title: Creative Lead
description:
**About Ogilvy**

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

  

**About WPP**

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

**Imagine yourself at Ogilvy.**

Imagine you can help brands grow and increase their positive impact on society in a creative and meaningful way. And at the same time, you also grow. At Ogilvy, that’s our mission. We achieve this by bringing in people who are creative, strategic, bold, disruptive, curious, detail-oriented, proactive, enthusiastic, analytical, multidisciplinary, open-minded, and all the other good qualities you can think of.

Can you imagine being one of those people? **Then, join our team!**

We’re looking for a **Creative Lead** to join our team and drive the global social and creator strategy for one of the world’s leading FMCG brands.

This is a **strategic and hands-on role**, perfect for a creative who has evolved from an **art direction background**into leading multi-platform campaigns with a strong focus on **social, collabs and creator-driven storytelling**.

You’ll lead creative development from insight to execution — crafting concepts that transcend formats, inspire teams and perform across markets.

**Responsabilities:**

* Lead the **creative vision and execution** for all social-first and creator-led content across global markets.

* Translate global brand platforms into culturally relevant, platform-native ideas and **creator collaborations**.

* Partner with Strategy, Account and Production to ensure creative excellence and brand consistency.

* Ideate and oversee **collaborations with influencers, creators and cultural partners**, ensuring authenticity and impact.

* Mentor and guide a small creative team (art & copy), raising the bar in concepting, design and storytelling.

* Collaborate with global hubs to align creative approaches across regions and partners.

* Stay ahead of trends, formats and innovations in **social, content and creator economy**.
* Be the guardian of the brand’s tone, look & feel, and creative consistency across every touchpoint.

**Qualifications:**

* **7+ years of creative experience**, ideally starting as an **Art Director** and evolving into a **Creative Lead / ACD**role.

* Proven track record developing **social-first campaigns** and **creator collabs** for global or regional brands.

* Deep understanding of **platform-specific storytelling**, digital culture and the creator ecosystem.

* Sharp visual sensibility and the ability to craft ideas that are as beautiful as they are effective.

* Experience leading creative teams and managing partner agencies or freelancers.

* Fluent presentation and communication skills in **English (C2 level required)**.
* Curiosity, agility and passion for how creativity moves at the speed of culture.

And since you'll give this and much more, **we also want to give you much more**:

* A dynamic and creative work environment.

* High-profile clients and international brands.

* Full-time position.

* Hybrid format: 2 or 3 days in the office / 2 or 3 days remote work.

* Christmas, Easter, July, and August: FULL REMOTE.

* Flexible hours.

* Permanent contract with a six-month trial period.

* 22 working days of vacation per year + 12 extra days!

* Optional access to flexible compensation (health insurance, transportation, meals, and childcare).

* Ogilvy Wellness Program: Free psychological, legal, and financial support service. Discounts on physiotherapy and gyms.
* Ogilvy is recognized with the Family-Responsible Company (EFR) certification for its commitment to employee well-being and work-life balance.

If you’ve imagined yourself in this position, that’s a good sign. At Ogilvy, we want to work with the best talent—those who challenge us and make us better. People who are eager to experience an agency culture open to diversity as a principle and connectivity as a primary tool.

So, if you're nodding your head while reading this, **send us your CV!**

At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression.

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.

Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve. This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.

Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at accommodations@ogilvy.com. Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.

title: E-Commerce Paid Media Creative Strategist
description:
En Natulim buscamos un/a **Creative Strategist – Paid Ads** que nos ayude a llevar nuestras creatividades publicitarias al siguiente nivel.

Buscamos una persona que combine **creatividad, storytelling y mentalidad de performance**: alguien capaz de detectar qué hace que un anuncio funcione, convertir insights en conceptos creativos y aterrizarlos en vídeos, hooks y guiones que generen resultados.

No buscamos un perfil puramente conceptual ni un/a editor/a de vídeo. Queremos a alguien que **piense la creatividad de principio a fin**, desde el insight y el concepto hasta la estructura del anuncio y su ejecución, trabajando junto al equipo de contenido, edición y performance.

### **Qué harás**

* Desarrollar **conceptos creativos y ángulos de comunicación** para campañas de paid ads.
* Crear y testar diferentes **hooks, narrativas, claims y estructuras de vídeo** para mejorar el rendimiento de los anuncios.
* Escribir **guiones y briefs creativos** claros para producción y edición.
* Analizar anuncios propios y de competidores para identificar oportunidades y nuevos enfoques.
* Analizar resultados de las creatividades y entender qué elementos están funcionando: **hook, retención, engagement, CTR, conversión, etc.**
* Transformar aprendizajes de performance en nuevas ideas y ciclos de test.
* Trabajar estrechamente con los equipos de **Performance, Content y Editing** para producir y escalar las mejores creatividades.
* Adaptar tendencias, formatos y códigos de redes sociales al universo de Natulim.
* Participar en la creación de contenido tanto **short-form como long-form**, siempre con foco en su aplicación a paid media.
* Mantener un sistema continuo de **testing e iteración creativa**.

### **Qué buscamos**

* **2+ años de experiencia** creando contenido creativo en vídeo para redes sociales y/o paid media.
* Experiencia real desarrollando **anuncios en vídeo para plataformas como Meta, Instagram, TikTok o YouTube**.
* Experiencia escribiendo **guiones, hooks y conceptos creativos**.
* Haber editado vídeo o tener suficiente conocimiento de edición para entender cómo llevar una idea a ejecución.
* Entender las estructuras que hacen que un vídeo funcione: **hooks, retención, ritmo, storytelling y CTA**.
* Experiencia trabajando con marcas de **e-commerce, belleza, FMCG o consumo**.
* Capacidad para interpretar métricas de performance y convertir datos en aprendizajes creativos.
* Buen criterio creativo y capacidad para convertir ideas en piezas concretas y ejecutables.
* Perfil autónomo, proactivo, curioso y muy conectado con tendencias y formatos actuales.
* **Permiso de trabajo en España.**

### **¿Qué ofrecemos?**

* **Acceso y formación en herramientas de IA**, trabajando con tecnología puntera como Claude.
* **Contrato indefinido**, estabilidad laboral y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.
* **Jornada completa de lunes a viernes**, con flexibilidad de entrada y salida.
* **Formación interna y externa** para impulsar tu aprendizaje continuo.
* **Retribución flexible** adaptada a tus necesidades (seguro médico, restaurante, transporte y guardería).
* **Hasta un 50% de descuento en productos Natulim.**
* **Días de adaptación escolar**, para acompañar a hijos menores de 3 años cuando lo necesites.
* **Un equipo joven, dinámico y con muy buen ambiente**, donde las personas y las ideas cuentan.  
    
  Te esperamos!

title: E-commerce Creative Strategist Ads - Poland
description:
**Creative Strategist Ads - Poland**
====================================

**About Natulim**
-----------------

Natulim is a fast-growing European brand of eco-friendly cleaning products. Our ambition is to become **Europe’s leading brand in eco-friendly cleaning**, building a strong, innovative DTC brand that stays close to its consumers.

Our flagship product, **biodegradable laundry detergent sheets**, offers a simpler and more sustainable alternative to traditional laundry detergents.

We currently operate across several European markets, and our growth is driven by a **DTC, data-driven and performance-oriented approach**, combining Shopify, acquisition, content, CRM and a culture of continuous experimentation.

We are a young, international and **remote-first team**, where everyone has a high level of autonomy and ownership. We are now looking to accelerate our growth in **Poland**, a strategic market for Natulim.

To support this ambition, we are looking for a **Creative Strategist for Poland** who can take ownership of the market and build the creative growth engine behind it.

**The Role**
------------

We are looking for someone who is **highly creative, performance-driven and strongly business-oriented** to drive Natulim’s growth in the Polish market.

Our main growth driver will be **creating, testing and optimizing ads**. We are looking for someone who can turn consumer insights into **creative angles, advertising concepts and content that drives sales**.

You will combine **creativity with data analysis**: understanding what works and why, developing new hypotheses, and continuously improving our creative system.

We are not simply looking for someone who can manage an ecommerce business. We want someone who can **understand Polish consumers, identify new communication angles and turn creativity into business growth**.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **1. Creative Strategy & Performance Ads**

* Regularly analyze campaign and creative performance to identify the **angles, hooks, formats and messages** that drive results.
* Identify new creative opportunities based on **data, consumer insights, trends, competitors and Polish culture**.
* Develop new creative hypotheses and propose innovative advertising concepts tailored to the local market.
* Create **creative briefs** and collaborate with internal teams, creators and external partners to produce new ads.
* Develop and test different **creative angles, hooks, formats, messages and value propositions** in Polish.
* Identify what makes a creative successful and turn those learnings into new iterations.
* Gradually build a **scalable creative system** capable of continuously generating new ideas and high-performing creatives.
* Stay up to date with DTC brands, social media trends and emerging creative approaches in Poland and internationally.
* Work closely with the Paid Media team to turn creative insights into **profitable customer acquisition and business growth**.

### **2. Growth & Performance**

* Track key acquisition and performance KPIs, including **CAC, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, AOV and LTV**.
* Understand the relationship between creative performance, customer acquisition and ecommerce conversion.
* Identify friction points in the funnel and propose initiatives to improve overall performance.
* Prioritize initiatives based on their **potential business impact**.
* Analyze the performance of the Polish market and translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Test, learn, iterate and scale the initiatives that work.

### **3. E-commerce & CRO**

* Manage and optimize the Shopify shopping experience for the Polish market.
* Identify opportunities to improve **conversion rates, AOV and revenue**.
* Manage and optimize products, collections, promotions, bundles, product pages and landing pages.
* Propose and coordinate experiments and A/B tests.
* Identify friction points in the customer journey and work with the relevant teams to address them.
* Ensure an excellent user experience, particularly on mobile, taking into account the expectations of Polish consumers.

### **4. CRM & Retention**

* Coordinate CRM campaigns and automated flows using **Klaviyo**.
* Ensure consistency between acquisition campaigns and the customer journey.
* Identify opportunities to improve **retention, reactivation and LTV**.
* Collaborate with the relevant teams to maximize the value generated by each customer.
* Adapt CRM messaging and communications to the linguistic and cultural specificities of the Polish market.

### **5. Polish Market Development**

* Develop a deep understanding of the **Polish consumer**, including their needs, objections, motivations and purchasing habits.
* Adapt messaging, creative assets and value propositions to the Polish market.
* Identify local trends, competitors and new growth opportunities.
* Help increase Natulim’s brand awareness and establish the brand as a leading player in the Polish market.
* Work independently while collaborating closely with the central team based in Spain.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Experience in **DTC ecommerce, Growth, Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing or a similar environment**.
* Strong creative instincts and the ability to **generate advertising ideas, angles and concepts**.
* Experience creating, testing or optimizing **digital advertising campaigns**.
* A solid understanding of **Meta Ads and key performance marketing principles**.
* The ability to analyze performance data and translate it into **creative and business insights**.
* A good understanding of key KPIs, including **CAC, ROAS, CTR, CVR, AOV and LTV**.
* Experience with Shopify or another ecommerce platform.
* An understanding of CRO, UX and funnel optimization.
* Knowledge of CRM, ideally including **Klaviyo**.
* A **hands-on mindset**, with the ability to work independently and take ownership.
* An entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment.
* **Native or bilingual Polish, with an excellent understanding of local language nuances and cultural context.**
* **Professional working proficiency in English** to collaborate effectively with an international team.

**What Will Make You Stand Out**
--------------------------------

* A genuine **obsession with creativity and ideas that sell**.
* Experience working in **DTC brands, startups or high-growth companies**.
* Experience with UGC content, social media ads or creative testing.
* The ability to move quickly from **idea concept test learning iteration**.
* Strong analytical skills without losing your creative edge.
* Experience launching or scaling a market.
* A strong understanding of Polish consumer behavior, digital trends and local advertising conventions.
* The ability to identify creative opportunities through customer feedback, performance data and competitive analysis.

title: Senior Manager Brand Strategy & Creative Solutions (m/f/d) Barcelona
Design Lead (Madrid only, contract)
description:
**This position is only for a particular project, not a full time inhouse position.**

**In this case, the social package (sick leaves, days off, vacation, necessary equipment provision, etc) is not covered by Selecto.**

### **PROJECT**

**Domain:** Sport Broadcasting

**Description:** We are designing a flexible, scalable multi-platform digital experience across responsive web, mobile apps, and connected TV, delivered through a comprehensive design system. The goal is to ensure a consistent and high-quality user experience across all digital touchpoints, compliant with WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards, and capable of smoothly shifting between lower-intensity “Flame to Flame” periods and peak-demand “Games Time” moments. The experience must serve a global, multilingual audience and perform reliably during major traffic spikes.

**Team:** Design Lead, Multidisciplinary designers (UX, UI, motion, accessibility specialist), Project Manager, Design Directors, Content and Development teams.

**Timeline:** full time, 6 months with the possibility of prolongation

**Location: Madrid, Spain only. There is a possibility of working from the client’s office once a week.**

**Languages: Fluent English, Fluent Spanish is a plus.**

This role is the strategic and creative anchor of project, and the face of the client in Madrid. You own the vision and quality of a multi-platform design system spanning responsive web, native mobile (iOS and Android) and, potentially, connected TV (Apple TV, Android TV, Amazon Fire TV, Roku), across two fundamentally different operating modes: the high-intensity, real-time data environment and the editorial, content-discovery focus.

You look at the product as a whole, not ticket by ticket. You set the design direction, govern the design system, guide the team's craft and hold the day-to-day relationship with the client, in person in Madrid, ideally once a week.

You bridge strategic intent and hands-on delivery, so the team works to one vision and the client feels the difference.

### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategy & Client Partnership**

* Hold the strategic view of the product and turn its objectives, priorities and brand evolution into a clear design direction and a deliverable plan.
* Anticipate needs and frame decisions proactively; work with the Project Director on scope, estimates and growth opportunities.
* Act as the trusted creative partner to the client: lead day-to-day communication, build relationships with Product Managers, manage expectations, take feedback with composure, and present to senior stakeholders in a multi-vendor environment.
* **Be on site in Madrid, ideally weekly, for reviews, workshops and working sessions.**

**Design Quality & Team Leadership**

* Set and hold the quality bar: run critiques, review all significant output before it reaches the client, and give direct feedback.
* Manage and coach the remote delivery team (Senior Product Designers and Product Designers across European time zones); grow seniors into leads.
* Set briefs, manage sprint workloads, protect focus, and coordinate with vendors and engineering partners.
* Define quality gates, review workflows and design operations frameworks that scale across engagements.
* Stay hands-on for explorations, key screens and defining moments.

**Design System**

* Architect and govern an atomic design system (tokens, components, patterns) across responsive web, native mobile and connected TV.
* Design for high-density real-time data (live results, schedules, medals), editorial storytelling and content discovery, plus TV-specific interaction (remote navigation, 10-foot UI, lean-back viewing).
* Build in accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), multilingual support and RTL from the start.
* Define contribution models, handoff protocols, documentation and versioning so client teams and vendors can extend the system safely.

**Design Engineering & AI**

* Work where design meets code: tokens, coded prototypes and the component library as living sources of truth.
* Use AI for prototyping, asset generation, automated QA and routine production; champion adoption with the team and client, with judgement on where craft stays human.

**Research & Validation**

* Shape and support user testing with the client and research partners, turning findings into design decisions.
* Build the evidence base for recommendations: testing, analytics and benchmarks.

### **PROFILE**

* Senior design leader (typically 10+ years) experienced in complex, large organisations with many stakeholders, vendors and governance.
* Background in major events, sports, broadcast or streaming preferred; live, real-time data experience is an advantage.
* Proven track record building and governing enterprise-scale, multi-platform design systems (web, native mobile, and TV).
* Fluent English (Spanish a plus), confident presenting to senior stakeholders.
* Based in Madrid, able to be on site ideally weekly (travel costs partially covered).
* Strategic, tasteful, calm under pressure and decisive; comfortable as the most senior design voice in the room.
* At ease with code, design tokens and AI-assisted workflows.

### **REQUIRED SKILLS & TOOLS**

* **Figma (expert) and design token tooling**
* **Coded prototyping and AI-assisted design tools**
* **CTV/OTT design constraints**
* **WCAG 2.1 AA (hard requirement)**
* Real-time data and live event design
* Standard project tracking, documentation and communication tools

title: Creative Strategist & Storyteller - YouTube + Instagram
description:
**Creative Strategist & Storyteller**
=====================================

En Natulim mejoramos los productos clásicos de limpieza. Creamos productos sin residuos, prácticos de utilizar y con ingredientes buenos para la piel y el planeta.

Nuestro producto estrella es un detergente para la ropa en formato de **tiras biodegradables** que se disuelven en la lavadora.

**Sobre el rol**
----------------

Buscamos un/a **Creative Strategist & Storyteller** para desarrollar conceptos creativos que conviertan y elevar el nivel de nuestros contenido en vídeo: Meta, Ads y YouTube.

Buscamos una persona que combine **criterio creativo, storytelling y mentalidad de performance**, capaz de detectar qué hace que un contenido funcione, transformar insights en conceptos potentes y convertirlos en piezas de vídeo que generen resultados.

El objetivo no es simplemente crear vídeos bonitos: es **crear anuncios que capten la atención, mantengan la retención y conviertan**.

Trabajarás principalmente con formatos de **Meta, YouTube y otras plataformas de paid social**, desarrollando conceptos tanto para vídeo short form como long form.

**No es un rol de UGC ni de influencer marketing.**  
Es un rol de **Creative Strategy Concept Hook Narrative Execution Testing Learning.**

**Responsabilidades**
---------------------

* Definir la **estrategia creativa de nuestros anuncios de vídeo**.
* Desarrollar conceptos, ángulos y campañas orientadas a performance.
* Crear **hooks** capaces de captar la atención en los primeros segundos.
* Escribir guiones y estructuras para anuncios **short y long form**.
* Diseñar diferentes narrativas, mensajes y formatos para testar.
* Transformar insights de consumidor, producto y performance en nuevas ideas creativas.
* **Analizar anuncios propios y de la competencia para detectar** **qué funciona, por qué funciona y cómo podemos mejorarlo**.
* **Analizar métricas creativas como CTR, hook rate, retention, CVR, CPA/ROAS** **y utilizar estos aprendizajes para iterar.**
* Crear sistemas de testing de diferentes hooks, claims, estructuras, mensajes y CTAs.
* Detectar tendencias y formatos relevantes y adaptarlos a la marca sin perder el foco en conversión.
* Trabajar junto al equipo de edición para llevar los conceptos a ejecución.
* Iterar rápidamente a partir de resultados y feedback.
* Construir una **biblioteca de conceptos y aprendizajes creativos** que permita escalar la producción de contenido.

**Perfil que buscamos**
-----------------------

* **+2 años de experiencia** en contenido creativo en vídeo, habiendo participado también en su edición y publicación.
* Experiencia demostrable creando contenido que haya conseguido **buenos resultados en redes o paid media**.
* Experiencia trabajando con **marcas de e-commerce, DTC y/o cosmética/beauty**.
* Experiencia creando contenido para **Meta Ads, YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads o plataformas similares**.
* Haber participado en vídeos de YouTube con **+50K visualizaciones** será muy valorado.
* Experiencia tanto en **short form como long form**.
* Capacidad para escribir **hooks, guiones y conceptos creativos**.
* Mentalidad muy orientada a **performance y conversión**.
* Capacidad para entender métricas y utilizarlas para tomar decisiones creativas.
* Criterio visual y capacidad para reconocer cuándo una pieza tiene potencial y cuándo no.
* Perfil **muy creativo, curioso y ejecutor**: alguien que propone ideas y sabe convertirlas en piezas reales.
* Capacidad para entender **por qué un anuncio funciona** y trasladar ese aprendizaje a nuevos conceptos.
* Estar muy conectado/a con el ecosistema de contenido, publicidad digital y tendencias creativas.
* Se valorará especialmente haber trabajado en equipos donde existiera un proceso continuo de **testing análisis iteración escala**.

**Qué ofrecemos**
-----------------

* **Acceso y formación en herramientas de IA**, trabajando con tecnología puntera como Claude.
* **Contrato indefinido**, estabilidad laboral y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.
* **Jornada completa de lunes a viernes**, con flexibilidad de entrada y salida.
* **Formación interna y externa** para impulsar tu aprendizaje continuo.
* **Retribución flexible** adaptada a tus necesidades: seguro médico, restaurante, transporte y guardería.
* **Hasta un 50% de descuento en productos Natulim.**
* **Días de adaptación escolar**, para acompañar a hijos menores de 3 años cuando lo necesites.
* **Un equipo joven, dinámico y con muy buen ambiente**, donde las personas y las ideas cuentan.

**¡Únete a Natulim!**
---------------------

Si te apasiona crear **contenido que capta la atención, cuentan historias y venden**, queremos conocerte.

title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist (Remote)
description:
**Media buying is now the easy part.**

In 2026, the buying itself is piping. The levers that actually move a DTC account are creative, offer, and conversion rate, and the platform keeps getting better at rewarding whoever gets those right.

So we don't hire media buyers. We hire marketers who buy media.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands across our service lines, 20 to 25 of them on paid media, and we spend $6-9M a month on Meta. We're hiring one person to own a handful of those accounts end to end.

Here's what "end to end" actually means here.

**You are the account manager.** We don't have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership and accountability: when you're the person answering for the account, it's your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

**You are the creative strategist.** You do the research, you find the angles, and you write the briefs and the scripts. You direct our editors and designers rather than filing requests with them. Creative isn't a ticket you submit. It's your job.

**You build the things the account needs.** If conversion rate is the bottleneck, you build the landing page. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

**You carry up to six accounts.** That's the capacity we run at today, and the team averages about four and a half. You'll manage far fewer accounts than you would at most agencies. In exchange you get real ownership of the results and you get to work as an end to end marketer instead of one station on an assembly line.

**You can live anywhere.** We're a remote team and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you're the client's point of contact and there's nobody else to cover it. The rest of your day is yours.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we'll both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

**We're growing fast and we keep the bar high.**

We believe the best media buyer today is a sharp marketer who uses AI every day. We built an internal creative analysis tool that connects to Claude, and we use Pipeboard to read and write to ad accounts and run heavy analysis. You don't need to know our stack yet. You do need to actually use AI in your work, not be afraid of it, and teach yourself what you don't know.

 **Requirements**  

### **What the job looks like**

**Own 4 to 6 DTC accounts** as the strategist, the buyer, the creative lead, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $30k/mo to $1M/mo.

**Own the client relationship.** There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you're the one who answers when something isn't working.

**Run the research before the ads.** Marketing is 80% research here. You mine customer reviews, ad comments, support tickets, and Reddit for the language and objections that become angles. You pull competitor ad libraries. You run our internal tooling that OCRs and transcribes the ads in your account and ties them to performance, so you know what winning and losing actually look like in *this* account.

**Write the briefs and the scripts, and direct the work.** Creative direction is yours. You run revision rounds with our editors and designers and you hold the quality bar.

**Ship creative on a cadence.** Roughly 8 to 10 new ad launches a week is where accounts hold, in batches every 1 to 1.5 weeks. Informed volume, not spray and pray. We want better hypotheses, not more randomness.

**Build and test landing pages.** Advertorials, comparison pages, PDPs. Built in Claude Code, deployed to Vercel, tested live on a subdomain before anything gets pushed into the client's theme.

**Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.** Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.

**Report on new customer economics.** We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended ROAS and not last click. You'll be expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.

### **You're a fit if**

**You've done this with real money.** Hands-on Meta at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them.

**You're AI-native, and you build.** This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude (or equivalent) as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. If you can research, write, and build a converting page from scratch, we can teach you the buying.

**You can write direct response in English at a native or near-native level.** Hooks, scripts, ad copy, advertorial. In the customer's own words, not invented. This is the single biggest source of leverage in the role and the thing we screen hardest for. If writing persuasive English isn't a strength, this isn't the job.

**You can communicate your ideas.** This matters as much as anything else on this list. You'll be in front of clients constantly with nobody in between, so you need to be able to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire.

**You have taste and you know when to hand off.** You direct creative, you don't half-build it yourself. AI slop shipped to a client is a habit we break, not a shortcut we accept.

**You can work US Eastern business hours** for client calls. Where you live is up to you.

**Bonus:** you've built or operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand. Several of our team have, and it shows.

### **You're not a fit if**

* **"That wasn't my role" is in your vocabulary.** It's the fastest way to end an interview here. If creative was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the creative.
* You want to be told what to do this week.
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters.

 **Benefits**  

### **Why This Role Is Exciting**

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

**You will work on real brands with real budgets.** We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

**You will grow into senior strategy.** We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. **The opportunity**

At Homa, AI is already part of how we make ads, playables and 3D assets. Now we need someone to turn it into a system that moves business results: faster wins, lower CPI (cost per install) and lower cost per winning ad.

You'll join our Creatives team and report to our Head of Creatives. You'll own the full cycle, from idea and brief to finished ad, and you'll work closely with UA, data and creative leads. You'll have access to the best AI models and tools from day one.

* **Raise.** Set the quality bar for the team, and push AI output until it's on-brand and stops the scroll.

* **Scout.** Keep testing new AI models and tools like Veo, Sora, Kling and Runway, and turn the useful ones into team workflows.

**Requirements**

* **Motivated.** You're ambitious and grounded. You see this opportunity as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else.

**For this role, you'll also bring**

* Visual taste. You can tell a good ad from a generic one, and you finish AI output by hand when it needs it.
* Hands-on AI video skills, plus strong After Effects or similar motion tools.
* A gaming background. You know mobile games, ideally hybrid-casual or casual, and what makes players tap.
* Critical and marketing thinking. You think in hooks, audiences and performance data, not just assets.
* Systems and automation expertise. You don't just make AI creatives, you design workflows that scale across games.
* Full autonomy. You spot problems, decide, ship and report without being managed day to day.

**Bonus points if you have:**

* UA or performance creative experience, ideally with winning ads on networks like AppLovin.
* Hands-on experience with Blender or other 3D tools, Unity, or playable ad tools.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

 **Benefits**

**Why Homa**

Your multidisciplinary team spans design, research, documentation, and accessibility, and works across web and mobile platforms in multiple countries and time zones.

That means using tools such as Figma Make, Claude Design, and other large language model (LLM)-based technologies to explore ideas, prototype, and test faster, and guiding the team to adopt them thoughtfully and responsibly.

Our design team is spread across multiple geographies including the UK, US, Colombia and Europe. You will lead it with flexibility and inclusion, building connection across locations and adjusting your own working hours when the business or the team needs you, so every colleague, in every time zone, has the access and support they need.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

* Strong leadership skills and the ability to create a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture
* Flexibility to work outside standard hours when needed to collaborate with colleagues, partners, and customers in other time zones

* Fluency in written and spoken English

* Experience in education technology or enterprise software as a service (SaaS)

We're an education company that builds technology. Learn more at blackboard.com.

* **Made By Music -**
  Inspired by shared passion and independence.
* **Pride in our product and service -**
  Obsess over detail, always learning and improving.
* **Embrace the culture -**
  Integrity, Innovation, Energy, Openness, Teamwork, Diversity, Flexibility, Fun, Music.
* **Make an impact -**
  See it through. Go the extra mile.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an exceptional person to join Cambridge Audio at a crucial time. We launched our new identity last year and have released a run of category-defining products through 2026, earning awards, critical acclaim and design accolades along the way. We need a Head of Creative to set the creative standard for what comes next. You will be the creative authority for the brand, responsible for the quality, consistency and impact of everything we put into the world, from product film and photography to web, print and live events. You will work closely with the CMO and the Head of PR and lead a small in-house creative studio. The company is small, the goals are demanding and the pace is high.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Set the creative vision:**
  Define and champion the creative direction across all channels (web, print, video, physical and digital), expressing our pillars:
  *Inspired by music. Crafted by design. Shaped by culture.*
* **Lead the function:**
  Own the creative team, workflow, budget and resourcing, blending in-house talent with agencies, copywriters and freelancers to deliver first-class work.
* **Lead the work from concept to delivery:**
  Art direct every shoot and campaign, owning the quality of the output and the results it delivers.
* **Own content direction:**
  Help shape and deliver a content strategy built around our brand pillars that reaches the right audiences, with a clear view of what success looks like.
* **Unite copy and design:**
  Direct tone of voice and copy alongside visual work. Own and evolve the brand guidelines and roll them out consistently across global markets.
* **Connect product and marketing:**
  Work with Engineering, Product and Marketing to shape creative requirements early in product development.
* **Be a voice of the brand:**
  Present the brand and creative direction to listeners, press, retailers and internal teams with confidence.
* **Build the process:**
  Put in place the planning, briefing and approval processes that let a small team deliver at pace without compromising standards.
* **Stay hands-on:**
  Pitch in and support design at busy times with the right skills and tools.

**Requirements**

* Creative Director/Head of Creative experience leading creative teams and external partners, including remotely, delivering on time and on budget across the campaign lifecycle from concept to delivery.
* A strong creative portfolio across multiple mediums and channels, including AV, Stills, Digital and ATL.
* Agency or similar in-house studio experience is essential.
* Passion for music, contemporary culture and technology.
* Deep understanding of how brand contributes to business growth, helping Cambridge Audio reach new audiences, drive product relevance, and open up new opportunities.
* Experience in hiring, nurturing and developing creative talent.
* Experienced in the use of and experimentation with AI as a copilot, or at least genuinely receptive and excited to experiment with AI design tools and integrate them into your workflow.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to represent the brand.
* Strong planning and project management skills in a small, scaling business.

**Desirable**

* Experience in technology and/or lifestyle businesses, Agency or publishing background
* Experience repositioning or evolving a brand with heritage
* Adobe Creative Suite proficiency and/or Web UX/UI experience.
* Understanding of how brand and creative drive business growth, product relevance and new audiences

**Personal Profile**

* Charismatic, personable and easy to work with.
* Driven, with the conviction to guide change and the drive to keep the brand relevant and ahead of the curve.

**Working Pattern & Duration**

Full-time, permanent.

**Location**

This role is based at our London Bridge HQ on a hybrid basis. We're looking for someone based in or near London who can be in the office regularly.

**Compensation**

Competitive salary based on experience.

If you need any adjustments to the recruitment process, let us know.

title: AI-Enabled Creative Director (US-Based)
description:
As an
**AI-Enabled Creative Director**
, you will turn complex business challenges into compelling creative ideas while making AI an essential part of how creative work is developed and delivered.

You will lead multidisciplinary teams, shape creative direction, and confidently sell ideas to clients. Beyond using AI tools yourself, you will build and apply practical workflows that expand creative possibilities, improve production efficiency, and help your teams deliver exceptional work.

This role calls for both strong creative leadership and hands-on AI expertise. You know how to inspire people, make confident creative decisions, and use emerging technology to elevate the work without compromising originality, strategy, or quality.

Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service platform. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.

**Why this role exists**

Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.

With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.

We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.

This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.

**What you will be doing**

* **Set the creative vision**
  – Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and disciplines, translating business objectives into compelling concepts, campaigns, brand identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Sell and champion creative ideas**
  – Present concepts with confidence, articulate the strategy behind your recommendations, and build buy-in from both clients and creative teams. Navigate objections assertively and constructively while protecting the integrity of the work.
* **Build and implement AI-enabled workflows**
  – Develop practical workflows for your client projects, combining AI tools to streamline asset creation, refinement, and production. Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and strengthen execution.
* **Expand creative possibilities through AI**
  – Use AI to explore new directions, challenge conventional approaches, and develop stronger creative solutions. Apply the technology where it adds meaningful value, not simply because it is available.
* **Lead and mentor multidisciplinary creatives**
  – Provide clear direction, actionable feedback, and support to designers, writers, motion specialists, and other creative professionals. Help teams strengthen their craft and incorporate AI effectively into their work.
* **Own the creative lifecycle**
  – Stay involved from the initial brief through final delivery, overseeing execution and quality control. Ensure every asset meets the highest standards of strategic relevance, originality, brand consistency, and production quality.
* **Collaborate closely with Creative Project Managers (CPMs)**
  – Partner with your CPM to align priorities, navigate feedback, and support smooth project execution while maintaining ownership of creative direction and outcomes.
* **Anticipate and resolve challenges**
  – Proactively identify creative or client issues, make confident decisions, and find solutions independently. Take responsibility for keeping creative work moving without relying on managerial escalation.

**What you will bring**

* **Around 8 years of relevant creative experience**
  , including at least
  **2 years in creative leadership and 2 years of hands-on experience applying AI to creative workflows**
  .
* **An outstanding creative portfolio with strong AI-enabled samples**
  , demonstrating strategic thinking, originality, and high-quality execution across creative disciplines. You can clearly explain your role, creative decisions, and the impact of AI on the final work.
* **Proven experience developing and implementing AI-powered creative workflows**
  , combining technologies such as Higgsfield, Weavy, or comparable tools to enhance creative development and production. Your expertise goes beyond basic prompting or isolated AI-generated assets.
* **A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving**
  , with the confidence to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and independently resolve creative or client issues without waiting for direction.
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail**
  , with the ability to balance competing priorities, identify inconsistencies, maintain brand standards, and deliver high-quality work across multiple projects.
* **Assertive, persuasive communication skills**
  , with a demonstrated ability to pitch and sell creative ideas, defend recommendations, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment among both clients and creative teams.
* **Experience leading and mentoring multidisciplinary creatives**
  , providing decisive direction, constructive feedback, and the motivation needed to bring ambitious ideas to life.
* **Strong creative and strategic judgment**
  , grounded in branding, storytelling, art direction, design, and audience-centered communication, with an understanding of responsible AI use and the importance of human oversight.
* **Experience managing a high volume and variety of creative deliverables**
  across multiple clients, brands, or products in fast-paced agency or in-house environments.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, along with the adaptability, reliability, and strong internet connection needed to succeed in a remote environment

**How we work**

Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection.

You will work within a
**Creative Circle alongside a Creative Project Manager (CPM) and a multidisciplinary team of creative professionals**
, supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts.

Your CPM partners with you on project coordination, timelines, priorities, and delivery. As the Creative Director, you lead creative strategy, guide the team, own the creative side of client relationships, and remain accountable for the quality of work from initial brief through final delivery.

**This role requires a high level of independence and accountability.**
You will operate autonomously without a Head of Department managing your day-to-day creative decisions or resolving routine client challenges on your behalf. We expect you to anticipate issues, communicate assertively, make sound decisions, and take ownership of solutions while keeping your CPM and creative team aligned.

**What this role offers**

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.

**We believe great teams are built on shared values:**

* Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
* Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
* Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
* Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
* Move with Purpose and make every action count.

**Success in this role means:**

* Delivering original, strategically strong creative work across multiple client accounts, maintaining exceptional quality from concept through final execution.
* Making AI a practical part of creative production by implementing workflows that expand creative possibilities and improve efficiency.
* Building trust and alignment with clients and creatives through persuasive presentations, confident leadership, and clear creative direction.
* Proactively resolving challenges, managing priorities independently, and maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.

description:
**ABOUT STORD**
---------------

  

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

  

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

  

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

  

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

About the Role
  
  
The Creative Director is the visual and conceptual voice of Stord. Reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, you will set the creative vision for how Stord looks, sounds, and feels across every channel, and lead the studio that brings it to life.
  
  
This role is for a hands-on creative leader who moves comfortably between big ideas and finished work. You have strong opinions about what great creative looks like, a portfolio that proves it, and the leadership skills to inspire a studio team and manage agency and freelance partners. You know that creative and performance work together, and you build campaigns that prove it for DTC founders, ecommerce leaders, and the broader commerce ecosystem.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Content, and Sales to make sure Stord's creative is consistent, differentiated, and commercially effective at every touchpoint.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Creative Vision & Brand Identity**

* Own Stord's creative vision, visual identity, and brand expression, keeping them consistent and distinctive across all channels and audiences
* Turn Stord's positioning into a clear visual language, voice, and point of view that resonates with mid-market DTC founders and ecommerce operators
* Act as the creative steward of the brand: set standards, educate the organization, and push for quality at every touchpoint
Partner with Product Marketing so creative ladders up to GTM messaging and positioning  

  

**Creative Studio Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop the in-house studio of designers, creatives, and content producers
* Set creative direction and review work across campaigns, sales collateral, web, events, and product marketing assets
* Build efficient creative processes (briefing, intake, review, and approvals) so the studio delivers high-quality work at the pace of a high-growth company
Manage agency and freelance relationships to scale output when needed  

  

**Campaigns & Content Creative**

* Develop big ideas and integrated campaign concepts that bring the brand to life across digital, video, social, events, and owned media
* Direct the creative for thought leadership, video, and editorial content that earns attention and builds brand affinity with DTC founders and ecommerce leaders
* Partner with Demand Generation and Sales to create work that drives pipeline, and use performance data to sharpen it
Make sure all creative reinforces Stord's position as the default operating system for modern commerce  

  

**Brand Experience & Visibility**

* Guide creative for major company moments, including product launches, partnerships, and executive announcements
* Support executive visibility and PR efforts with strong creative storytelling and polished visual assets
Collaborate with Communications and Content on a consistent narrative across press, social, and owned channels  

  

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 10+ years of progressive creative or marketing experience, with at least 4 years in a Creative Director or equivalent creative leadership role, ideally in VC-backed, high-growth B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services
* A strong portfolio showing concept-to-execution work across brand, digital, video, campaigns, and sales or product marketing assets
* Proven experience building or scaling a creative function from an early or underdeveloped state
* Deep fluency across creative direction, brand identity, design, and storytelling, with the judgment to operate at the strategic level without losing touch with craft
* Experience leading and developing in-house creative or studio teams, and the ability to attract, retain, and inspire A-players
* Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and production partners
* Comfort working as a player-coach: you set direction and hold a high bar, and you roll up your sleeves when the moment calls for it
Superior storytelling, presentation skills, and executive presence, with the ability to defend creative decisions and represent the brand with conviction  

  

**Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------

* **Creative Vision:** Turns complex positioning into simple, memorable ideas and visual systems that connect to commercial outcomes
* **Builder's DNA:** Thrives in ambiguity; builds the processes, standards, and teams where none existed
* **Creative Rigor:** Holds a high bar for quality while moving at the speed of a high-growth business; knows when to ship and when to push
* **Cross-Functional Influence:** Earns trust with Marketing, Sales, Product, and executive stakeholders; drives alignment without relying on authority
* **Coaching & Talent Development:** Gives clear, constructive feedback and grows creative talent at every level
* **Customer Obsession:** Uses voice-of-customer insight to inform creative decisions and keeps the DTC founder and ecommerce operator at the center of the work
* **UX Ownership:** Brings deep understanding and empathy for the user experience and owns translating it into exceptional, engaging design

  

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* 10+ years of creative or marketing experience, including 4+ years leading creative direction in a high-growth B2B environment
* Experience managing and scaling an in-house creative or brand studio
* Demonstrated ability to deliver integrated campaigns that drive measurable business results
* Bachelor's degree in design, communications, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Bonus: prior experience in ecommerce SaaS, logistics, or commerce-adjacent technology

title: 3D Miniature Sculptor - Co-Founder & Chief 3D Design Director (CDD)
description:
3D Miniature Sculptor and Business Co-Founder sought for a new Funko-Like luxury collectable range currently in the startup phase

**Important Note on Compensation & Business Stage**

​TESSET is currently in its early incubation phase prior to our Kickstarter launch.  
​This position is a true co-founding partnership, not a salaried or contract role. There is no initial upfront pay or salary prior to crowdfunding. Post-Kickstarter funding will cover full production and distribution. Future executive compensation/dividends will be established as the line scales post-kickstarter.

As such however, this role would suit a candidate currently under other employ, and wished to undertake their work for this business in a part/spare time capacity in the short term

**​About The Business**

​TESSET is an upcoming hybrid product line merging collectible diorama displays (the luxury Gashapon/Funko aesthetic) with a tactical, symbol-based grid tabletop game. The core product features stunning character dioramas housed inside precision-engineered 5cm clear cubes, playing into a competitive 12-round cube-placement strategy.  
​We are currently preparing for our upcoming Kickstarter launch and are seeking our second founding director to take complete ownership of the 3D sculpting pillar—the core visual foundation of our tactile experience.

​**The Role**

​As our Chief 3D Design Director (CDD) and co-founding partner, you will work hand-in-hand with our Founder / CCO (Ryan, UK) to define, formulate, and execute the signature visual identity of the TESSET universe.

​You will take 2D concepts, lore, and character archetypes and translate them into production-ready 3D character assets optimized for large-scale physical production and manufacturing via our Chinese partners.

​**Key Responsibilities**

​**Define the Signature Look**: Formulate and evolve the overarching visual style of TESSET miniatures, establishing a cohesive design language across diverse genres (Sci-Fi, Fantasy, and beyond).

​**3D Character Sculpting**: Design and sculpt dynamic, highly readable character miniatures and environment pieces that pop when viewed through a clear display enclosure.

​**Design for Manufacturing** (DFM): Architect 3D models with strict awareness of physical production constraints, ensuring structural integrity, clean geometry, and minimal friction during mass production.

​**Co-Founder Leadership**: Participate as a core founding director in shaping product expansion sets, campaign milestones, and overall business strategy.

**State-Side Pursuits**: Handle any US activities such as Games Conventions, Partner Meetings etc (Ryan will handle UK/EU Equivalents)

​**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)**  
​

**Proven 3D Sculpting Portfolio**: Demonstrated experience in sculpting tabletop miniatures, collectible toys, or character assets (using ZBrush, Blender, or equivalent tools), ideally viewable via ArtStation or MyMiniFactory.

​**Mastery of Small-Scale Anatomy**: Deep understanding of how proportions, silhouettes, and details translate when shrunk down to a 38mm scale.

​**Technical & Manufacturing Awareness**: Understanding of how digital models prepare for resin bureaus or injection molding tolerances/draft angles.

​**Incubation & Entrepreneurial Mindset**: Understanding that this is an early-stage startup; you are looking for long-term brand co-ownership rather than short-term contract work.

​**Collaborative Partner**: A proactive communicator who can build creative direction alongside the CCO.

​**How to Apply**

​If you are an exceptional 3D sculptor who wants to co-found a brand-new tabletop IP from the ground up, we’d love to connect!  
​Please submit your application with:  
​A summary of experience.  
​A link to your portfolio (ArtStation, MyMiniFactory, Behance, etc.) highlighting miniature or character sculpts.  
​A brief note explaining why an early-stage co-founder role appeals to you.  
Any questions you may have at this stage

Pay: $1.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience my 3D modelling software such as Blender, Maya, Zbrush etc?
* Do you have an interest/passion of pop culture media such as video games, tv shows and movies?
* Do you understand this is a founders position and has no day one salary?

description:
### **About Us!**

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we’re proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio’s vision.

### **About Fivestone Studios!**

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and make heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

### **Your Mission**

We are looking for an experienced **Creative Director** to lead the creative vision and experience design of immersive, interactive, and technology-driven projects, from initial concept through to final delivery.

This role calls for a senior creative leader with a strong foundation in visual design and art direction, combined with expertise in experience strategy, UX, storytelling, content production, and creative technology.

You will shape compelling user and audience experiences, establish distinctive creative directions, and ensure creative consistency across multidisciplinary productions.

We are particularly interested in someone who is **hands-on in visual development**, capable of personally creating initial concepts, treatments, and style frames, while directing sophisticated content production and maintaining creative oversight throughout the entire project lifecycle.

You will collaborate closely with creative leadership, producers, designers, content strategists, creative technologists, developers, and other multidisciplinary teams to align creative vision with experience design, technical feasibility, and production requirements. You will also work with clients and stakeholders to translate their objectives and feedback into cohesive, high-quality experiences.

**PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.**

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Experience Strategy & Design**

* Define the overall experience vision, creative premise and guiding principles.
* Translate client objectives and audience needs into compelling, intuitive and engaging experiences.
* Shape user journeys, interaction models and experience principles, considering usability, accessibility and context.
* Identify opportunities to make experiences distinctive, meaningful and memorable.

#### **2. Creative & Art Direction**

* Direct visual design, motion, animation, content and storytelling to ensure a cohesive creative vision.

#### **3. Creative Leadership & Collaboration**

* Work closely with UX/UI Designers, Content Strategists, Creative Technologists, Developers, Animators, 3D Artists, Sound Designers and Producers.
* Encourage collaboration, experimentation and creative problem-solving.
* Ensure all disciplines remain aligned with the agreed creative vision and quality expectations.

#### **4. Technology & Production Collaboration**

* Work closely with Creative Technology and Production teams to ensure concepts are technically and operationally achievable.
* Understand relevant technologies, platforms and physical environments, recognising their opportunities and limitations.
* Balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, scope, budget and schedule.
* Identify potential constraints early and develop creative solutions without compromising the core experience.

#### **5. Creative Oversight & Delivery**

* Maintain creative oversight from concept development through to final delivery.
* Review designs, prototypes and integrated experiences, providing clear and constructive feedback.
* Make timely creative decisions and guide adaptations throughout development and production.
* Identify and resolve creative and experience-related issues, ensuring the final work maintains the quality, coherence and intent of the approved vision.

### **Your Journey**

#### **Must Have**

* **Experience:** developing immersive and interactive experiences across physical and digital environments.

* **Senior Creative Direction Experience:** Extensive experience leading the creative vision and execution of multidisciplinary projects from concept through final delivery.
* **Visual Design & Art Direction:** Strong artistic foundation with the ability to independently establish visual direction and create initial concepts, treatments and style frames.
* **Experience Design:** Proven expertise in shaping engaging user and audience experiences, including experience strategy, UX and interaction design.
* **Content Production:** Demonstrated experience directing sophisticated and technically complex content production across animation, game engines, film, UI and interactive experiences.
* **End-to-End Creative Ownership:** Ability to maintain creative leadership and involvement throughout development and production, ensuring the final experience reflects the approved creative vision.
* **Multidisciplinary Leadership:** Experience guiding creative teams across visual design, motion, animation, content, UX/UI, 3D and creative technology.
* **Creative Technology Understanding:** Strong understanding of technology-driven experiences, including technical possibilities, limitations and integration considerations.
* **Production Awareness:** Ability to balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, production constraints, budgets and schedules.
* **Creative Communication:** Ability to present concepts, communicate artistic direction, provide constructive feedback and collaborate effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams.

#### **Nice to Have**

* Background in brand experiences involving immersive, interactive or technology-driven creative work.
* Experience directing creative work across a broad range of content formats and production disciplines.

### **Engagement Opportunity**

The collaboration will begin on a **freelance basis**, with the intention of transitioning into a **full-time role** if there is a strong mutual fit. This is a remote position.

This opportunity is part of Fivestone Studios' long-term creative needs.

Thank you for applying. We’re committed to an inclusive process and we welcome talent from all walks of life. We aim to review every application. Roles in experiential can be ultra-specialized; if it’s not a fit for this one, we may still flag your profile for future opportunities. Thanks for helping grow the Sourcing Unicorns talent ecosystem.

title: Creative Director (Video Ads)
description:
**Why should you join Jerry?**

* Join a pre-IPO startup with capital, traction, and runway ($240M funded | 40X revenue growth in 4 years | $2T market size).
* Disrupt a massive market and help scale us to a $5B business in the next few years.
* Be immersed in a talent-dense environment and accelerate your career growth exponentially.
* Bring sharp visual craft and creative energy to Jerry's video output — from concept through final cut.

**About the Role**

At Jerry, we are redefining and radically improving how people manage car ownership, one of their most expensive and time-consuming assets. Backed by artificial intelligence and machine learning, Jerry simplifies and automates car ownership while providing personalized services tailored to all car owners' needs. We are the #1 rated and most downloaded app in our category with a 4.7-star rating in the App Store and more than 5 million customers — and we're just getting started.  
  
We're looking for a **Creative Director (Video)** with a strong visual eye and a genuine curiosity about performance creative. Someone who cares deeply about craft, moves fast, and is excited by how AI and new media are reshaping what great advertising looks like. You'll work closely with senior creative leads to concept, produce, and iterate video ads across TikTok, Meta, YouTube, and CTV — learning and contributing at every stage of the process.

**Why you will (or won't) like working here:**

**Large canvas:** You won't inherit a set-in-stone playbook. You'll have real creative input and contribute meaningfully to our brand foundation early in your career.

**Hands-on from day one:** This isn't a support role. You'll be concepting, editing, and iterating — using AI tools and your own creative instincts to ship work that performs.

**Car ownership is not "sexy":** Insurance, maintenance, and safety are only topics people think about when they have a bill to pay or a flat tire to change. Can you build enthusiasm and trust around a "dry" topic? That's the creative challenge here.

**What You'll Do**

* Concept and produce video creative across paid social, CTV, and emerging channels — working end-to-end from brief to delivery under the guidance of senior creative leads.
* Lead a small and nimble team
* Bring a sharp visual eye to every asset: elevating composition, pacing, and storytelling to raise Jerry's brand while keeping performance top of mind.
* Stay on top of platform trends, formats, and cultural shifts to ensure Jerry's creative stays fresh and effective.
* Develop hooks, angles, and visual frameworks rooted in what drives real performance — not just what looks good.
* Edit video directly: fluent in editing tools and comfortable cutting, iterating, and polishing ads at speed.
* Leverage AI tools (for ideation, scripting, editing, asset generation, etc.) to accelerate workflows and expand creative range.
* Collaborate closely with media, growth, and senior creative teammates to turn performance signals into stronger creative work.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years in video creative, art direction, or production — at a performance agency, in-house growth team, or content studio.
* A growing track record contributing to video creative for paid channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, CTV, etc.).
* Strong visual instincts — you have an eye for design, composition, pacing, and brand quality.
* Video editing fluency — you can cut and iterate ads yourself, making them feel polished without heavy direction.
* Performance creative curiosity — you understand (or are actively learning) what makes people stop scrolling: hooks, pacing, CTAs.
* Collaborative and eager mindset — comfortable in fast-paced environments and open to feedback from creative and analytics teams alike.
* AI fluency — you experiment with generative tools to speed up production and expand what's creatively possible.
* Bonus: exposure to both performance and brand creative contexts. You're building a point of view on how craft and conversion can coexist.

description:

We build technology that increases access and independence for sellers, individuals, and artists around the world. Working at Block means working on and across our brands—Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Spiral, and Proto— in roles that connect, enable, and push all of them forward faster.

We’re remote-first by design and operate with intelligence at the center of everything we do. At Block, you'll be challenged by some of the brightest, most creative minds in the industry and have the tools and autonomy to do the most meaningful work of your career.

#### **The Role**

Block’s in-house creative team builds the brand platforms and campaigns behind Cash App, Square, and Afterpay. We’re hiring a creative director for experiential, spatial design, and activations to originate ideas that bring our brands into the world and lead them from concept through production and execution. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you’ll shape the brief alongside creative strategy, lead project teams, and set the creative standard for experiences that connect with people and culture.

**You will**

* Originate distinctive experiential, spatial design, and activation ideas across Block brands, creating new ways for people to encounter and connect with them.
* Own complex projects independently, from the first concept through production and execution. Stay hands-on and protect the idea through the details of the finished experience.

* Present creative work to senior stakeholders, explain your decisions, and navigate feedback while preserving what makes the work distinctive.
* Work with agencies as an extension of the team, developing ideas and shaping the work together rather than handing off a brief.

* Works with art and copy teams as needed at job initiation, prior to internal reviews, to ensure creative development is on track and in keeping with project brief deliverables.

* Oversees development of concept once from original idea through to execution and tactical pull through

  + On brand: Aligns with current brand standards
  + On strategy: Aligns with current creative brief and client-provided documentation
  + Clear, compelling, and stylish

* Demonstrates a thorough understanding of the brand narrative, key messages and data along with the ability to verbally communicate it internally and to clients
* Ensures internal understanding of brand narrative as needed

* Engages in strategic conversations with client
* Represents creative team with another senior representative of the agency (account, strategy)

* Promotes, when appropriate, other agency services to established clients (planning, interactive)
* Assumes a role in new business pitches

* Develops sound understanding of agency experience and full range of agency capabilities
* Is clear and consistent in direction and is a role model for the rest of his/her team in terms of work ethic and dependability
* Works cross-departmentally as needed to bring solutions to team that moves projects forward
* Reviews portfolios, interviews candidates and works toward the growth of the department and the larger organization

* Education: Bachelor's degree or above required
* Work Experience: 7+ years in advertising required; healthcare (device/pharmaceutical) focus preferred

* Verbal and written communication
* Original content creation
* Content organization

* Incredible prowess with verbal and written communication
* Proven ability to ingest client-provided story, then elevate and present back to them
