title: VP, Associate Creative Director, Art
description:
**About Us**

At **BGBx**, we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.

Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.

If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx.

**Position Overview**

The VP, ACD, Art is responsible for providing direct support to the Creative Director, particularly in the areas of creative presentation, client relations, and team creative oversight. The group art supervisor must possess superior visual conceptual skills and knowledge of pharmaceutical requirements/terminology and vendor requirements/capabilities. The depth of the position demands qualifications developed over a minimum of 7 years of related graphic and supervisory experience.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Establish credibility with clients at all levels through advanced thinking via clear communication

* Helps establish and maintain the highest possible standards of reproduction for all digital, print, audio/visual and collateral materials produced by the agency

* Monitors the quality of finished mechanical/digital art and conceptual materials produced by internal and freelance artists

* Provides direction and guidance to department subordinates

* Informs and advises the Creative Director on the status of departmental affairs, including all design-related computer hardware/software needs (upgrades, equipment needs/problems, training, etc.)

* Encourages the professional development of department staff

* Ensures the efficient visual execution of creative concepts according to a prime account responsibility list or by management's assignment

* Consults with the Creative Director, as well as account service, traffic and other agency team members as necessary to achieve agency objectives

* Observes agency consensus in the production of client presentation materials, either conceptual or finished art

* Examines and approves finished art and conceptual material, and supervises the alteration or correction of such material

* Maintains a current list of available freelance artists, web designers, art and photography stock houses, photographers and other contributory talent and vendors

* Recommends and directs freelance contributors

* Engages in any personal development necessary to stay current in advertising techniques and standards, and research activity required to become more familiar with clients' businesses

* Meets established deadlines or provides reasonable notice to the Creative Director of special circumstances requiring deadline extension

* Liaises with the Creative Director in assigning necessary vendor overtime needed to meet any overload demand

* Consults with Creative Director and agency services manager regarding staffing needs
* Performs occasional additional duties as deemed appropriate by the Creative Director

**Desired Skills and Experience**

* A Bachelor of Fine Arts degree and a minimum of 7 years of related medical education, pharmaceutical advertising experience

* Fantastic presentation and communication skills

* Excellent supervisory and management skills

* Demonstrated organizational, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills

* Excellent judgment and decision-making skills

* Excellent design skills, including a highly developed overall design aptitude as well as typography, color, photography, and art

* Excellent computer skills, especially as they apply to desktop design including advanced proficiency in the following Adobe applications: Acrobat, InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator; as well as an understanding of Flash, HTML, and Aftereffects. Proficient in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

* Ability to prioritize workflow and redirect agency projects to meet competing and changing deadlines
* Team player with excellent interpersonal skills

**Salary Range:** $170,000 - $200,000

**What We Offer**

At BGBx, we invest in our people because exceptional talent drives exceptional work. We provide a competitive rewards package designed to support your health, well-being, professional growth, and life outside of work.

Our benefits package typically includes health care insurance, retirement plans, generous paid time off and holidays, wellness benefits, life insurance, learning and development opportunities, and other resources that support our employees throughout their careers. Additional benefits may be available based on your location. Beyond benefits, you'll find a culture built on collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on healthcare and the people it serves.

*BGBx is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status or any category or class of person protected by law.*

title: Creative Director - Design, Enterprise Marketing (Remote)
description:

With $90 billion in assets, and a $9.7 billion market cap, we are a leader in the U.S. banking industry. Throughout seven unique affiliated bank brands who welcome clients at 400 local branches across the West, Zions Bancorporation is committed to business and commercial banking because we believe that businesses are the cornerstone of thriving communities. Together with consumer banking, wealth services, and robust banking products and services, we are known for our exceptional service and deep local roots.
  
  
Today, we are shaping the future of banking—leveraging innovation, strengthening local relationships, sharpening sector expertise, and delivering exceptional value across our family of great banks.
  
  
Our newly founded enterprise Marketing team is a transformative organization that puts an in-house Creative Studio arm-in-arm with data, insights, strategy, tech, and governance teams to evolve and elevate how we tell our story and connect with clients. This is a collaborative hub for meaningful and holistic brand-building, bold ideas, and breakthrough campaigns.
  
  
Now, we are adding the role of Creative Director for a new digital banking platform to our team.
  
  
As the organization continues to grow, this key position offers the opportunity to help shape not only a rapidly scaling digital banking brand, but also the future of modern marketing across the enterprise.
  
  
Designed to move nimbly into the future and transcend our footprint while leveraging the Zions Bancorporation foundation of strength and stability.
  
  
This role combines the energy and influence of a high-growth business with the resources, stability, and support of a leading financial institution.
  
  
The platform has successfully launched and is now actively adding new clients offering a unique opportunity for a dynamic, creative leader with bright, modern ideas and deep chops in brand design to help build the identity of one of the fastest-growing areas of the organization
  
  
The Creative Director - Design (Enterprise Marketing) will deliver innovative design and creative direction that prioritize innovation while balancing business goals with brand integrity. They will be a culturally savvy self-starter and systems-thinker who uses data and insights to create compelling, conversion-focused work that positions us as a leader in digital-forward business banking.
  
  
Initially, this position will lead and execute design and creative leadership within a small, discreet startup team, working directly with leadership, and aligning with Creative Studio executive leaders at regular intervals to ensure holistic brand alignment.
  
  
While entrepreneurial in spirit, this is not a ground-floor build from scratch. The platform is established, operating in market, and supported by an expanding Enterprise Marketing organization. The Creative Director will partner closely with an existing designer and writer who support the platform's marketing efforts, providing creative guidance and direction while benefiting from the broader capabilities and resources of the Enterprise Marketing team.
  
  
Primary Function
  

* Act as a leader in the creative visioning, stewardship, and hands-on design of the platform’s brand and its marketing approach.
* Deliver creative strategy and design of brand assets, guidelines, and marketing campaigns that will strengthen client trust and drive measurable results across digital, print, physical, and in-person experiences.
* Collaborate with performance marketing teams and other organizations to optimize creative for ROI, conversion, and sustainment.
* Leverage client insights, campaign performance data, and market learnings to evolve the brand and create increasingly effective client experiences as the business scales.

Leadership and Team Development
  

* Provide creative leadership and mentorship across a designer and writer while fostering strong collaboration with performance marketing, content, strategy, and enterprise creative partners. (more may be added)
* Regularly connect with and seek direction from Creative Studio.
* Act as an evangelist for the platform’s brand and its application throughout the enterprise.
* Demonstrate expert level skills in design tools, methodologies, and production processes, and coach junior members toward the same, fostering a culture of excellence.
* Establish creative workflows that enhance efficiency and productivity.
* Maintain an extensive network of creative resources for freelance and recruiting. Help shape the future growth of the platform's creative capabilities as the organization continues to expand.

Brand Building and Stewardship
  

* Establish robust brand identity systems that work across many channels, ensuring quality and brand integrity across all touchpoints.
* Balance innovative approaches with regulatory requirements and financial industry standards.
* Develop creative solutions that resonate with small business owners and business decision- makers, helping strengthen client trust and differentiate the brand in a competitive digital banking landscape.

Data-Driven Innovation
  

* Use performance data and testing insights to refine creative strategies.
* Track and forecast marketing trends, technologies, and best practices.

Vendor and Partner Collaboration
  

* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders, external agencies, and production vendors to ensure quality and cost efficiency.
* Maintain a knowledge of regulatory requirements and ensure application of best practices to avoid risk for the organization and ensure clarity for clients.
* Operate with organizational savvy in a collaborative, productive manner.
* Partner effectively across a matrixed organization, influencing stakeholders and building alignment while maintaining speed and creative excellence.

QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Bachelor's degree or master's degree in design and minimum 8 years of experience in graphic design, interactive, advertising, media, UX, and/or related fields.
* Strong visual, written, and oral presentation skills
* Preferred: experience in banking, fintech, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
* Preferred: experience developing creative and marketing programs that support small business acquisition, engagement, and growth.
* E xperience building brands in growth-stage environments is highly valued.

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION
  
This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $115,000 - $175,000 annually depending on job-related factors such as level of experience and location.
  
  
This opportunity can be located across the Zions Bancorporation Footprint or 100% remote within the United States.

title: Associate Creative Director
description:
World Vision is hiring an Associate Creative Director to serve in the Marketing Division.
  
  
AT A GLANCE
  
**Role:** Associate Creative Director
  
**Reports to:** Senior Creative Director
  
**Location:** Remote
  
**Required Experience:** In addition to education or equivalent experience, requires at least 8 years of progressively responsible creative experience. Experience in an advertising agency or a high-performing in-house creative team is required.
  
**Preferred Experience:** Prior people-management experience is preferred. Experience with digital-first marketing, direct response, testing and optimization, and responsible use of AI-enabled creative tools is strongly preferred.
  
**Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S.A for any employer.
  
**Travel:** Up to 10% of the time.
  
**Estimated hiring range:** 104,200 - 151,590
  
  
THE JOB
  
Lead creative development, storytelling, and brand expression within World Vision’s internal advertising agency. Partner with senior leadership to translate fundraising and audience strategies into integrated, multichannel campaigns, with an emphasis on writing and messaging. Guide assigned team members, set priorities, and oversee quality and delivery to strengthen brand awareness and produce measurable results. Carry out World Vision’s Christian mission, vision, and strategies, witnessing to Christ and ministering to others through life, deed, word and sign.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  

* Keep Christ central in individual and corporate life. Actively participate in and contribute to the spiritual disciplines of the organization (Christian conduct, chapel, prayer, worship, devotions and leadership of devotions); incorporate WV Core Values into decisions within scope of role.
* Lead assigned brand and fundraising campaigns from strategic brief through final delivery, translating audience insight and organizational objectives into integrated creative concepts, messaging, and multichannel experiences.
* Serve as the lead creative and conceptual partner for assigned work, developing campaign narratives, concepts, messaging frameworks, calls to action, and creative solutions across direct response, digital, social, video, experiential, print, email, web, and emerging platforms.
* Establish project-level creative direction, goals, priorities, and quality expectations for assigned writers, designers, freelance partners, and cross-disciplinary teams; monitor progress and resolve difficult but typically non-complex execution, resource, and stakeholder issues.
* Review work in progress and final deliverables for strategic alignment, brand voice, creative quality, accuracy, accessibility, channel requirements, budget, and timelines; provide clear, actionable feedback and approve work within delegated authority.
* Partner with peers, the Senior Creative Director, and cross-functional partners to clarify briefs, align expectations, allocate resources, and deliver cohesive creative solutions.
* Present creative concepts and rationale to clients and senior stakeholders, synthesize feedback, and guide the team toward effective solutions.
* Supervise assigned professional employees and creative personnel, including setting goals and objectives, assigning work, coaching performance, supporting development, and contributing to talent decisions.
* Support a client-centric in-house agency model through strong service standards, collaboration, processes, and consistent policies.
* Use performance data, audience feedback, testing results, and emerging tools to improve work.
* Maintain awareness of corporate goals, objectives, organizational announcements, and activities. Reference and follow organizational policies and procedures, seeking clarity as needed.

YOU BRING THESE SKILLS
  

* Creative thinking, storytelling, concept development, and strong oral and written communication, including fluent English and persuasive messaging that motivates donors and prospects.
* Advanced marketing and branding knowledge and graphic design fundamentals, supported by fundraising knowledge and an understanding of global events and World Vision’s mission and priorities.
* Strategic orientation and planning: Translating organizational goals into creative strategies and practical short- and long-range plans across work units.
* Implementation and project management: build production plans, identify resources, balance competing priorities, and manage milestones, costs, and delivery.
* Team building, people management, collaboration, and relationship building set clear expectations, develop team members, and build strong internal and external partnerships.
* Customer-focused solution design, initiative, adaptability, and quality orientation: respond to changing needs, solve problems proactively, and improve processes and creative work.

REQUIREMENTS
  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (8 years). In addition to education or equivalent experience, requires at least 8 years of progressively responsible creative experience. Experience in an advertising agency or a high-performing in-house creative team is required. Prior people-management experience is preferred. A portfolio demonstrating strong creative thinking, concept development, and campaign effectiveness is required. Experience with digital-first marketing, direct response, testing and optimization, and responsible use of AI-enabled creative tools is strongly preferred.
  
  
SALARY & BENEFITS
  
**WVUS Pay Grade Level:** 228
  
**Estimated hiring range:** 104,200 - 151,590
  
  
The posted hiring salary range reflects pay for U.S. locations and is determined using market data and internal compensation guidelines. Actual compensation may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, and applicable laws. For information about World Vision U.S' comprehensive benefits package, please visit this link.
  
  
ABOUT WORLD VISION
  
We're a global Christian humanitarian organization. We partner with children, families, and their communities to empower them as they reach their full potential by tackling the causes of poverty and injustice. For 75 years, World Vision has followed Jesus' example to show unconditional love to the poor and oppressed. We serve every child regardless of faith.
  
  
**L.I.F.E. LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:**  
The LIFE Leadership Competencies provide a shared framework for Christ-centered leadership at World Vision. They define the skills, behaviors, and character qualities that help leaders lead faithfully and effectively, shaping how we hire, develop, and evaluate leaders to cultivate thriving teams and greater Kingdom impact.
  
  

* Love: How we show up every day, every interaction. Loving others the way Jesus loves—with humility, care, and grace-filled truth. We build trust. We model life with God. And we create environments where people feel seen, valued, and supported, because we see the image of our God in each of them.
* Ignite: How we unlock and catalyze. To Ignite is to unlock purpose, passion, and potential—so people can bring their best in service of children and donors. We build healthy, thriving teams and develop character, competence, and courage.
* Fulfill: How We Deliver. To Fulfill is to focus on what matters most—and deliver with excellence and accountability. We own outcomes. We prioritize mission-critical work. And we partner with God to produce results that advance Kingdom impact.
* Envision: How we change and evolve towards ‘Better’. To Envision is to lead boldly into the future—discerning what’s ahead with faith, navigating complexity, and casting vision that leads to lasting impact.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?

We also encourage you to submit a PDF resume and a cover letter. Our goal is to fill this vacancy with the right person in the shortest amount of time.

title: Art Director, Motion and Brand
description:
### **About PrePass**

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

### **About the Role**

The PrePass marketing team is tasked with expanding the PrePass brand. We are energized by the prospect of breaking ground in our field and making a positive impact within the transportation industry. We are looking for an Art Director, Motion and Brand, with strong design, motion, and animation fundamentals and a passion for visual storytelling. This person not only values great craftsmanship but also knows how to turn complex products and ideas into clear, compelling video and animation that share the PrePass story and purpose with our customers.

As the Art Director, Motion and Brand, you'll work with the Senior Art Director, the Director of Marketing Comms, and the larger Marketing team to bring the PrePass brand to life in motion. You'll own video and animated content for performance marketing campaigns, product launches, social, web, and events, with secondary responsibility for digital design across email, social, landing pages, and other channels. This role requires strong organizational and communication skills to manage multiple projects, timelines, and deliverables.

### **Essential Responsibilities**

### **Video, Motion, and Animation**

* Conceptualize, storyboard, and produce video and animated content for social, web, email, paid media, webinars, and trade show screens.
* Create product explainers, animated demos, and short-form videos that make complex solutions—toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety—easy to understand.
* Design and animate 2D motion graphics, kinetic typography, illustrated animation, and animated data visualizations.
* Edit and finish video from raw footage, including pacing, sound design, music selection, captioning, and color correction.
* Support video shoots, customer testimonials, and event coverage, from shot lists to final edit.
* Build animated brand elements, including logo animations, lower thirds, transitions, and title sequences.
* Develop motion guidelines and reusable templates that keep video and animated content consistent and on-brand.

### **Brand and Creative Support**

* Design marketing assets, including emails, social graphics, landing pages, web banners, and paid ads.
* Create supporting collateral and assets for campaigns and events, such as video thumbnails, ad variations, and presentation graphics.
* Extend the PrePass visual brand identity consistently across video, motion, and digital channels.
* Generate strong conceptual ideas aligned with strategic business goals.
* Clearly articulate creative rationale, concepts, and visual direction to key stakeholders.
* Contribute to all phases of the creative process: research, brainstorming, scripts, storyboards, animatics, style frames, and final production.

### **Collaboration and Tools**

* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional internal teams and external vendors.
* Use design and production tools such as Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, and Asana, along with generative AI tools such as Adobe Firefly and Google Flow, to speed up ideation and production.
* Prepare and optimize files for each channel, including aspect ratios, file sizes, and accessibility standards.

### **Project Execution**

* Manage day-to-day workflow while meeting deadlines across multiple initiatives.
* Support marketing events such as webinars, trade shows, and product launches with motion and design assets.
* Stay current on design, animation, and video trends and bring fresh ideas to the team.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Qualifications/Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in design, motion graphics, and animation, gained at an agency, startup, or in-house team.
* A portfolio and reel that showcase polished video editing, motion graphics, animation, and strong design fundamentals—including typography, layout, color, and composition.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, plus Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions through a strategic business lens.
* A self-starter who takes full ownership of design projects, both large and small.
* Strong prioritization skills with the ability to manage timelines across multiple initiatives.
* Based in the United States.

### **Bonus Points For**

* B2B marketing experience, especially translating technical products into clear visual stories.
* Experience with 3D tools (Cinema 4D, Blender), AI-assisted design and video tools, or Lottie/web animation.
* Knowledge of the transportation, logistics, or fleet management industry.
* Availability in Mountain Standard Time or West Coast time zones.
  

  
  
**Benefits**  

### **How We Will Take Care of You**

* Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
* Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
* 401(k) plan with employer match.
* Company-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships).
* Tuition Reimbursement Program.
* Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.
* Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).
* Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
* Community Give-Back initiatives.
* Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

**Join Us**

**At PrePass, our mission drives us.**

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

**Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.**

Reporting to the Director of Brand Marketing, you will collaborate with Brand, Growth, E-Commerce, Retention, Retail, Experiential, Product Development, and Supply Chain to ensure creative builds brand recognition, communicates product value, and supports business goals.

* Experience in beauty, haircare, skincare, wellness, or consumer packaged goods is strongly preferred. Experience supporting social commerce, particularly TikTok Shop, is strongly preferred. Ability to direct video and motion work is required; hands-on motion design or video editing is a plus.

* Play a pivotal role in a high-growth, high-impact brand with national reach
* Directly support strategic initiatives and help shape scalable infrastructure

* Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency

**WHAT YOU OFFER**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
* Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

**Business Acumen**

* Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
* Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions
* You think like an owner and make decisions with financial impact in mind

**AI & Tools**

* Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
* Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
* Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
* Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

**What Success Looks Like:**

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.

Within six months, you're running the department with full confidence — driving creative quality, owning margin targets, making smart resourcing decisions, and positioning Performance Design as a competitive differentiator in new business conversations.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $160,000-$185,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.

We accommodate global candidates in markets where Directive has established business operations, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. title: Design Director, Brand
description:
**About AlphaSense**
AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
  
  
**Location:**
New York or San Francisco preferred, open to remote within the US
  
  
**About The Team**
The AlphaSense Brand Team is a creative powerhouse composed of great talent across copywriting, brand design, advertising & filmmaking. This team of creative technologists help drive the innovation, conceptual storytelling, execution & delivery of our brand and products each & every day. At our core, we're here as a partner to the broader business – which we do by identifying customer problems, understanding market needs, & inventing ways to deliver world class brand experiences.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the
**Design Director**
on the AlphaSense Brand & Creative team, you own the strategic and conceptual pull-through of our brand — translating who AlphaSense is into ideas, design systems, and experiences that show up everywhere the company does. You set the creative vision and the standard of craft for the design discipline, and you're a leader-doer: you direct from inside the work, getting your hands on it when an idea demands it. This is a defining moment for the brand. As the market shifts from an information economy to a reasoning economy, it's racing toward a shortcut — assuming that wiring a model up to more tools and more sources adds up to intelligence. AlphaSense exists to prove otherwise: access isn't intelligence, and the question that matters isn't “Can it connect?” but “Can I trust it?” You'll be the one who makes that argument — connected isn't intelligent — look and feel as undeniable as the platform makes it true.
  
  
This role is equal parts vision and craft, leadership and making. You'll shape the creative direction for our most significant brand investments — campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — then build the team and systems that let that work scale without losing its edge. You'll mentor and grow the design team alongside the Design Manager, while partnering across PMM, Product, Web, and Comms, and directing agency and production partners, to align stakeholders behind brave ideas. Your north star: take the highest-stakes ideas in enterprise intelligence — trust, evidence, judgment under pressure — and make them clear, human, and impossible to ignore.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A Proven Creative Leader: 10+ years in brand and creative design, with a portfolio that shows range across campaigns, brand systems, and high-craft execution — and a track record of leading teams to do the best work of their careers.
* A Leader-Doer: You set the vision and the bar, but you stay in the work. You direct from inside it and get hands-on when an idea needs your hand — not from a distance.
* Ideas-First: You lead with concept. You can take an abstract, technical idea — like enterprise market intelligence — and find the visual metaphor that makes it land for a sophisticated audience.
* A Builder of Teams & Culture: You've managed and mentored designers (including through other managers), shaped roles, grown careers, and cultivated a creative culture of transparency, connectedness, and inspiration.
* A Systems Thinker: You think in systems and scale — building design languages and ways of working that keep the brand consistent as it grows while still leaving room to surprise.
* A Trusted Cross-Functional Partner: You build deep relationships across PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms, influence senior stakeholders, and can win support and alignment for ambitious, high-stakes work.
* Fluent in Complex & Enterprise Storytelling: You've made technical, B2B, or otherwise “dry” subject matter feel anything but boring, ideally for expert or executive audiences.
* Strategically Grounded: You balance creative ambition with clarity, strategy, and business outcomes, and you thrive in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities and a fair amount of ambiguity.

**What You’ll Do**

* Help Drive the Design Vision: Define and evolve the creative direction for the AlphaSense brand across campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — ensuring a cohesive, elevated, unmistakably-AlphaSense expression at every touchpoint.
* Lead Idea-Centric Work: Drive the strategic and conceptual pull-through of big ideas from brief through execution, setting the bar for craft and originality on our most visible, highest-stakes brand investments.
* Hands-On: The team is lean, so using your own design thinking and execution to make the work when the moment calls for it is imperative — you direct from inside the work, not from a distance.
* Build & Grow the Team: Lead, mentor, and develop the brand design team in partnership with the Design Manager — shaping roles, raising the craft bar, growing careers, and keeping morale and creative culture high.
* Partner Across Functions: Build deep, productive relationships across creative functions (copy, art direction, production, film) as well as marketing functions (PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms) and lead agency and production partners when the time calls for it — aligning stakeholders and securing support to move ambitious work forward.
* Evolve the System: Develop and steward the AlphaSense design system and visual language so the brand scales with consistency while still leaving room to surprise.
* Push Product Integration: Find innovative ways to bring the product into the brand story, demonstrating the full creative potential of the platform.
* Develop Deep Product & Market Fluency: Build a thorough understanding of the AlphaSense platform, our customers, and the broader B2B enterprise landscape so the work reflects real product value, use cases, and buyer context — not just surface-level aesthetics.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.
  
  
You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.
  
  
Base Compensation Range
  
  
$160,000—$200,000 USD
  
  
AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
  
  
In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
  
  
Recruiting Scams and Fraud
  
  
We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note

* All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
* If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

Robotics Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

**The role**
------------

As a Robotics Mechancial Engineer, you will play a key role in the design and development of our robots. You will be responsible for creating robust and efficient mechanical mechanisms, assemblies, and systems that integrate with advanced robotic technologies. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, bringing together expertise in mechanical, electrical, and software engineering.

**The day-to-day**
------------------

* Design and develop mechanisms, systems, and electromechanical assemblies for robotic applications, including structures, actuators, and motion systems.
* Collaborate closely with the electrical and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of mechanical designs into complete robotic systems.
* Prototype, test, and iterate on mechanical designs to meet performance, cost, and manufacturability requirements.
* Analyze project specifications, materials, and manufacturing methods to ensure that designs meet both functional and production objectives.
* Use CAD tools (SolidWorks) to create detailed designs, 3D models, and engineering drawings.
* Participate in design reviews, contributing innovative solutions and improvements.
* Conduct simulations, stress analysis, and FEA to ensure reliability, durability, and safety of the designs.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting during product development and manufacturing processes.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in robotics and mechanical design to incorporate cutting-edge technologies into our products.

**You should apply if you**
---------------------------

* Hold a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (Master's preferred).
* Have demonstrated of experience in mechanical design, preferably in robotics or automation.
* Are proficiency with CAD software (ideally SolidWorks).
* Have a strong understanding of mechanical principles, including statics, dynamics, and material properties.
* Have experience with FEA, simulations, and mechanical stress analysis tools.
* Have hands-on experience with prototyping and testing.
* Are familiar with manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal manufacturing and injection molding.
* Have excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and within a team.
* Have strong communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
* Have experience with robotics, automation, or mechatronics systems is highly desirable.

**Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

* Helsing's work is important. You'll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn't work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Competitive salary** and **VSOP options**
* **Relocation support**: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation
* **Learning**: €500/£450 yearly allowance
* **Health & wellness**: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)
* **Social**: regular company events and monthly social allowances
* **Enhanced parental leave**: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers
* **Family support:** 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work
* A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled "Infraduction"), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one (Specifically for engineering and AI)

*These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.*

title: Senior Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe
description:
**About the Role**

Teach For All is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to support a diverse group of network and prospective partner organizations in the Europe region and to lead regional work on public sector partnerships. As a Senior Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe, you will steward Teach For All's engagement with a group of partner organizations in the Europe region, working to build and deepen relationships and collaboration in pursuing educational equity in Europe. In this role you will act as a strategic advisor to partner organizations, diagnosing needs and opportunities, consulting on strategic challenges, and mobilizing network resources to drive collective impact

In this position, you will also play a critical role in strengthening partner organizations'public sector partnerships through targeted support around institutional relations strategy development and execution in key countries in Europe. You will work closely with global team members to build more active partner connections and collaboration with their governments (Ministries of Education at national, regional or local levels; regional and local authorities; Universities and research institutions), by developing specific partner support initiatives, contributing to Erasmus+ projects, and designing learning experiences and ad-hoc resources when needed. The ideal candidate for this position will have a proven ability to work effectively across diverse contexts and cultures, navigating ambiguity with ease, and will have experience making sound strategic decisions that drive impact in complex and changing environments.

This role provides an exceptional opportunity for an individual with superior leadership, strategic, interpersonal, and programmatic skills to increase the impact of our mission and shape the education landscape in the region. The strongest candidates will have a proven ability to set a clear vision, build culture and relationships, influence outcomes through others, and make strategic decisions that drive meaningful impact. A strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion is essential.

The ideal candidate will have a deep familiarity of living and working in Europe, must reside and be authorized to work in the region, speak English and ideally one additional regional language. The Director- Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe will report to the Head of Partner Engagement & Program - Europe and work closely with the Head of Region, Europe on external positioning and advocacy.

**Outcomes**

* Regional partner organizations are highly engaged with each other and the network and are dedicated to our mission and values, and to contributing to progress towards Teach For All's vision and intended outcomes, as measured by the annual network survey.
* Partner organizations in the region are better supported to develop and implement new, innovative and forward looking public sector partnerships that enable them to scale their programmes and increase their impact in the education system.
* There is growth in aggregate progress across the region, as demonstrated by relevant measures for the intended outcomes:

* Our network is expanding in the region.
* Collective leadership is strengthening within the communities and countries of network partners.
* Students in our classrooms are developing holistically as leaders who can shape a better future.
* Our network staff members, teachers, and alumni are a deeply interconnected, learning regional and global community.
* Insights from our network inform the regional understanding of what will drive progress for marginalized children.
* Strengthened relationships with regional program stakeholders in the region generating new opportunities for impact and influence. Support the growing impact of alumni in the region as leaders in schools and the education ecosystem.

**Key responsibilities:**

Partner Support (40%)

* As a "portfolio lead," serve as the primary day-to-day relationship holder with a portfolio of current and prospective partner organization CEOs, cultivating relationships to build positive, long-term partnerships as a means to achieving shared and mutually beneficial goals and outcomes.
* Co-create and manage the implementation of an annual partnership plan with each organization in the Network Engagement Director's portfolio, identifying how Teach For All will support them and how they will contribute back to the network on an ongoing basis. This plan will include the strategic engagement of other colleagues, teams and resources from across Teach For All.
* Share insights, ask thoughtful questions, and provide support to partner and prospective partner organization CEOs and their leadership teams, to build their capacity, advance strategic clarity and impact, and foster learning and sharing across the network, in line with Teach For All's shared global vision and priorities.

Public Sector Support (50 %)

* Work directly with CEOs and Head of Institutional Relationships in each partner organization to develop strong public sector strategies and action plans to identify new champions in government and identify new ways of partnering with the public sector to increase their ability to scale their programmes and increase their impact by leveraging regional, national and multinational opportunities
* Leveraging deep understanding of the educational landscape, develop and execute on strategies that build external champions and elevate awareness of our programmatic work in Ministries of Education and Ministries of Labour and Social Welfare, Regional and Local governments, and Universities across the region.
* Continue to build more capacity across the region, in both partner organizations and Teach For All to develop and manage stronger public sector relationships in pursuit of sustainability and scale of our work in Europe
* Facilitate meaningful learning experiences for partner organizations in the region, virtual and in-person when possible, such as immersive experiences and peer-to-peer visits for network partner organizations and emerging social entrepreneurs, fostering collaboration, culture, and connection in line with our broader network vision and values.
* Lead initiatives and strategies on region wide and global priorities to contribute to progress against our network intended outcomes.
* Co-build public sector partnership collaboration and learning across the region and globally.
* Support leadership development of key stakeholders in the region from alumni and senior partner staff through coaching and leadership development experiences

Contribute to Teach For All globally (10%)

* Work with the other global teams to contribute to global priorities and initiatives in particular in relation to our leadership development and program strategies
* Represent the global organization as needed at external opportunities

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience & Track Record: Minimum 10 years of professional experience, including demonstrable success leading senior-level public sector partnerships and navigating complex government or education systems across Europe.
* Contextual & Geographic Mastery: Deep familiarity with living and working within the European sociopolitical landscape, with current legal authorization to live and work long-term in an eligible hiring country.
* Strategic Systems Thinking: Proven ability to analyze educational landscapes, navigate bureaucratic systems, and design actionable public partnership strategies that achieve scale and sustainability.
* Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional interpersonal and political acumen, with a track record of building trusted relationships with senior leaders, government ministers, and diverse community stakeholders.
* Adaptive Leadership: Demonstrated experience navigating ambiguity, leading through influence across matrixed and cross-border teams without formal authority, and making sound decisions in complex environments.
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: Demonstrated commitment to DEI principles, with deep self-awareness and the ability to navigate racial, cultural, ideological, and power dynamics across countries.
* Linguistic Capability: Professional fluency in written and spoken English, paired with strong, professional-level communication skills.

**Additional Desirable Skills / Experiences**

* Fluency or professional working proficiency in French or an additional European language.
* Direct professional experience working inside schools, school networks, or national education ministries.
* Formal executive or leadership coaching experience supporting senior executives and social entrepreneurs.
* Prior hands-on experience designing or managing EU-funded programs (e.g., Erasmus+ projects).
* Familiarity with the Teach For All network model and theory of systemic change.

**What Teach For All Offers:**

* Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization's progress
* Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
* Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
* Generous time off and flexible work arrangements

* And much more!

**Application Instructions**

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Therefore, candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

Work authorization

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

**Compensation**

Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

**Travel and Hours**

All work is delivered virtually. Up to 30% of travel may be required. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

**About Teach For All**

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations' under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All's global organization works to increase the network's impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

title: Global CS Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

**Why join us?**

Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success.

**The role**
============

Docplanner's Customer Success organisation serves hundreds of thousands of healthcare professionals across 13 markets, through several business units: Individual Doctors, Clinics, and our Practice Management Software (PMS) products. Each of them relies on the CRM to onboard, retain and grow customers efficiently.

This role leads the Global CS Ops team that designs those CRM processes. The team turns business goals into processes and tooling that improve churn, win rate and, above all, productivity, measured as more customers and MRR served per CS FTE.

You'll lead a team of 5 analysts, each owning one business unit or enabler: Individual Doctors, Clinics, PMS, and the tools integrated into the CRM (e.g. meetings and quality). You'll be the main point of contact for the countries' requests: deciding what matters, what doesn't, and saying no when needed.

We are close to finishing the migration of all CS teams from HubSpot to Salesforce with 100% of products in Salesforce expected by mid-2027. Your job is to land it, then make the most of Salesforce as our single CS platform, quantifying the gains and detecting the main opportunities to deliver more impact.

This is a role reporting to the Global Director of Customer Success Operations & Analytics.

**What you'll be doing**
========================

***Leading the CS Ops team***

* Manage and grow a team of 5 analysts, each owning a business unit or enabler; organise workload and keep a healthy pace using agile ways of working (sprints, backlog, clear intake)
* Coach analysts to grow in process design, Salesforce and stakeholder management; hold them accountable for business impact, not just tickets delivered
* Empower analysts to own their business unit end to end, to be proactive and keep processes consistent across units and markets

***Building a relationship with the countries***

* Be the go-to partner for local CS and RevOps teams across 13 markets, building trust through regular syncs, clear communication and follow-through
* Run a single, transparent intake for country requests so the team works on what matters and stakeholders know where their request stands
* Prioritise by business impact (churn, win rate, productivity, legal requirements) and push back with data when a request doesn't justify the effort
* Favour global, standard solutions over market-specific ones; challenge local deviations unless they're legally required or clearly worth it

***Designing CRM processes that move business results***

* Translate business goals from CS leadership into end-to-end CRM processes for onboarding, retention and expansion
* Define how success is measured for each process and follow up after go-live to confirm it delivered
* Drive productivity: automate manual work, simplify rep workflows and remove steps that don't add value

***Completing the HubSpot to Salesforce migration***

* Lead the team through the remaining migrations till mid-2027
* Protect the standard Salesforce setup during each migration: separate day-one blockers from post-go-live improvements, and manage change with local teams
* After the migration, shift the team's focus from migrating to optimising: using Salesforce's native capabilities to improve how CS works with a data-driven and measured KPIs approach.

***Partnering with the Salesforce and other tech teams***

* Be the main business counterpart of our internal Salesforce development team and of the other tech teams
* Bring well-scoped, prioritised requirements, and challenge solutions so they're built the Salesforce way: standard first, custom only when needed
* Plan delivery capacity with tech each quarter and keep stakeholders informed on what will and won't ship

**Who you'll work with**
========================

* **Local CS and RevOps teams across 13 markets**: your main source of requests and your main customers
* **Global-Local Coordinator** (main peer): helps you align needs and opportunities across all markets
* **Global CS Analytics team** (main peer): measures the impact of the processes your team designs
* **Internal Salesforce development team** (main tech partner), plus the other teams whose tools integrate into the CRM
* **Business leadership**: VP of Individual Doctors, VP of Clinics and the PMS business owners

**What you bring**
==================

* 7-10 years of professional experience, including 5+ in Revenue Operations, CS/Sales Operations or CRM process design, and 2+ years leading teams, ideally across multiple countries or business units
* Strong hands-on Salesforce experience: you understand objects, flows, automation and reporting well enough to design processes and challenge developers on the best solution. Salesforce Administrator or Consultant certification is a plus
* Proven track record of managing many stakeholders across countries or business units, with a reputation for building trust while saying no when needed
* Strong business judgement: you understand SaaS metrics (churn, MRR, win rate, productivity) and can tell which requests move them and which don't
* Experience prioritising a high-volume backlog of requests with a clear, data-backed framework
* Experience in CRM migrations or large CRM implementations, including change management with end users
* Comfortable working with data to size impact and measure results (reports, dashboards, SQL is a plus)
* Professional fluency in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus

***What makes you a fit***

* Relationship builder: local teams see you as a partner, not a gatekeeper, even when your answer is no
* Business-first: you start from the problem and its impact, not from the feature request
* Pragmatic prioritiser: you know what's important and what isn't, and you explain trade-offs clearly
* Strategic, structured thinker who breaks complex problems into logical parts and solves them at the root
* An owner with an entrepreneurial mindset: you own your team's work, results and everything in between
* Empowering leader: you set ambitious goals, give your team autonomy and hold them accountable
* AI-curious: you look for ways AI and automation can make CS teams more productive

***Extra advantage***

* Experience in tech companies, start-ups or SaaS, ideally with multi-country operations
* Experience with HubSpot, or with integrations between Salesforce and other tools
* No prior experience in healthcare required, but curiosity about it is

**What to Expect from Our Hiring Process**

title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
description:
### **About Hilo by Aktiia**

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

### **Role overview**

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

### **Core responsibilities**

### **Direction & Outcomes**

* Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
* Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

### **Design System & Prototyping**

* Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
* Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

### **Leadership & Collaboration**

* Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
* Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
* Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

 **Requirements**

### **Background & Experience**

### **Essential**

* Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
* 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
* Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
* High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
* Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
* Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
* Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
* Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
* A public portfolio website (required with your application).

### **Nice to Have**

* Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

### **How you work**

* AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
* Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
* Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
* Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
* Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
* Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

### **This isn't for you if**

* You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
* You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
* You'd rather list risks than own one.

### **How we hire**

* Recruiter screen (30 min)
* Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
* Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
* Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
* Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

### **What success looks like**

* You take something off our plate and it gets done.
* If it won't happen, you tell us first.
* You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
* You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
* The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

  
**Benefits**

### **What Makes You A Great Fit**

**At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:**

**Move the Needle** — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

**Move Fast, Learn, Refine** — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

**Team First** — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

### **Why Join Us?**

* Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
* Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
* Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
* Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
* Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

### **Ready to Move the Needle?**

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Lead Yaw Systems Mechanical Engineer
description:

The mechanical design engineer will primarily support the hydraulic + passive mechanical braking systems through the entire life cycle from conceptual design through detailed design and development, testing, qualification, manufacturing, and installed fleet support. The engineer will drive technical excellence and continuous improvement in the design, analysis, cost, and reliability of the components under their responsibility.

**Job Description**
===================

You will:

* Execute projects pertaining to new product introduction, new technology integration, and field issue resolution with a heavy focus on quality and reliability verified by physical testing
* Be responsible for designing yaw system components for wind turbines focusing on hydraulic pressure unit (HPU) systems, yaw bearings, yaw drives, and yaw brakes encompassing component design, system interaction, and system reliability
* Hold ownership of and drive lessons learned, best practices, and standardization into design related documentation such as design practices, drawings, and technical specifications
* Responsible for design, development of testing/validation plans to prove component function and reliability
* Provide innovative design solutions to meet aggressive timing, product cost, and reliability targets
* Ensure quality of new and revised drawings, BoMs, and specifications applying all GEV and industry processes, standards, and best practices
* Work cross functionally, developing strong relationships with quality teams, manufacturing engineers, sourcing, suppliers, field support, and others to improve product quality and first-time yield
* Support manufacturing, sourcing, and the field with issue resolution and quick corrective actions for design related causes (NCR, SDR, PAC)
* Drive quick, complete technical root cause analysis of field failures and identify design related corrective actions to prevent recurrence
* Identify and execute cost saving ideas and strategies
Drive efforts to introduce advanced technology, materials, manufacturing methods, new design tools/methods to advance the strategic position of yaw subsystem components  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Significant experience in mechanical analysis and design experience in industry
* Working knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and manufacturing
* Experience with 3D-CAD tools like Unigraphics / Siemens NX

* Excellent communication, project management, interpersonal, and presentation skills
* Proven ability to lead global projects with team members across cultural boundaries
* Ability to work under pressure and challenging conditions
* Established problem solving process knowledge and execution
* Strong desire and ability to drive improvement and change
* Fluent English written and spoken
* Ability to travel up to 10%
  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Working knowledge of Ansys or other finite element analysis tools
* Design experience working on components in the wind turbine yaw subsystem (yaw drives, yaw bearings, bolted joints, hydraulic + mechanical yaw braking systems)
* Experience with system design including interface definition, system stiffness, DFMEA, and design for manufacturability / installation / serviceability.

* Proven track record of collaborating with business product managers and suppliers/vendors to optimize component costs and influence purchasing strategy

==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

description:

Help us lead one of the world’s largest pharmaceutical companies. We are a world leader in plasma-derived medicines with a presence in more than 100 countries, and a growing global team of over 20.000 people. That’s why we need a **CAPEX & INVESTMENT TECHNICAL OF MANAGER** like you.

Responsible for establishing, governing, and executing the corporate Capital Expenditure framework across all global operations. This role oversees the entire investment lifecycle—from 5-year Long-Range Planning (LRP) and annual budgeting to monthly execution monitoring, post-investment benefit reviews, and asset capitalization. Acting as a strategic bridge between Executive Management, Corporate Finance, Engineering (GE), and Local Manufacturing Plants, this position ensures optimal capital allocation, strict financial control, and process excellence across all capital investment categories.

**What are your responsibilities:**

**Corporate Governance & Procedure Implementation**

1. Corporate Procedure Definition & Rollout: Design, update, and enforce the corporate procedure for monitoring major capital investments across all business units.

2. Stage-Gate Governance: Enforce mandatory Stage-Gate reviews (Gates 1 to 4) for major projects, ensuring technical and financial maturity before approving budget releases or Phase transitions.

3. Delegation of Authority (DOA) Enforcement: Administer the corporate approval matrix for investment authorization, supplements (AFE Overrun Requests), and contingency releases.

**Long-Range Planning (LRP) & Annual Budget Preparation**

1. Corporate 5-Year LRP Preparation: Lead the annual multi-year investment planning process (LRP), prioritizing candidate projects aligned with corporate strategic objectives and cash flow capabilities

2. Annual CAPEX Budgeting: Consolidate and build the annual global CAPEX budget, integrating inputs from Global Engineering, site-level operational teams, and executive stakeholders.

3. Capital Allocation & Cash Flow Alignment: Coordinate with Treasury and Corporate FP&A to align monthly cash-out trajectories with corporate liquidity limits.

**Monthly CAPEX Monitoring & Comprehensive Reporting as a complement of the financial report**

1. Global CAPEX Tracking from technical approach: Execute detailed monthly monitoring across all investment streams (Grifols Engineering, Local CAPEX, Master Projects)

2. Estimate at Completion (EAC) variances and track technical progress, identifying critical path delays or cost overruns.

3. Executive technical Dashboards & Reporting: Prepare monthly reporting packages and executive dashboards for the Investment Committee and Board of Directors.

**Global CAPEX Taxonomy & Strategic Categorization**

1. Capital Classification & Reclassification: Review, audit, and reclassify (if necessary) all global investment proposals into strategic buckets:

o Growth / Expansion: Revenue-generating or capacity expansion projects.

o Sustaining / Maintenance: Asset replacement, operational continuity, and

reliability.

o Compliance & Regulatory: EHS, quality, and regulatory mandatory standards. o Efficiency & Productivity: Cost reduction, automation, and operational improvement projects.

**Post-Investment Analysis & Asset Capitalization**

1. Post-Implementation Reviews (PIR): Conduct formal post-investment audits 12 to 24 months after commissioning to verify the delivery of Business Case promises (ROI, ramp-up speed, capacity, and OPEX savings).

2. Asset Capitalization Coordination: Partner with Corporate Accounting to ensure timely project closure and accurate asset capitalization (transfer from Construction in Progress - CIP to Fixed Assets), preventing delays in depreciation schedules.

3. CAPEX vs. OPEX Boundary Compliance: Enforce strict accounting rules on plant direct purchases to prevent misclassification of operational expenses as capital investments.

**Performance Metrics (KPIs) & Process Excellence**
