title: Customer Onboarding Engineer | Implementation Specialist (ES)
description:
#### **Welcome to Infraspeak.**

Our mission is simple: to transform facilities management with a **collaborative platform** that unifies every part of FM operations into one cohesive system — **enabling every stakeholder to Work as One**.

We go beyond traditional tools, eliminating fragmented systems in complex operations. Our platform ensures end-to-end collaboration across FM teams, processes and assets — with no silos, blind spots or overload.

**Born in Porto**, Portugal, we’re now a **global company** serving customers in **45+ countries** and backed by top investors. **But we’re just getting started**.

* We believe in ownership, collaboration, and meritocracy.
* We believe that only great teams build great products — and that includes our customers.
* We believe happiness is in the journey, not just the destination.

Above all, we are guided by our purpose: to ***Be a Source of a Good Life*** — for our customers, our team, and the broader community.

#### **What are we building**

We seek a senior, technically minded specialist to own the technical onboarding of our enterprise customers in the EMEA region. This is not an entry-level implementation role. You will join rollouts that span multi-site, often multi-country portfolios, with years of legacy data to migrate and an operations director who expects you to have the answer.

We want you if you have already fought these battles and know how to hold your ground with a demanding customer. We will train you on our product and our processes. We will not have time to teach you how to lead a workshop with senior stakeholders, push back on a requirement that won't scale, or carry a go-live under pressure. You will be the customer's technical authority, working alongside the Delivery Manager who owns governance and scope.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

**Solution Design:** Lead discovery workshops with the customer's operations, maintenance, and IT leads, and translate complex, multi-site operations into a configuration that scales.

**Technical Configuration:** Configure asset hierarchies, maintenance plans, SLAs, workflows and permissions for large, multi-site and multi-country portfolios.

**Data Migration:** Own the technical side of migrating data from legacy systems, from mapping and cleansing rules to validation and load, and hold the customer to the quality of what they hand over.

**Integrations:** Work with our Integrations team and the customer's IT to specify, test and validate integrations with ERPs and other enterprise systems.

**Training & Rollout:** Train users from administrators to field technicians, and plan phased rollouts across sites and regions.

**Pushback & Trade-offs:** Challenge requirements that don't scale, propose standard alternatives to customisation, and explain the trade-off to senior customer stakeholders with confidence.

**Technical Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve technical issues during implementation, and escalate to Product and Engineering with clear evidence when needed.

**Partnership with Delivery:** Work alongside the Delivery Manager, keeping them informed of technical risks, effort and dependencies so that scope and timeline decisions are made early.

**Documentation:** Produce configuration documentation that the customer and our Support team can rely on after go-live.

**Product Feedback:** Channel structured feedback from enterprise customers to Product and Engineering.

**Who are we looking for?**
---------------------------

**Spanish:** Native-level or fluent.

**English:** Business-level fluency. Non-negotiable.

**French:** A plus.

**Location:** Based in or near Barcelona, Spain, and available to travel to customer sites.

**Technical Background:** An engineering background (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical) or substantial hands-on experience in facilities or maintenance management.

**Enterprise Implementation Experience:** A proven track record in customer-facing B2B SaaS implementation roles, including large, multi-site enterprise rollouts delivered end to end.

**Seniority & Composure:** At ease leading workshops with operations directors and IT leads, and steady when a go-live is under pressure.

**Courage:** Willing to say no to a customer, defend a design decision and raise a problem on the day you see it.

**Data Migration:** Hands-on experience migrating and cleansing large datasets from legacy systems.

**Software Proficiency:** Experience with CMMS, EAM or field-service platforms is a significant plus, as is familiarity with APIs and integrations.

**Autonomy:** Able to run your workstream independently within weeks. We will train you on product and processes, not on how to operate at this level.

**Communicator & Educator:** Able to explain complex configuration to anyone, from a field technician to a C-level sponsor.

**AI-Savvy:** Skilled in using AI tools to streamline daily operations and enhance performance.

#### **What do we offer?**

* A challenging, high-growth environment in an agile, global company.
* Access to our co-working space in central Barcelona.
* A flexible-remote working culture.
* Competitive compensation with performance-oriented bonuses, SPIFFs, and incentives.
* Excellent bonus structure tied to delivery quality and KPIs.
* Monthly perks and a training budget for professional development.
* Flexible working hours.
* Regular training, coaching, and team events.

*At Infraspeak, everyone is equal, unique, and valued. We believe diversity makes us stronger — shaping our culture, our business, and the world around us for the better — and we're committed to ethical talent acquisition, grounded in respect, fairness, and equal opportunity.*  
  
*Our code of conduct is clear: discrimination has no place here — whether based on age, disability, gender, race, religion or belief, civil or parental status, political views, or any other basis protected by law.*  
  
*"To be a source of a good life" isn't just a statement — it's our mission, and everyone is welcome to join us on that journey.*

title: Conversion Oriented Copywriter
description:
En Natulim buscamos un/a **Creative Strategist – Paid Ads** que nos ayude a llevar nuestras creatividades publicitarias al siguiente nivel.

Buscamos una persona que combine **creatividad, storytelling y mentalidad de performance**: alguien capaz de detectar qué hace que un anuncio funcione, convertir insights en conceptos creativos y aterrizarlos en vídeos, hooks y guiones que generen resultados.

No buscamos un perfil puramente conceptual ni un/a editor/a de vídeo. Queremos a alguien que **piense la creatividad de principio a fin**, desde el insight y el concepto hasta la estructura del anuncio y su ejecución, trabajando junto al equipo de contenido, edición y performance.

### **Qué harás**

* Desarrollar **conceptos creativos y ángulos de comunicación** para campañas de paid ads.
* Crear y testar diferentes **hooks, narrativas, claims y estructuras de vídeo** para mejorar el rendimiento de los anuncios.
* Escribir **guiones y briefs creativos** claros para producción y edición.
* Analizar anuncios propios y de competidores para identificar oportunidades y nuevos enfoques.
* Analizar resultados de las creatividades y entender qué elementos están funcionando: **hook, retención, engagement, CTR, conversión, etc.**
* Transformar aprendizajes de performance en nuevas ideas y ciclos de test.
* Trabajar estrechamente con los equipos de **Performance, Content y Editing** para producir y escalar las mejores creatividades.
* Adaptar tendencias, formatos y códigos de redes sociales al universo de Natulim.
* Participar en la creación de contenido tanto **short-form como long-form**, siempre con foco en su aplicación a paid media.
* Mantener un sistema continuo de **testing e iteración creativa**.

### **Qué buscamos**

* **2+ años de experiencia** creando contenido creativo en vídeo para redes sociales y/o paid media.
* Experiencia real desarrollando **anuncios en vídeo para plataformas como Meta, Instagram, TikTok o YouTube**.
* Experiencia escribiendo **guiones, hooks y conceptos creativos**.
* Haber editado vídeo o tener suficiente conocimiento de edición para entender cómo llevar una idea a ejecución.
* Entender las estructuras que hacen que un vídeo funcione: **hooks, retención, ritmo, storytelling y CTA**.
* Experiencia trabajando con marcas de **e-commerce, belleza, FMCG o consumo**.
* Capacidad para interpretar métricas de performance y convertir datos en aprendizajes creativos.
* Buen criterio creativo y capacidad para convertir ideas en piezas concretas y ejecutables.
* Perfil autónomo, proactivo, curioso y muy conectado con tendencias y formatos actuales.
* **Permiso de trabajo en España.**

### **¿Qué ofrecemos?**

* **Acceso y formación en herramientas de IA**, trabajando con tecnología puntera como Claude.
* **Contrato indefinido**, estabilidad laboral y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.
* **Jornada completa de lunes a viernes**, con flexibilidad de entrada y salida.
* **Formación interna y externa** para impulsar tu aprendizaje continuo.
* **Retribución flexible** adaptada a tus necesidades (seguro médico, restaurante, transporte y guardería).
* **Hasta un 50% de descuento en productos Natulim.**
* **Días de adaptación escolar**, para acompañar a hijos menores de 3 años cuando lo necesites.
* **Un equipo joven, dinámico y con muy buen ambiente**, donde las personas y las ideas cuentan.  
    
  Te esperamos!

title: Marketing Technology Engineer (BCN)
description:
#### **Who We Are**

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

**Working in MarTech with WPP Enterprise Solutions**

WPP Enterprise Solutions is a full-service digital agency helping ambitious brands deliver connected, personalised experiences across digital channels. Our expertise spans Marketing, Commerce, CRM, PXM and CX, enabling us to deliver end-to-end solutions with measurable impact.

Our clients include Bayer, MSD, Dyson, Johnson & Johnson, RTL, Nestlé, Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein and other global brands. Our teams are based in Amsterdam, Barcelona, London, Poland and India, with access to the wider WPP network worldwide.

**The Opportunity**

You'll help design and build MarTech solutions across Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud and the wider Salesforce platform, working collaboratively across the wider team. Depending on the client, you may work across platforms such as Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach and Adobe, together with data and cloud technologies including Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Tealium, Segment, AWS, Azure and GCP.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Design the solution and data**

* You help shape the data model and integrations, then build, test and support reliable production code with the wider team.
* Most of our depth sits in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, but the architecture rarely stops at one platform.
* Relational schemas, keys, retention, extract and ingestion strategies.
* Identity resolution across fragmented sources.

**2. Build the integrations**

* REST, SOAP, webhooks, batch or event-driven - you help select the right pattern, implement it and ensure failures recover safely.
* Work at the warehouse and CDP layer, not just the activation platform at the end of it.

**3. Build maintainable solutions**

* Build with AMPScript, SSJS, Apex, LWC, Liquid, Jinja or general-purpose code, depending on the platform and problem.
* Queries and automation logic driving segmentation and journeys at volume.
* Improve the team's versioning, review and deployment practices where they add value.
* Decisions documented so they outlast your engagement.

**4. Translate for the client**

* Shape ambiguous requirements into something buildable and present the solution yourself.

**What You Bring**

**1. Software Engineering**

* Production experience with Node.js, Python, Java, PHP or .NET.
* You write maintainable, tested and idempotent code with effective error handling and logging.

**2. Data Engineering and Architecture**

* Strong SQL against large datasets - not just reads, but the queries that drive segmentation and automation.
* You understand customer identity resolution across fragmented sources, including deterministic and probabilistic matching, survivorship and profile consolidation.

**3. Integration and Delivery**

* Delivered a production integration using REST, SOAP or webhooks.
* Understands batch and event-driven patterns, rate limits, retries, failure recovery and duplicate prevention.
* Hands-on version control in a team setting - branching, pull requests, peer review.

**4. Front-end Development**

* Comfortable building and debugging rendered output with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

**5. Marketing Platform Delivery**

* Hands-on delivery on an enterprise marketing or CRM platform - Salesforce, Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach, Adobe or equivalent.
* Built audience segmentation and multi-step customer journeys against a live data source.
* Worked directly with marketing stakeholders on requirements, not only via a ticket queue.

**Bonus experience**

* Additional Marketing Automation Experience: Salesforce Personalization, Pardot or Marketing Cloud Next; Adobe Campaign, Journey Optimizer or Marketo Engage; or HubSpot.
* Core CRM Platforms: Salesforce Sales, Service, Experience, Commerce or Industry Clouds.
* CDP Platforms: Data Cloud, Tealium, Segment or equivalent.
* Platform Development: AMPScript, SSJS, Apex, LWC, Liquid, Jinja.
* Data Engineering and Architecture: ETL / ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, data governance, big data.
* APIs & Integration: GraphQL.
* Front-end Development: React, Angular, Vue.
* DevOps: CI/CD, SFMC DevTools, Salesforce CLI, Copado, Gearset.
* Email Development: Responsive email build, including cross-client and dark mode testing.
* Email Deliverability: Sending reputation and authentication - SPF, DKIM, DMARC, dedicated IP warming.

**How You Work**

**1.Stay hands-on across the delivery lifecycle**

* This is a hands-on developer role. You help design and build solutions using platform languages, SQL and the appropriate integration technologies.
* You also review, audit, migrate and improve inherited solutions.
* You build solutions that are bulk-safe, observable and tested, with error handling and logging included from the start.
* You name things properly, you leave comments where the platform forced an ugly decision, and you don't hand over a black box.

**2. Platform-pragmatic**

* You work the constraint rather than resenting it. Enterprise marketing platforms often won't let you build the elegant solution, and you find the one that holds.
* You know when a platform's native tooling is enough and when the problem belongs in real code.

**3. Design, document and deliver responsibly**

* You consider the data model and integration pattern before building, keeping the design effort proportionate to the problem.
* You write the design down. Decisions and trade-offs outlast your engagement.
* You take responsibility for what you ship and can diagnose production issues.
* Your work lives in version control, gets reviewed by peers, and deploys the same way twice.
* You'd rather have a design challenged early than find the problem in production.

**4. Client-facing across disciplines**

* You lead requirements discussions and present solutions clearly to both marketing and technical stakeholders.
* You adapt the level of detail to your audience.
* You work closely with campaign operations, data engineers, developers and strategists, translating effectively between disciplines.

**In return, this is what we offer**

We encourage ambitious ideas, invest in your development and support a flexible, welcoming workplace.

**Our compensation**

* An annual gross salary of €43,700–€50,000, depending on experience.
* Company private health insurance.
* A choice of a Mac or Windows laptop.

**Career progression**

* Deepen your technical path towards Senior Marketing Technology Engineer, with a longer-term route into Technical Lead responsibilities across a portfolio.
* Broaden your practice path by improving how we deliver, what we standardise and how the wider team develops.
* We'll help you build either path through demonstrated impact, growing responsibility and business need.

**Our culture**

* Work from home at least one day a week.
* A culture of trust, with a feel-at-home vibe and an international environment.
* Mental health: Complimentary membership to EAP counselling services.
* Experience working across both B2B and B2C delivery contexts.

Note to recruitment agencies: We are unable to collaborate with external agencies at this moment in time, applications sent won't be processed.

#### **About WPP**

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

title: Project Accountant

#LI-AH1

* You are comfortable working with technology partners to build a joint pipeline.
* You are driven by the change AI brings to supply chain planning and consulting. You experiment, learn fast and take others with you.

***Supply chain transformation***

* You bring substantial consulting experience in supply chain planning transformation.

* You have led transformations with Anaplan or comparable planning solutions, such as SAP IBP, Kinaxis or OMP. You do not need technical Anaplan expertise. Your strength is leading delivery, aligning stakeholders and managing teams.
* You oversee multiple engagements, support project leads and take accountability for delivery outcomes.

***General***

* You are fluent in English. Spanish or French is a plus.
* You have a master’s degree in Economics, Engineering or another related field.
* You are ready to represent our values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast and be kind.
* You work well in an international team with a hybrid working model. You travel to clients (20%) and Bluecrux offices (Barcelona ES, Mechelen/Aalst BE, Zug CH – Min 40%).
* You have a valid driving license, or you obtain one within six months.

### **Why join us?**

* **Shape regional growth.** You decide with us where and how we grow our Anaplan supply chain business in the South region.
* **Lead complex transformations.** You guide clients through programs that change how they plan, and you build lasting relationships.
* **Lead your own squad.** You own your team's performance, development and growth.
* **Shape innovation into a concrete offering.** You work with fellow leaders and partners to develop our planning capabilities, embed AI in everything we do and bring innovation to our clients.
* **Shape how we use AI.** You help define how AI changes our client offering and the way we deliver.

* Enjoy a flexible & hybrid work environment, combining remote work, office presence and onsite client visits.
* Benefit from a **competitive salary** package, complete with **multiple extra-legal perks** designed to reward your expertise.

title: Head of Content
description:
**About us**
============

At THEKER, we're taking on one of the greatest challenges of the 21st century: redefining how physical work gets done in the world.

We are a robotics and AI company building intelligent, adaptable systems that solve problems traditional automation never could. From Barcelona, our mission is to create a generation-defining company leading the robotics revolution.

By joining us, you will have the chance to do the most meaningful work of your life, setting a new standard for industrial automation and driving breakthroughs with global reach, while being surrounded by a focused, talent-dense team that shares this ambition and is here to win.

We recently closed the largest robotics Series A in Europe's history, and we're looking for the top 0.01% of talent to take on that mission with us, and build the biggest company in the world.

**Your role**
=============

We are looking for a Head of Content to run THEKER's content operation from request to delivery. You will receive what the company needs from marketing, decide what comes first and make sure it ships on time and on brand. This is an operations and management role with a strong eye for brand. You won't be designing or editing yourself, but you will know good work when you see it.

You will be the single point of contact for marketing requests across THEKER, from videos and photos to presentations and events. You will turn each request into a clear brief, assign it to the right person in the content team and follow it through to delivery. You will also own the materials our sales team uses with clients and keep them current and consistent.

Day to day, you will manage the team's timeline and keep several projects moving at once. You will work with the founders and with every team from engineering to sales. You will also track what each channel delivers and propose new actions, from trade fairs to formats we haven't tried yet. Success means every request has an owner and a date, and sales trusts every material it sends.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

We are looking for a hybrid profile: part creative director, part motion designer, part AI-native creator and part team leader.

You should have:

* Strong experience in marketing or content, ideally B2B, including leading a creative team and giving clear, demanding creative direction.
* Strategic judgement. You set objectives, prioritize, and can explain why an action is worth doing.
* Strong brand and visual judgement, with deep knowledge of video and motion production. Your portfolio shows a point of view of its own.
* Solid copywriting in Spanish and English, plus comfort working with marketing metrics and analytics tools.
* A genuinely AI-native way of working. Claude should feel like your working environment, not an occasional tool.
* Based in Barcelona or willing to relocate (100% on-site role).

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Knowledge of motion graphics or 3D.
* An AI-native way of working, with tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.
* Experience planning trade fairs and external events in industrial or tech sectors.
* A track record of turning complex technical products into content that non-technical audiences understand.

**You'll thrive at THEKER if**
------------------------------

* You're excited by a fast-paced and ambitious environment. The opportunity ahead of us is enormous, and we're going all in to capture it.
* You want responsibility early on, delivering at world-class standards for leading clients.
* You enjoy experimenting, iterating quickly, and embracing change as part of the learning process.
* You enjoy bringing order to many moving parts, and you're comfortable saying "not yet" when priorities require it.

**Main responsibilities**
=========================

* Own the single entry point for marketing requests from the rest of the company. Turn each one into a brief, prioritize it, assign it and track it to delivery.
* Manage the content team's calendar and coordinate internal and external collaborators on each project.
* Own every material that goes to GTM, from sales decks to product documentation, with clear versions and approvals.
* Act as the main contact for sales on what they need and what is out of date.
* Keep the message and the brand consistent in everything that reaches a client.
* Write and review copy for LinkedIn, presentations and product materials.
* Define the metrics for each channel and turn what they show into decisions.
* Choose and plan the trade fairs and external events we attend, and propose new channels and formats with a clear goal and a way to measure them.

**What we offer**
=================

* Being part of a fast-growing robotics and AI company with genuine ambition, where your career can accelerate alongside us.
* The chance to build THEKER's content function and decide how a robotics company should look and sound.
* A focused, talent-dense team where your work is visible and your decisions count.
* An environment where new ideas are encouraged and your contributions shape both the product and the company.
* 100% on-site work in Barcelona.

**What the process looks like**
===============================

* Intro call with Talent Team. 30 minutes.
* Portfolio review and a case study on a real THEKER content and marketing challenge.
* Conversation with the founding team.
* Meet the rest of the team and founders at our offices.

These steps can be completed in 7 days.

**Final observation**
=====================

We're committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion. We welcome all applications regardless of background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, or beliefs.

You'll challenge assumptions, help leaders own their decisions and measure success by whether the business makes better decisions about its people because of your involvement.

* Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.
* Competitive compensation: Proactively maintained to value your work.
* Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

**Who you are**

* Experience partnering with Revenue teams in an international organisation, with an understanding of commercial pressures.
* Credibility advising directors and vice presidents on people strategy, organisation design and workforce change, alongside hands-on performance management experience.
* Clear, concise communication and senior stakeholder influence, including the ability to present recommendations, challenge assumptions and maintain a constructive position under pressure.
* Data storytelling skills that connect signals across clusters, distinguish local issues from organisation-wide patterns and build a business case for action.
* Understanding of how artificial intelligence reshapes roles, team structures and capability needs, and the ability to guide leaders through workforce redesign decisions.

* Experience independently managing complex employee relations cases with significant business, legal or reputational dimensions, including knowing when to escalate or involve Legal.

**We welcome**

You will work closely with the store team ensuring the right products are available on and close to the shop floor enabling an excellent client experience.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Maintain the organization of the stockroom to the highest standards with merchandise stored in a clear and organised way which allows the efficient flow between front and back of house.
* Manage the delivery of stock into the store, checking that it matches against the invoice and informing HQ / Inventory of any discrepancies.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience in achieving individual goals and contributing to team results
* Experience within a similar role , preferably in fashion/luxury
* Organised, with close attention to detail and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment
* Clear communication with the ability to connect with and influence various people
* Confident to work a utonomously and as part of a team
* A deep interest in Fashion, Art and Culture
* Fluent in Spanish, English will be a plus

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Digital Workplace Operations Director, Madrid (M, ES)
description:
**Location:** Madrid, M, ES

As Digital Workplace Operations Director, you will be accountable for the global delivery, performance and evolution of Swiss Re's employee workplace technology operations. Your scope spans Workplace Service Management, remote second-level support, onsite Field Services across Swiss Re locations, workplace hardware lifecycle services, and meeting room and multimedia technology support. You will lead a geographically distributed organization and govern the outcomes delivered by internal teams and external service partners.

This is a senior enterprise leadership role with end-to-end accountability for service reliability, employee experience, operational risk, service economics and transformation. You will set a consistent global operating model, connect workplace products and engineering with day-to-day delivery, and ensure employees experience one integrated service regardless of location, channel or provider.

You will drive the shift from reactive support to proactive, data-led operations through automation, self-service, knowledge management and AI-enabled support. Success requires a leader who has already managed comparable global operations, developed strong leadership teams and taken executive decisions during business-critical incidents and complex change.

**Key Responsibilities:**

You will have global leadership accountability for Workplace Operations, its people, service outcomes, delivery partners and continual improvement.

**Digital Employee Experience, Operational Intelligence and Product Improvement**

* You will establish a customer-centric, data-driven approach to Digital Workplace Operations, ensuring that operational insights and employee experience continuously inform product and engineering priorities.
* You will bring together service performance data, incident and problem trends, digital employee experience telemetry and direct employee feedback to identify systemic issues, recurring friction and opportunities for improvement.
* Working closely with Product and Engineering leaders, you will establish a structured feedback loop that translates these insights into actionable engineering priorities, addressing underlying product, platform and integration weaknesses rather than relying on operational workarounds or repeated support interventions.
* You will ensure that improvements are measured against tangible outcomes, including reduced incident recurrence, lower support demand, improved employee productivity and experience, and sustainable reductions in operational cost.

**Global workplace operations and service ownership**

* Set and execute the global Workplace Operations strategy, service portfolio and operating model across service management, remote support, regional onsite support and multimedia services, with clear responsibilities and consistent standards.
* Own end-to-end service delivery outcomes and the interfaces across the enterprise Service Desk (first level), remote second-level support, onsite teams, engineering specialists and managed-service providers.
* Translate business priorities into measurable service objectives, service catalogues, location coverage and capacity plans, balancing global consistency with justified local requirements.

**Regional Field Services and employee technology lifecycle**

* Lead onsite technology support across the Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific, including executive and business-critical support, ensuring effective regional leadership, service continuity and a consistent employee experience.
* Oversee operational delivery of end-user hardware throughout provisioning, onboarding, deployment, replacement, recovery, reuse and secure retirement, including inventory availability and demand planning in partnership with Engineering, Procurement and suppliers.
* Ensure technology readiness and support for meeting rooms, multimedia services, office openings, moves and closures, and major employee events, in coordination with relevant workplace and infrastructure teams.

**Service management, quality and operational resilience**

* Lead Workplace service-management governance and operational performance across incident, major incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service-level and service-transition practices, aligned with enterprise processes.
* Ensure effective escalation, restoration and communication during major disruptions; drive rigorous root-cause analysis, permanent remediation and a reduction in recurring incidents and avoidable service demand.
* Establish meaningful service levels and experience measures (SLAs, XLAs and operational KPIs), and maintain a transparent view of quality, reliability, employee impact, risk, demand and improvement priorities.

**Security, controls and governance**

* Ensure workplace services operate within applicable security, privacy, regulatory and internal-control requirements, with clear operational ownership for risk, vulnerabilities, privileged support access and third-party obligations.
* Oversee audit readiness, control evidence, management actions, service-continuity arrangements and supplier resilience, ensuring risks are raised early, remediation is effective and accountability is clear.

**Managed services, commercial and financial leadership**

* Own Workplace Operations financial planning and performance, including operational budgets, forecasts, service cost drivers, workforce and supplier spend, investment cases and sustainable cost optimization.
* Lead strategic partner governance, sourcing and service transitions; manage vendors against contracted outcomes, quality, experience, innovation and value rather than resource counts alone.
* Maintain effective oversight of workplace technology assets, service contracts and relevant licence consumption, partnering with Finance, Procurement and product owners on lifecycle cost and value.

**Transformation and employee experience**

* Build an evidence-led improvement roadmap that uses employee feedback, digital experience telemetry, workflow automation, self-service and AI-assisted operations to reduce friction, prevent incidents and improve productivity.
* Own operational assurance and readiness for workplace transformations, large-scale technology deployments and provider changes, ensuring credible delivery capacity, support acceptance, communication, hypercare and business continuity.
* Strengthen the experience of critical employee journeys, including joining, moving, changing devices, seeking support and leaving, with measurable gains in quality, speed, cost and satisfaction.

**Organizational and executive leadership**

* Lead and develop a multi-region organization of 150+ employees through its service-management, regional Field Services and multimedia leaders; shape structure, talent, succession, workforce planning, performance and a culture of accountability.
* Serve as a member of the Digital Workplace leadership team and partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, HR, Facilities, Finance and business leaders to resolve cross-functional issues and translate strategy into reliable operations.
* Act as the senior escalation and decision point for critical service matters, communicating clearly with executives and making balanced decisions across employee experience, cost, risk, speed and resilience.

**About the team**

In GSTP Digital Workplace, we make it easy for Swiss Re employees to use their digital workplace to connect seamlessly with people, ideas and expertise across the company and beyond. We focus on translating internal client needs into workplace products and services that improve productivity, enable flexibility and support secure ways of working.

Digital Workplace provides the products, services and support that enable Swiss Re's workforce to work from anywhere, anytime, in a stable and secure environment. This includes collaboration, productivity, endpoints, workplace foundations, governance and emerging workplace capabilities such as AI.

Workplace Operations is the global delivery and service-management capability behind that experience. It brings together remote and onsite user support, global Field Services, multimedia technology services and operational governance, in close partnership with the engineering and product organizations accountable for the technology platforms.

**About you**

To be successful in this role, you are already an established senior leader of large-scale, global IT operations or Digital Workplace / End User Services. You bring direct accountability for a comparable operation, not only individual service-management processes, engineering platforms or transformation programmes.

You have led leaders across regions and time zones, managed significant internal and outsourced service capacity, and improved service quality while controlling cost and operational risk. You are credible with engineers and service providers, but you measure success through employee productivity, reliable services and business outcomes.

You combine executive presence, sound judgement and calm incident leadership with the ability to build a strong organization. You know when to challenge, when to empower and how to turn operational evidence into clear priorities and decisions.

**You have:**

* 15+ years in enterprise IT operations or Digital Workplace, including several years as a Director or Head of a significant global service organization.
* Prior end-to-end accountability for global remote support, onsite Field Services, service governance and strategic outsourced service providers.

* Proven experience establishing data-driven operational improvement capabilities, using service analytics, digital employee experience telemetry and customer feedback to influence product roadmaps and engineering priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Operations, Product and Engineering to eliminate recurring issues at their root cause, reduce support demand and improve the end-to-end employee experience.
* A proven record of leading managers across regions, building effective teams and developing talent, succession and delivery accountability.
* Deep practical knowledge of IT service management (ITIL / ITSM), major incidents, problem and change management, service transition, ServiceNow or comparable platforms, and measurable service and experience outcomes.
* Strong commercial and financial leadership, including substantial operating budgets, outcome-based managed-service contracts, supplier negotiation, service cost optimization and sourcing decisions.
* Demonstrated delivery of operational modernization with measurable improvements through automation, self-service, AI-enabled support, digital employee experience insights and continuous improvement.
* A strong understanding of workplace endpoint and collaboration technology, device and asset lifecycles, field support and multimedia services, sufficient to challenge technical and commercial decisions.
* Experience managing security, regulatory controls, audits, operational resilience and risk in a complex enterprise; experience in financial services or another regulated industry is advantageous.
* Credibility with senior executives and the ability to coordinate decisions across Technology, Security, Finance, Procurement and business stakeholders while protecting service continuity during change.

For Spain the **base salary range** for this position is between EUR 98,000 and EUR 163,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

* the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
* the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

**About Swiss Re**

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

title: Expansion Project Manager
description:
**About Impress**

We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love. We are IMPRESS, the largest chain of digital orthodontic clinics in Europe, revolutionizing the invisible orthodontic sector and bringing smiles to people's faces. Our unique combination of medical expertise and digitalization has earned us recognition as one of the top fastest-growing Health Tech companies by Forbes. Born in Barcelona in 2019, we have expanded across 10 countries with more than 110 locations, offering leading care and state-of-the-art technology.

#### **Role Overview**

We are looking for an **Expansion Project Manager** to oversee the full expansion lifecycle for Impress, driving commercial growth through strategic partnerships and leading the delivery of flagship clinic construction projects worldwide. This role is responsible for identifying and closing real estate and B2B dental opportunities, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing CAPEX budgets, and executing end-to-end fit-out and site delivery.

### **Your Responsibilities:**

#### **1. Business Development & Real Estate Partnerships**

* Identify, prospect, and engage new real estate partners, including landlords, property owners, retail groups, and shopping centers.
* Pitch the Impress model to generate strong interest in hosting clinic locations.
* Build and manage an active pipeline of prospective sites, leading the full negotiation cycle through to contract signature.
* Develop and maintain an ongoing network of strategic partners, including landlords, commercial brokers, and investors.
* Represent Impress during meetings, site visits, and industry events to maximize expansion opportunities.

#### **2. Dental Partnership Development (B2B)**

* Prospect dental practices and orthodontists to establish strategic B2B partnerships.
* Present the Impress partnership model, tailor the pitch to partner needs, and execute agreements.
* Maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing partner practices to optimize ongoing collaboration.

#### **3. Construction & Project Delivery**

* Lead and manage flagship construction projects worldwide, owning each phase from design coordination and the tender process through construction, opening, and site handover.
* Manage the workload and output of regional teams involved in design and construction.
* Ensure all projects align with expansion forecasts, new opening schedules, and operational goals.
* Oversee the maintenance and remodeling of operational clinics to reflect strategic decisions, policy updates, and brand improvements.

#### **4. Budget Management**

* Build budgets prior to presentation to senior management for executive approval.
* Oversee comprehensive cost and budget management, evaluating and approving additional spending when necessary.

#### **5. Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting**

* Collaborate closely with operations, finance, legal, marketing, and construction teams to ensure cross-functional alignment on expansion priorities and deadlines.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders (such as Country Managers and Medical Directors) to communicate regional needs, address requirements, and mitigate escalations.
* Escalate critical issues promptly to ensure all project milestones and opening dates are met.
* Identify potential operational, financial, or delivery risks early and implement corrective solutions.
* Deliver regular, structured reporting on pipeline status, contract negotiations, construction milestones, and upcoming clinic openings.

### **What you need to be successful:**

* Academic Background: Degree in Engineering (Civil, Industrial, Mechanical, Architectural, or related field).
* Experience: 5+ years in commercial real estate expansion, retail/network rollouts, or multi-site technical project management.
* Languages: **Native or Professional fluency in English** (additional languages are a plus).
* Mobility: **Willingness to travel frequently** for site visits, contractor inspections, partner meetings, and industry events.
* Commercial & Deal-Making Track Record: Proven background in B2B sales, real estate acquisition, lease negotiation, and partnership development with landlords, brokers, and healthcare professionals.
* End-to-End Project Delivery: Direct experience managing fit-outs and construction projects from initial design and tender to contractor oversight, site handover, and maintenance.
* Financial Acumen: Strong experience formulating, tracking, and managing multi-site CAPEX budgets and construction cost accounts.
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence C-level executives, landlords, regional country managers, and medical directors.
* Project Management & Organization: Strong organizational skills with a track record of running parallel projects across multiple regions while hitting strict launch deadlines.

title: Head of Talent Acquisition (Remote)
description:
**Unstoppable starts with people.** The future of payments is being built today, and at **Paymentology**, we are looking for people who want to help shape it. We power card issuing for leading banks, fintechs and digital brands across the globe, and as we continue to grow, we are looking for curious, ambitious people who thrive on solving complex challenges, embrace innovation and want to make a tangible impact at global scale.

**Head of Talent Acquisition**
==============================

We’re looking for a **Head of Talent Acquisition** to lead and shape our global Talent Acquisition function, ensuring Paymentology attracts, assesses and secures the exceptional talent needed to deliver our business strategy.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you’ll define our global Talent Acquisition strategy, establish high hiring standards and lead a team of three TA Partners and a TA Operations role to deliver an effective, consistent and high-performing recruitment function.

This is a strategic leadership role for someone who combines commercial judgement, deep recruitment expertise and the confidence to influence senior stakeholders. You’ll play a critical role in translating business and workforce priorities into effective hiring strategies, strengthening hiring decisions and continuously evolving an effective, scalable and data-driven TA function that supports our global growth.

**Location:** This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Poland, Italy, Slovenia, Serbia, Czech Republic, Portugal, Croatia or Spain.

**Application deadline:** 18 November 2026.

**What you get to do:**
-----------------------

### **Talent Acquisition Strategy & Hiring Priorities**

* Define and lead Paymentology’s global Talent Acquisition strategy, aligning recruitment priorities with business objectives, approved workforce plans and future capability needs.
* Partner with the Executive Team, functional leaders and Finance to understand workforce requirements, challenge assumptions and recommend hiring priorities based on business impact, affordability, market conditions and recruitment capacity.
* Anticipate talent-market challenges and hiring risks, providing strategic insights and recommendations that support informed workforce and hiring decisions.
* Continuously evolve the TA operating model to support changing business needs, ensuring the function remains scalable, efficient and commercially focused.

### **Hiring Excellence & Talent Standards**

* Define and maintain high hiring standards, ensuring recruitment decisions are structured, evidence-based and aligned with Paymentology’s talent philosophy.
* Set clear expectations for role definition, assessment quality and hiring decisions, ensuring TA Partners effectively challenge requirements and uphold consistent hiring standards.
* Drive a culture of hiring excellence through effective interview practices, strong hiring-manager capability, timely decision-making and a positive candidate experience.

### **Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach and develop a global Talent Acquisition team comprising three TA Partners and a TA Operations role, fostering accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Empower TA Partners to own recruitment within their functions, strengthening their ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex hiring challenges and make decisions independently.
* Provide strategic direction and oversight to TA Operations, ensuring systems, processes, governance and reporting enable effective recruitment delivery.

### **Stakeholder Partnership & Strategic Influence**

* Act as a trusted strategic advisor to the Chief People Officer and Executive Team, providing insights on hiring priorities, talent-market dynamics and critical capability needs.
* Influence and challenge senior stakeholders, resolve competing hiring priorities across functions and provide leadership on selected executive and business-critical appointments.

### **Recruitment Operations, Technology & Analytics**

* Oversee the effectiveness of recruitment processes, systems and governance, ensuring consistent, compliant and scalable hiring practices across the organisation.
* Champion the adoption of modern recruitment technology, AI and automation to improve hiring quality, operational efficiency and candidate experience.
* Define and monitor recruitment performance metrics, leveraging data and market intelligence to identify improvement opportunities and inform strategic decisions.

### **Talent Attraction**

* Define and lead Paymentology’s global talent attraction strategy, strengthening our ability to engage and attract high-calibre talent in priority markets.
* Partner with People and Marketing to strengthen Paymentology’s positioning in priority talent markets and support proactive talent attraction initiatives and partnerships.

**What it takes to succeed:**
-----------------------------

* Extensive experience in Talent Acquisition, including at least 5 years in leadership roles with responsibility for TA strategy, team performance and recruitment effectiveness.
* Experience operating in a globally distributed organisation, ideally within SaaS, technology infrastructure or a similarly complex environment.
* Proven ability to define and execute a global Talent Acquisition strategy, aligning hiring priorities and recruitment capabilities with business objectives and workforce plans.
* Strong commercial acumen and strategic judgement, with the ability to balance business priorities, hiring demand, recruitment capacity, budget considerations and talent-market realities.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to advise and constructively challenge C-suite executives and senior business leaders.
* Deep recruitment expertise, with a proven ability to establish and uphold high hiring standards, drive structured and evidence-based assessment, and improve the quality of hiring decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing Talent Acquisition teams, building accountability, empowering others and developing their capability to operate as strategic business partners.
* Strong analytical capabilities, using recruitment data, performance metrics and talent-market intelligence to inform decisions, identify risks and drive continuous improvement.
* Experience designing and evolving scalable recruitment operating models, processes and governance, with the ability to lead change and drive adoption across the organisation.
* Strong understanding of modern recruitment technology, ATS platforms, automation and AI, with the ability to leverage these to improve hiring quality, efficiency and candidate experience. Experience with Ashby is a strong advantage.

We’re a team that cares deeply about the quality of our work, supports each other and is always looking for ways to improve. You’ll be joining a group of people who enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas and making things better, with plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

At **Paymentology**, we believe that making a difference starts with the people behind the work. You will be part of a diverse, global team of Paymentologists who are united by a shared mission to advance the world through payments.  
This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful work, collaborate across markets and functions, and help shape the future of a business with global reach and real impact.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on any unlawful ground, including race, colour, ethnicity, sex, gender, pregnancy, marital status, family responsibility, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, language or HIV status.

Paymentology will never request any form of payment from applicants at any stage of our recruitment process, including for applications, interviews, training or job placements. All legitimate Paymentology vacancies are advertised via our official careers page, and our recruitment emails are sent only from official Paymentology domains.

description:

**What we are looking for:**

Semperis is looking for a passionate and results-driven **Enterprise** **Customer Success Manager** to join our EMEA team.

**Fluency in English, Italian, and French is required for this role.**  
  
**What you will be doing:**

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Semperis, you will ensure your customers' success and satisfaction with our products and support them every step of the way. You will be an essential member of our Customer Success team, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including Technical Delivery and Sales teams to maximise opportunities for our Enterprise Business customers and Semperis.

Our CSM will build and nurture long-lasting relationships across multiple client accounts. Our CSM’s strengths include the ability to identify gaps in the product and internal operations and build effective and scalable solutions to address them. * You will be empowered to achieve and report on customer health, satisfaction, retention, and growth targets

* Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our customers' operations
* Monitor record-keeping to ensure that relevant customer information is captured to enable informed, personalised customer interactions with Semperis Support, Customer Success (CS), Sales, etc

* Network security, endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), cloud security (CSPM/CWPP), identity (IAM/SSO/MFA), SIEM, zero-trust, threat intelligence, etc
* Fundamental understanding of modern architectures: on-prem and cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)

* Executive presence & communication: can explain complex threats or product value to CISOs, CIOs, architects, and analysts in their language
* Storytelling with data: Turn telemetry, risk scores, and attack surface metrics into compelling business narratives
* Project/program management: Be in tune with customer onboarding, health checks, maturity roadmaps, and expansion opportunities
* Conflict resolution & expectation management during incidents or escalations.
* Consultative selling & value realization: Identify use cases that justify expansion, upsell & cross-sell modules, or multi-year renewals

**Business & Strategic Skills -**

* Renewal & expansion forecasting (understand ARR, NRR, consumption metrics)
* Ability to build and Execute Customer Success Plans / Joint Success Plans with Account owners (sales reps)
* Risk identification (technical debt, low adoption, competing solutions) and mitigation planning (QBRs, escalation paths)

**Preferences:**

* Experience with SFDC and Active Directory
* **Fluent Italian, French, and English language skills are required**

#LI-LP1

description:
**Company Description**

**THE WORLD OF UBISOFT**

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

**Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile** brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

 **Job Description**

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a **Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist** to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.

**\*Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.\***

**Your daily adventure:**

* Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.
* Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.
* Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.
* Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.
* Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.
* Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.
* Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.
* Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.
* Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.
* Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends.
* Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.

 **Qualifications**

**YOUR SKILLS**

* Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.
* 3+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.
* Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.
* Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.
* Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).
* Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.
* Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.
* Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.
* Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.
* Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.

**Nice to Have:**

* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.
* Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).
* Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).
* Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.
* Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.
* Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.

 **Additional Information**

**YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)**

* **Ticket Restaurant:** 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery free of taxes).
* **Flexible working hours:** 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
* **Reduced schedule** (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
* **Personal Matters Hours:** 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
* **Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day** on yourUbi-Birthday.
* **5 extra holiday days** on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.

* **Life Insurance** with AXA.
* **Office Gym** open from 7 AM to 8 PM

* **Language training** for English, Spanish, and French.
* **Professional development training & programs**, based upon request.
* **Ubisoft games** are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
* **Locally roasted craft coffee** by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).

Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

description:
**AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter**
------------------------------------

Organic Instagram & Facebook Reels | Direct Response Copywriting

**About Us**
------------

Impact Clients is a fast-growing, 100% bootstrapped online education and software company. Through courses, coaching, and software, we help everyday people develop practical skills and build digital product businesses.

We are launching an exciting new business division focused on AI avatars, viral health and wellness content, and supplement affiliate marketing.

We are hiring a full-time AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter to join our internal team and help us build a portfolio of highly successful Instagram and Facebook accounts that generate millions of organic views and drive supplement sales.

Your primary mission is simple: Research viral content, write exceptional short-form scripts, and turn organic views into supplement affiliate revenue.

This is a hands-on creative position for someone who understands how to capture attention, write compelling health and wellness content, and turn social media engagement into measurable revenue.

Company: Impact Clients  
Website: https://go.impactclients.co/ Language: English  
Availability: Full-Time (40 hours/week)  
Time Zone: ET business-hour overlap preferred  
Work Type: Full-Time, Remote  
Industry: Health & Wellness, Supplements, AI Avatars, Affiliate Marketing, Direct Response  
Expected Compensation: 2,000 - 3,000 USD/month

**Our Business Model**
----------------------

We are building a new portfolio of organic Instagram and Facebook accounts focused on health, wellness, longevity, and supplement-related topics.

Rather than using traditional human influencers, we use AI-generated avatars to create engaging, educational, and entertaining short-form videos.

Here's how the business works:

* Research Viral Content: Identify high-performing health and wellness videos, trending topics, proven hooks, and compelling educational angles.
* Write Scripts: Turn research into original, attention-grabbing Instagram and Facebook Reel scripts designed to maximize retention, engagement, and sharing.
* Create AI Avatar Videos: Our production team uses AI avatar technology and video editing to bring your scripts to life.
* Drive Organic Traffic: Publish content across our Instagram and Facebook accounts to generate views, followers, and product interest.
* Generate Affiliate Revenue: Direct interested viewers toward relevant supplements sold through affiliate partners, including Amazon product pages, where purchases can generate commissions.

Our goal is to build a repeatable, scalable content engine that consistently produces viral videos and generates meaningful affiliate revenue.

You will be responsible for the research, hooks, storytelling, and scripts that power this entire operation.

**Example Accounts & Creative References**
------------------------------------------

Below are examples of Instagram accounts operating in the type of health and wellness content space we are entering.

Please review these accounts before applying to understand the general content formats, topics, and creative styles we are looking to develop:

* Nutrition Is Greatness: https://www.instagram.com/nutrition.is.greatness/reels/
* Wellness Everyday Health: https://www.instagram.com/wellnesseverydayhealth/reels/
* Homestead Wellness Daily: https://www.instagram.com/homestead.wellness.daily/reels/
