* Health Is Greatness: https://www.instagram.com/health.is.greatness/reels/
* Travis on Wellness: https://www.instagram.com/travisonwellness/reels/

These accounts are provided as creative references for the type of organic health and wellness content we intend to produce.

Your responsibility will be to research what makes content successful in this market and develop original scripts that can achieve comparable or better results.

We are looking for someone who can identify proven viral patterns and turn them into original, engaging, revenue-generating content—not simply copy or rewrite another creator's videos.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Research viral content daily: Discover high-performing Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other short-form videos in the health, wellness, longevity, and supplement markets.
* Write high-converting scripts: Develop original short-form video scripts designed to generate strong hooks, watch time, engagement, shares, and supplement affiliate sales.
* Develop compelling hooks: Write attention-grabbing openings that stop viewers from scrolling and make them want to watch the entire video.
* Master short-form storytelling: Structure scripts with compelling introductions, curiosity, educational value, and natural transitions into product-related calls to action.
* Research supplement products: Understand the supplements we promote, their ingredients, intended uses, consumer interests, and approved product positioning.
* Write product-focused content: Develop educational and promotional content around health topics that naturally connects to relevant supplement products.
* Optimize for revenue: Understand that our goal is not simply generating millions of views, but producing content that translates into clicks, qualified product interest, and affiliate commissions.
* Collaborate with AI video editors: Work closely with our AI avatar production team to ensure scripts translate into compelling final videos.
* Analyze performance: Review metrics including views, average watch time, engagement, clicks, and attributable sales to identify successful formats and improve future scripts.
* Build repeatable content systems: Organize research, winning hooks, proven angles, and creative templates to help our team consistently produce high-performing content at scale.
* Maintain compliance: Ensure health and supplement scripts avoid unsubstantiated medical claims, misleading representations, and prohibited claims while following applicable FTC guidance, affiliate disclosure rules, and platform policies.
* Continuously improve: Test different hooks, messaging angles, storytelling structures, and calls to action based on performance feedback.

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* Strong copywriting ability, particularly for short-form videos, direct-response marketing, or social media content.
* Demonstrated ability to research viral content and understand why certain videos outperform others.
* Excellent understanding of Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and short-form content retention.
* Ability to write engaging scripts that communicate complex topics in simple, compelling language.
* Strong research skills and an ability to identify interesting health and wellness topics from credible sources.
* Understanding of persuasive writing, consumer psychology, curiosity-driven hooks, and effective calls to action.
* Ability to produce scripts consistently at high volume without sacrificing quality.
* Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and writing while maintaining originality and accuracy.
* Willingness to learn about supplements, affiliate marketing, and direct-response content monetization.
* Strong attention to detail, ability to follow feedback, and willingness to iterate based on performance.
* Excellent written English and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

**Nice To Haves**
-----------------

* Experience writing viral Instagram or Facebook Reels that have generated 1M+ views.
* Experience writing direct-response copy specifically for supplements, health, wellness, nutrition, or longevity products.
* Proven track record writing social content that has generated measurable clicks, conversions, or affiliate revenue.
* Familiarity with AI avatar platforms, AI video generation, or faceless content production.
* Experience with supplement affiliate programs, Amazon Associates, or similar performance-based marketing models.
* Understanding of Facebook and Instagram algorithms, retention metrics, and organic content distribution.
* Experience writing comment-to-DM calls to action or using ManyChat-style automation workflows.
* Familiarity with supplement advertising compliance, health-related advertising restrictions, and affiliate disclosure standards.
* Experience creating high volumes of original content across multiple social media accounts.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

We are not hiring someone to simply write scripts and check boxes.

We are hiring someone who is excited about the challenge of building a brand-new revenue division through viral content.

Success in this position means:

* Consistently identifying promising viral content opportunities before they become oversaturated.
* Producing original scripts that achieve strong watch time, engagement, and organic reach.
* Developing repeatable winning formats that can be replicated across multiple accounts.
* Collaborating effectively with our AI avatar production team to maintain a consistent content pipeline.
* Creating content that generates meaningful affiliate clicks, supplement purchases, and attributable revenue.
* Continuously improving creative performance through research, testing, and iteration.

Ultimately, we want a copywriter who thinks like both a creative strategist and a direct-response marketer.

You should care just as much about whether a video generates sales as you do about whether it generates views.

**Our Core Values**
-------------------

We believe that an exceptional company is built by exceptional people.

Impact Clients has grown from zero to multiple eight figures without outside funding because our team operates with an entrepreneurial mindset, high standards, and a shared commitment to our customers.

Our three core values define how we work:

1. Client Success = Company Success

Everything we do, from marketing and sales to coaching and fulfillment, exists to create the best possible outcomes for our customers.

Client success always comes first.

2. 1% Better Every Day

We believe in constantly improving, both personally and professionally.

Whether that's working out, reading, learning new skills, or sharing valuable ideas, our team takes personal growth seriously.

We encourage continuous development—physically, mentally, and spiritually—and regularly share books, podcasts, lessons, and reflections with each other.

3. FIO — Figure It Out

We are an entrepreneurial, resourceful team of owners.

We believe in hiring people who can take initiative, solve problems independently, and operate with very little micromanagement.

Every team member is encouraged to treat their division like their own business, take full ownership of results, and find creative solutions to challenges.

We believe that if you want to go fast, you go alone; if you want to go far, you go together. That's why we all choose as individuals to grow with this team because we are committed to the vision of building a billion-dollar enterprise-value organization, and having a ton of fun along the way.

We work hard, set high standards, and genuinely enjoy building alongside talented, ambitious people.

**Benefits & Opportunity**
--------------------------

* Competitive compensation: 2,000–3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and qualifications.
* Build a new division: Join at the ground floor of an exciting new AI avatar and supplement affiliate marketing business.
* Creative autonomy: Research viral content, test fresh angles, and develop your own creative approaches to generating organic growth.
* High-growth environment: Work inside an established, multiple-eight-figure company launching a new revenue channel.
* Work with AI technology: Collaborate with a team using AI avatars, video generation, and modern content production tools.
* Growth opportunities: Potential to expand into senior copywriting, creative strategy, or content leadership responsibilities as the division grows.
* Fully remote: Work remotely with a results-oriented team that values autonomy, ownership, and execution.
* Entrepreneurial culture: Join a team of ambitious people committed to personal growth, excellence, and building something meaningful together.

**How To Apply**
----------------

If you're passionate about viral content, direct-response copywriting, AI technology, and health and wellness, we'd love to hear from you.

Please be prepared to share examples of your previous copywriting work, particularly short-form video scripts, along with any available performance metrics demonstrating results.

We are looking for someone who wants to do more than write content.

We want someone who can help us build a viral content engine that consistently generates millions of views and turns that attention into real, measurable revenue.

Apply below to join our team.

description:
**About UMAEZ**

UMAEZ builds, launches and scales direct-to-consumer brands it owns outright, including GODA. Every revenue function sits in-house, from creative strategy and paid media to retention, creator programs and customer support. We are remote-first and AI-first, with a global team that ships a high volume of performance creative every week.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the operational backbone of our marketing team.

You will connect creative production, retention, creator and affiliate programs, social media initiatives, hiring coordination, external partners and marketing systems, and you will design the workflows and AI integrations that make them run. Your job is to turn priorities into clear assignments, make sure teams have what they need, keep deadlines visible and get approved work to launch.

This is a hands-on ownership role. You will run daily execution while maintaining and improving the systems behind it. In the same week you might clear an urgent production bottleneck, build a ClickUp automation, rebalance an overloaded pod and give leadership a clear read on operational performance.

You will take full ownership of the function through a structured handover with the outgoing Head of Marketing Operations.

**What you'll own**

Daily execution and operating rhythm

* Own the daily operating rhythm of the marketing department. Turn leadership priorities into plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-through.
* Coordinate requests across creative, media buying, retention, customer support, People and external partners. Resolve blockers, manage competing priorities and escalate decisions before they affect delivery.
* Track announcements and feedback from team leads, and turn strategy or priority changes into updated assignments the same day.
* Run the relevant operational meetings, keep action logs and make sure decisions are reflected in team workflows.
* Own the follow-ups and smaller tasks that keep work moving.

Creative production and delivery

* Own the workflow from brief assignment through production, review, revisions, approval, final upload and delivery for launch.
* Work with creative leads and strategists to keep production plans realistic, priorities clear and workloads balanced. Track backlog, overdue tasks, revision queues and upcoming deadlines, and protect the weekly editing cadence so the pipeline is cleared by the end of each week.
* Enforce naming conventions, task requirements, upload procedures and approval gates. Leads and strategists approve their own department's creative; you own the approval flow, including repurposed TikTok edits that admins approve against set guidelines.
* Run pre-launch quality checks on the ads delivery tracker, including content safety (claims, platform policy, visual compliance) and duration and format checks, so every asset is complete, compliant and ready for media buying.
* Oversee the daily delivery sweep with the operations admins. Confirm that approved assets reach media buying, delivery records in ClickUp and Notion stay accurate and launch blockers get timely follow-up.
* Maintain the marketing and launch calendar for campaigns, product launches and seasonal peaks such as BFCM. Coordinate dependencies across creative assets, product information, website readiness and launch teams.
* Brief and prioritize web and design requests, and check output before it goes live.

Pod structure, capacity and team coordination

* Own the operational structure of the creative pods (strategists, video editors and shared resources, including pods run with external creative partners), and adapt it as brands and workloads grow.
* Keep a current view of who supports each strategist, product and brand. Spot staffing gaps, overloaded or idle team members and opportunities to rebalance work.
* Place new joiners in pods, coordinate their access, workflow training and team integration, and keep the pod structure tracker up to date.
* Monitor delivery performance and recurring execution issues. Agree corrective actions with functional leads and follow through until each issue is resolved.

Workflow building and AI integration

* Design and build the operational workflows that connect teams, tools and handoffs, from intake and assignment through review, delivery and reporting.
* Lead AI integration across marketing operations: find where AI can remove manual work or improve quality, then build, test and roll out the solution with the teams who will use it.

Notion and operational documentation

* Keep SOPs, playbooks, team resources and the onboarding knowledge base organized and current, including role-based onboarding templates and walkthrough videos. Every process should have a clear owner and reflect how the team actually works.

Reporting and operational performance

Turn reporting into clear actions for the team and concise updates for leadership, including a weekly Marketing Operations update and the operations section of the monthly leadership review.

AI tools, software and cost oversight

* Own monthly Higgsfield credit reporting: credits consumed, allocation by team and project, usage patterns and efficiency metrics such as credits per finished second of video. Forecast requirements and flag overspend early.

* Support the rollout of approved AI workflows, training resources and usage standards.

Retention operations

* Oversee the operating structure that supports the retention team, working closely with the Head of Retention.
* Maintain project and campaign workflows, ownership, timelines, reporting and cross-team dependencies, so the team has the systems and resources to execute consistently.
* Track agreed initiatives, escalate delivery, staffing or coordination issues, and support new retention and growth projects through planning, setup and implementation.

Creator, affiliate and social media programs

* Oversee the creator and affiliate programs, including the Trybe creator program and partner-agency programs: program structure, recruitment and activation workflows, performance tracking and the overall health of each program.
* Maintain onboarding resources, submission processes, approval requirements, tracking and communication procedures. Make sure product samples are tracked from order to delivery and that delayed shipments and missing content are followed up.
* Coordinate issues involving creator permissions, usage rights, asset delivery, attribution and commission setup and internal handoffs.
* Oversee social media initiatives with the social team: content calendars, production and approval workflows, asset delivery and posting cadence. Make sure social plans line up with launches, creator content and paid campaigns.
* Report on program and initiative performance with the relevant leads, and turn what works into repeatable processes.

External partners and vendors

* Manage operational relationships with external creative partners, agencies, vendors and platforms, and lead key partner calls. Keep deliverables, responsibilities, timelines and escalation routes clear.
* Monitor partners and vendors for operational gaps, keep partner documentation current and follow through on open commitments, service issues and agreed improvements.

Creative rewards and commission administration

* Own the administration and documentation of creative rewards programs.
* Maintain eligibility rules, performance trackers, milestone records and calculation procedures. Validate the monthly close with the relevant performance and finance owners before rewards are approved for payment.
* Resolve questions on naming, attribution, iterations and eligibility consistently. Escalate exceptions and proposed rule changes to leadership.

Hiring, onboarding and offboarding coordination

* Partner with the Head of People and functional leads to identify hiring needs based on capacity, workload and performance.
* Keep visibility into open roles, expected start dates, onboardings, exits and resource gaps, and share a regular hiring operations recap.
* Coordinate skills-test logistics for creative candidates with the reviewing leads.
* Prepare new joiners operationally: workspace access, onboarding checklists and ClickUp templates, pod and channel assignments, welcome messages and training resources.
* Oversee the marketing side of offboarding so access is removed across every tool and shared account, and responsibilities and files are handed over properly.
* People owns recruitment and formal HR processes. You own the operational readiness and integration of marketing hires.

Admin team management

* Lead the marketing operations admins. Set weekly priorities, clarify ownership and review the accuracy and completeness of assignment, delivery, reporting and access-management work.
* Keep dependable daily coverage so recurring work continues through absences and staffing changes. Own escalations and fix the process when the same issue comes back.

Leadership support and continuous improvement

* Give the CEO a clear view of operational health, risks, capacity and decisions required.
* Support planning for new products, brands, teams, partners and growth initiatives. Assess operational requirements, resource implications and execution risks before rollout.
* Keep visibility into vendor costs, rewards liabilities and resource allocation, and provide accurate operational inputs for budget and profitability decisions.
* Proactively spot broken or missing processes, and take approved improvements from diagnosis through implementation, documentation and team adoption.

**What success looks like**

* Marketing priorities have clear owners and realistic deadlines. Teams know what to work on, approved assets move steadily toward launch and blockers surface early.
* Every asset that reaches media buying has passed its quality, safety and duration checks, and delivery records match reality.
* Manual coordination keeps shrinking as reliable workflows, automations and AI agents take it over, and the team knows how to run them.
* Creator, affiliate and social media programs run on clear processes, with samples, content, rights and results tracked end to end.

* New hires join prepared pods with the right access and onboarding, and leavers are offboarded cleanly. External partners follow clear delivery processes.

**Requirements**

What we're looking for

* Experience owning marketing operations, creative operations or project operations in a DTC e-commerce business or performance marketing agency.

Above all, we need someone who takes full ownership, follows through and builds systems the team can rely on.

title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] Data Intelligence Platform
description:
Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

Software engineering is being redefined. The engineers who will shape the next decade of product development are not the ones who write the most code — they are the ones who know how to think clearly, ship confidently, and use every tool available to them, including AI, to multiply their impact.

The Actian Data Intelligence Platform helps teams find, understand, and use AI-ready data under clear governance. It connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, so enterprises can turn raw data into reliable decisions — the trusted foundation that AI agents increasingly depend on to work. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Data Intelligence Platform has to deploy, operate, and pass audits in every one of the environments our customers run — public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises. We are standing up a dedicated platform team to make that possible, and we are hiring the leader who will build it.

This is a hands-on director role. You will stand up and lead a newly formed platform team, hire and grow it, and build alongside it from day one: you will design the platform services, write infrastructure code, and set the engineering standards the rest of engineering relies on.

We are an AI-first engineering organization, and in this role AI is how the work gets done. AI agents run operational tasks, AI accelerates the team's own engineering, and AI replaces tools we pay for today but no longer need. You will also build the infrastructure that runs the AI and ML workloads inside our product.

  

### **What You Will Own:**

* Platform services for the Data Intelligence Platform, including the infrastructure behind the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and the APIs that power customer integrations.
* Cloud-agnostic deployment of the Platform across AWS, a second public cloud (Azure or Google Cloud), and customer on-premises and private-cloud environments — including packaging, installation, upgrades, and supportability.
* The internal developer platform and CI/CD, including GitOps delivery, so engineering teams ship safely and quickly.
* Security operations and compliance evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR — including EU data residency — in partnership with the security team.
* Cloud cost management and FinOps, with clear cost visibility and accountability across every environment.
* Infrastructure for the AI and ML workloads used by the Platform.
* Observability, reliability, and incident response for the services the team runs, including the team's on-call rotation.
* Building and growing the team — hiring platform engineers, setting the operating model, and establishing the standards and rituals the team works by.

### **What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:**

* High-functioning platform team: an operating model in place, and clear ownership boundaries with the product engineering teams you serve.
* Portable, cloud-agnostic deployments: one deployment model that runs the Platform on AWS, on at least one other cloud, and on customer infrastructure — defined as code and delivered through GitOps.
* AI agents running operations: agents that handle routine operational work — triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting — with measurable reductions in manual effort and a smaller tool footprint.
* Platform foundations for the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and integration APIs: scalable, observable infrastructure that product teams build on.
* Compliance automation and audit readiness: evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR collected automatically from the platform rather than assembled by hand before each audit.

### **We expect this leader to treat AI as part of the platform. That means you will:**

* Design and run AI agents that operate infrastructure under clear guardrails — human approval for high-risk changes, and full audit trails.
* Review our current tooling and retire tools that AI agents or simpler automation can replace, with a cost and risk case for each change.
* Use AI coding and operations assistants in your own daily work, and set the standard for how the team uses them.
* Build the compute, data, and access patterns that let AI and ML workloads run reliably in every environment we support.

### **What You Bring:**

* 10+ years in platform engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, including 3+ years managing engineers — with experience building or scaling a team, not only running an established one.
* AI-first mindset, making extensive use of this technology for accelerating developments.
* A track record of shipping on-premises or self-hosted software that customers install and run in their own environments.
* Deep, hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production, infrastructure as code (Terraform/Terragrunt), and GitOps delivery with Argo CD or similar tooling.
* Strong AWS experience, and the judgment to design for portability rather than lock-in to a single cloud.
* Hands-on experience operating systems under SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR controls, including data-residency requirements.
* Experience managing cloud costs and making cost trade-offs explicit to engineering and business leaders.
* Clear written communication, suited to a fully remote team across US and EU time zones.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience running infrastructure for data platforms, data catalogs, or graph databases.
* Production experience on Azure or Google Cloud in addition to AWS.
* Experience with air-gapped or restricted-network customer deployments.
* Experience building infrastructure for AI and ML workloads, including model serving and vector or graph data stores.
* Observability with OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling, from instrumentation through alerting.
* Privileged access management with StrongDM or a comparable tool.

### **What We Value:**

We value autonomy over process, outcomes over activity, and builders over theorists. This role suits someone who thrives when handed a hard problem, a team to build, and the space to figure it out — and who uses every tool available, including AI, to multiply the team's impact.

### **How You Will Work:**

You will report to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with product engineering, security, customer success, and support. The role is fully remote from the US, UK, Spain, France or Germany, with at least four hours a day of overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time. Expect occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings.

### **What We Offer:**

* The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
* Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.

**Why Join Us?** At Actian, we are passionate about innovation and teamwork. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves creating an efficient and welcoming workspace, and enjoys working closely with a talented team.

**Interested?** We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us.

title: Applied AI Course Author
description:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. Brand:
  
TripleTen

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!**

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**The team**
------------

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

**About the role**
------------------

* **What you'll do and for whom.** You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.
* **Where you'll work.** You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.
* **What success looks like.** In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the service that product teams build on.** Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.
* **Own the persistence layer.** Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.
* **Scale BLP for large enterprises.** Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.
* **Own email, in and out.** Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.
* **Make setup self-service.** Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.
* **Work with customers.** Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.
* **Own it end-to-end.** From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

**Tech stack:** Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

**We're excited about you because**
-----------------------------------

* You have **4+ years of experience as a software engineer**, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.
* You have **2+ years of professional Go experience**, writing services that run in production, not side projects.
* You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.
* You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.
* You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.
* You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.
* You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.
* You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

**Strong plus**
---------------

* Experience with *distributed systems*, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).
* Experience running multi-tenant systems.
* Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

**What you'll get**

* **Ownership of visible outcomes.** The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.
* **Impact at scale.** Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.
* **Senior scope from day one.** You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

title: Market Development Manager — EMEA
description:
#### **About the Role:**

Hearing care is consolidating. Regional chains are becoming national ones, national ones are going multi-country, and most of them are still running on software that cannot take them there. Auditdata already powers the largest groups in the industry. The question this role answers is which markets and which companies come next.

As Market Development Manager you own how Auditdata enters and grows beyond its established accounts across EMEA: which markets are worth opening, which chains are worth pursuing, and what it takes to get in. You will shape that view with the VP EMEA and then go and prove it in the market yourself. This is a build role, working alongside the people who actually decide — no layers to push through, no waiting for permission.

**Your mandate:**

* **Market selection:** build the commercial case for where Auditdata expands next and turn it into a prioritised target map across EMEA.
* **Market entry:** create the first real pipeline in countries where we have no presence and close the deals that establish us there.
* **Demand:** turn interest into qualified opportunity across the region and make sure what we generate matches what we have decided to go after.

Who you work with the VP EMEA on strategy and prioritisation, the VP Marketing as an equal partner on campaigns and account-based programmes against your target map, the Account Managers and Account Executives when an opportunity grows into an enterprise cycle. Pre-sales and customer success are yours to call on. Product Management is your partner in crime for shaping how to enter new markets.

#### **What You Will Do:**

* Build the EMEA target map: enter new markets, new chains, new segments, and provide the reasoning for pursuing each.
* EMEA wide inbound & outbound motions: prioritise what is important vs urgent, you are the owner of your own success across the region.
* Open conversations at the owner, operations and clinical leadership levels in companies that do not yet know us.
* Carry and close your own quota of Enterprise & mid-market deals, within your EMEA territory.
* Partner with marketing on positioning, campaign design and follow-up, so demand generation and direct outreach pull in the same direction.
* Bring the market back into the business: what competitors are doing, what buyers are asking for, where the product needs to go.
* Keep HubSpot as the single source of truth, and own a pipeline forecast the business can plan on.

#### **What You Bring:**

* 3+ years generating pipeline and winning new logos in B2B software or medtech, with success cases you are proud of.
* Proven ability to build a target market from scratch rather than work a list handed to you.
* Commercial judgement: you can argue why one market or account deserves our attention over another.
* Comfort with CRM and modern prospecting and automation tooling; HubSpot is a plus.
* Fluent English plus one additional European language - German, Dutch, French, Italian or Spanish.
* Curiosity about healthcare and a willingness to learn the audiology domain properly.
* A self-directed mindset: you will be creating this territory, not inheriting it.

#### **What’s in It for You:**

* Remote-first and async-friendly with a flat organizational structure.
* A modern IT environment: leading AI tools, HubSpot CRM and the means to automate your go-to-market.
* A real career path and leadership track, with development and certification support.
* A global, diverse team across 30+ nationalities.
* A product held to ISO 13485 and EU MDR, and a mission that matters: do this well and more people hear better, sooner.

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

We look forward to your application! (***please submit your CV in English and a few lines on why this role interests you***)

*Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create a diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.*

Cyprus / Worldwide – Remote (Any Location) · Full-Time · Research Center

We are looking for a Deputy Chief Data Officer for the Research Center of the Core Business Unit — the #2 role in a data function that directly drives company P&L.

We see the Deputy CDO as a full-fledged successor to the CDO: a leader who can take over the function when needed. Together, the CDO and the Deputy CDO make sure we do the right things and that these things reach measurable results fast and predictably. The Deputy CDO owns execution across the function, leads part of the strategic initiatives personally and works directly with C-level executives. This is not a chief of staff or program manager role: we need a leader who goes deep into the substance of analytics, ML, data engineering, marketing analytics, UX research and experimentation, and turns strategy into business results.

**Your main tasks will be:**

* Lead part of the Research Center's strategic initiatives end-to-end — from business case and prioritization to delivery and measurable impact.
* Work directly with C-level executives and business heads: align priorities, commitments and trade-offs, negotiate resources and timelines with clear, numbers-based arguments.
* Own the execution of key cross-functional initiatives across the Research Center: data platform and BigQuery migration, ML projects with complex dependencies, experimentation process, AI for analytics, UX research, data quality / SLA / freshness.
* Unblock stalled projects: when work is stuck between teams or has no clear owner, define scope, owners, next steps and blockers, escalate early and drive it to delivery.
* Manage resources and backlog across teams: prioritize by business value, allocate capacity, manage dependencies between ML, backend, product and analytics, stop or rethink initiatives that don't deliver.
* Build and run the operating system of the function: monthly reviews, quarterly planning, project reviews, retros, commitment tracking, escalation process and a single status dashboard — working with or without any single person.
* Measure everything in business terms: translate initiatives into numbers, benefits and expected impact; track ROI and results against plan; make sure “we shipped the task” is never mistaken for “the business changed”.
* Strengthen the team leads (Product Analytics, Data Engineering, ML, UX Research): help them set goals, prioritize, give honest feedback and grow as managers.
* Own the operational health of the function: data freshness, platform uptime, ML platform stability, delivery predictability and experimentation throughput.

**We expect from you:**

* 7+ years in data, analytics or ML in product tech companies, including 4+ years in leadership roles managing strong specialists and team leads.
* Experience as a CDO, Deputy CDO or Head of Data / Analytics in a mid-size or large product organization is highly desirable.
* Readiness and ambition to grow into the CDO role: strategic thinking combined with the willingness to own day-to-day execution.
* A broad understanding of all Research Center domains: product and marketing analytics, A/B testing and experimentation, the ML lifecycle from idea to production, data platforms, data quality and SLA, BI / self-service, unit economics. Hands-on depth in at least one of them.
* Proven track record of execution: concrete examples of delivering complex cross-functional data / ML projects to measurable results.
* Strong operational management skills: project decomposition, planning, resource and backlog management, risk management, clean escalation, running many parallel initiatives.
* Business leader mindset: thinks in numbers, benefits and business impact; understands trade-offs between speed, quality, value and risk; always asks “what changed for the business?”.
* Experience working with and negotiating with C-level executives: confident, precise with numbers, persuasive through facts.
* Influence without formal authority: earns trust through competence and results; able to push hard and handle conflict without becoming toxic.
* Systematic, disciplined and persistent; comfortable with ambiguity and multitasking.
* Fluent Russian and English are a must.

**What do we offer:**

* REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full time;
* The initial pay level or pay range for this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before the commencement of employment;
* Vacation 28 calendar days per year;
* 7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave;
* Compensation of kindergarten or school fees for your child;
* Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company;
* 50% payment for professional training, international conferences and meetings;
* Corporate discount for English language lessons;
* Health benefits. According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor's fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children);

In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years;

Sounds good? Join us now!

title: Product Manager
description:
### **About our Crew**

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy. We spend each day surrounded by 500,000 boats from across the globe!

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

To support this growth, we're hiring a **Product Manager, Monetization & Compliance** to join our Product team in Barcelona.

### **The role**

We're looking for a Product Manager with a strong business mindset to own our **monetization and compliance roadmap**. You will identify and ship the right opportunities to grow our **revenue and contribution margin**, while keeping the product compliant on **tax and invoicing**.

You'll own the strategy and the priorities, while delivery is run by your squad and its Engineering Manager. You'll work closely with **finance, data, legal and operations**, with regular exposure to our leadership team, and play a central role in meeting our revenue and margin targets.

**The Product team at Click&Boat: 4 Product Managers**, 1 Head of Product, 1 VP product organized into squads, each dedicated to a specific functional scope. Together, they deliver a first-class experience to our users: boat owners, renters, and Click&Boat's internal teams.

### **What floats your boat**

* **Build a point of view:** you develop strong convictions on where we can grow revenue, and where Click&Boat should place its bets (pricing, fees, payments, upsells, checkout).
* **Vision & Roadmap:** you align the leadership team around a clear product vision, then turn it into a 3 to 6 month roadmap and concrete priorities that help your squad deliver maximum value against our OKRs.
* **Compliance by design:** you make sure tax, invoicing and regulatory requirements are built into the product, partnering with finance and legal to turn constraints into clean, scalable solutions.
* **Data-driven decisions:** you analyze quantitative and qualitative data to size opportunities, measure revenue impact and learn from every release.
* **Decision making:** you're comfortable deciding with 40 to 70% of the information, using data to guide you without waiting for perfect certainty.
* **Fail fast, learn fast:** you promote rapid iterations, A/B tests and continuous improvement, always with a "user first" approach.

### **What you bring aboard**

* Significant experience as a Product Manager, regardless of the scope.
* You are both strategic and hands-on: able to define a monetization strategy and a long-term roadmap, while still going deep into a checkout experiment or a revenue metric when needed.
* A strong business and data mindset, with decisions grounded in solid analysis.
* Structure and excellent prioritization: you manage your time and stakeholders effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication: you justify your decisions with clarity and confidence, from squads to top management.
* You embrace feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.
* Fluent or bilingual in English.

**Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)**

* Experience in a marketplace, tech or B2C company.
* Experience in pricing, payments, or regulated features (tax, invoicing), with a measurable revenue impact.
* Fluency in French and/or Spanish.

### **The hiring journey**

* HR call with Talent Acquisition,
* Interview with the Product team,
* Management interview with a case study to assess your skills and alignment with our values: leadership, strategic thinking, learn & grow.
* Final Interview with Nicolas, our CTPO

We aim to keep things smooth, transparent, and respectful of your time throughout the process.

### **️** **What awaits you on board**

* A high-impact scope, directly tied to Click&Boat's revenue and margin, with direct exposure to top management;
* Personal and professional development in a fast-growing, multicultural team;
* 8 additional days off;
* Lunch vouchers (Cobee);
* Gym partnerships (Wellhub);
* PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;
* Breakfast every Tuesday morning;
* A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20-minute walk from the sea;
* Team-building activities;
* Hybrid role based in Barcelona (3 days per week at the office), with 3 days per month spent in Paris, around 6 to 9 trips per year.

**Contract:** Permanent position

**Start date:** ASAP

### **Ready to join?**

If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit the "apply to this job" button.

Remember, even if you don't meet every requirement, you might still be a great match for us! And yes, we're especially talking to women here: science says that you are less likely to apply if you don't meet them all. So go for it, we'd love to hear from you.

At Click&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We hire for talent, drive, and mindset. The sea is open to all.

### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

### **Job responsibilities**

  

**Your role will be:**

* Supplier onboarding
* Conducting on-site social compliance audits of suppliers and manufacturing partners
* Assessing supplier compliance with the LVMH Code of Conduct
* Identifying potential risks within the supply chain and documenting irregularities
* Analyzing risk patterns and trends across the supply chain
* Developing and implementing Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) programs in collaboration with other departments

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience as a Social Auditor in an international audit firm
* Certification: certified by recognized auditing bodies (e.g.: SA8000, SMETA, APSCA)
* Knowledge of labor legislation and human rights regulations
* Ethical judgment, risk assessment, data verification, and compliance evaluation across social, environmental, and governance areas
* C1 level of English and Spanish
* Willingness to travel

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

* Partner with Paid Media to identify organic content amplification opportunities and align paid and organic initiatives.
* Support testing of new formats, creative approaches, and platform features.

**Hard Skills**

* Proven experience managing organic social media channels for international or global brands, including content planning, editorial calendar management and publishing.
* Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Instagram and TikTok, including platform-specific content formats, best practices and audience behavior.
* Previous experience or demonstrated working knowledge of Asian social media platforms, particularly WeChat, Xiaohongshu (RED), Weibo, Douyin, LINE and/or KakaoTalk.
* Experience coordinating content calendars, campaigns and social media activities across multiple markets or regional teams.
* Strong ability to identify social media trends and translate them into relevant content concepts, creative directions and actionable briefs.
* Proven experience collaborating with Creative and Content teams on content ideation, briefing, development and execution.
* Strong understanding of social-first storytelling, short-form video formats and platform-specific creative best practices.
* Ability to assess creative content from both a brand positioning and social media performance perspective.
* Experience with social media management, scheduling, listening and analytics tools.
* Strong understanding of organic social media KPIs and performance reporting.
* Awareness of digital culture, emerging social media trends and luxury industry best practices.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong creative instinct and refined aesthetic sensibility, with a deep understanding of luxury brand codes.
* Ability to translate social media insights into relevant creative opportunities.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple content streams, deadlines and stakeholders.
* Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership of projects.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, particularly in multicultural and international environments.
* Ability to balance creative thinking with operational excellence and attention to detail.
* Curious, culturally aware and passionate about social media, luxury, beauty and digital storytelling.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Approachable, inclusive and collaborative.

**Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communication, Digital Media or similar
* 2–4 years of experience in social media, digital marketing
* Demonstrated experience managing editorial calendars and coordinating social media content across multiple markets.
* Previous experience developing content concepts and creative briefs in collaboration with Creative and Content teams.
* Experience or strong familiarity with Asian social media ecosystems, with an understanding of how content strategies and platform dynamics differ from Western markets.
* Experience in luxury, fragrance, fashion or lifestyle brands is highly valued.
* Proven examples of social media projects demonstrating editorial planning, creative ideation and collaboration with creative teams.
* Fluent English, written and spoken. Spanish is highly valuable; additional languages, particularly Asian languages, are a plus.

### **Additional information**

*LOEWE Perfumes represents the organic part of LOEWE. We are the unique Maison that crafts* *collectable botanical art pieces* *connected with nature in its purest form.*

*LOEWE Perfumes respects diversity and promotes inclusion from its recruitment process. We are committed to create an integrative working environment where all talents and singularities are engaged and valued.*

***LOEWE PERFUMES*** 
**MAISON**
--------------------------------

LOEWE Perfumes adds a multisensory dimension to LOEWE via a kaleidoscopic range of iconic fragrances for men, for women and for the home that combine vibrant, nature-inspired olfactory experiences with bold visual expression.
  
In 1972, LOEWE launched its first women’s fragrance: L de Loewe. Because of its success, the House began investing in international perfumery retail. LOEWE Perfumes has kept sustaining the brand’s Spanish legacy, artisanal savoir-faire and innovative spirit guided, since 2013, by the creative vision of Jonathan Anderson, LOEWE’s Creative Director, in partnership with in-house perfumier, Nuria Cruelles.
  
Encompassing the Botanical Rainbow—nine iconic fragrance families that translate the depth and variety of Nature’s inspiration into the medium of perfume—and LOEWE Home Scents—twelve plant portraits capturing the authentic essences of a vegetable garden—plus the ever-expanding, hedonistic Paula’s Ibiza fragrance families and the Un Paseo Por Madrid collection, LOEWE Perfumes creates a multisensory kaleidoscope of colour, scent and emotion, inspired by nature.

title: Client Data & Insight Manager
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

Are you passionate about client behaviour, data and luxury fashion? Join LOEWE as a Client Data & Insight Manager and turn client data into insights that help shape business decisions across our global organisation. Working closely with global and regional teams, you will identify trends, uncover opportunities and translate data into clear recommendations that help us better understand our clients and strengthen business performance.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Analyse client data from different sources to identify trends, understand client behaviour and uncover business opportunities.

* Monitor client performance across markets, collections and client segments, delivering regular reports, dashboards and ad hoc analyses.

* Ensure the quality and reliability of client data, KPIs and reporting, helping teams make informed decisions with confidence.

* Turn complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations that support commercial, CRM, clienteling and strategic priorities.

* Prepare and present insights to senior management and key stakeholders, adapting your message to different audiences.

* Partner with global and regional teams to understand business needs and provide relevant insights that support decision-making.

* Connect data with market trends, client expectations and local specificities to identify opportunities for business improvement.

* Contribute to a more data-driven culture by sharing best practices, improving reporting approaches and exploring new tools and methodologies.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* A degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field. A Master's degree or MBA is a plus.

* Significant experience in data analytics, client insights, business intelligence or a similar role, ideally within luxury, fashion, retail or consumer-focused industries.

* Strong experience in client behaviour analysis, performance reporting and data visualisation.

* Solid SQL skills and experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI. Knowledge of BigQuery is a plus.

* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work confidently with large datasets and translate findings into business recommendations.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex information clear and relevant to different audiences.

* A collaborative and proactive mindset, with the ability to work autonomously, manage priorities and build relationships with stakeholders across regions and functions.

* A genuine interest in luxury, fashion, client behaviour and cultural differences across markets.

* Fluent English is required; Spanish is a strong plus.

### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

Job Description:

**Job Title:** Administrative Case Manager & Accessibility Liaison

**Start Date:** January 7 or as soon as possible

**Department:** Student Affairs, Diversity & Inclusion

**Reports to:** Valencia Director of Student Affairs, Diversity and Inclusion

**Location:** Valencia, Spain (On-site)

**Contract type:** Full time position

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday, 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM CET

**Reports To:** Valencia Director of Student Affairs, Diversity and Inclusion

**Position Overview**

Reporting to the Director of Student Affairs, Diversity and Inclusion, the Administrative Case Manager works in consultation and collaboration with internal and external partners to assist students in accessing support for health and wellness related concerns and navigating barriers to success. This position provides 1:1 consultation with students, and supports essential functions related to interventions with students of concern.

The position includes coordination with various resources in Valencia (and Boston when applicable) as well as with external resources (e.g. contracted counseling service providers, health insurance, contracted health care providers).

The position operates strictly within an administrative, non-clinical scope, focusing on triage, documentation, compliance, and cross-departmental coordination to ensure student success and campus safety. While this is not a clinical position, sensitivity, judgment, and respect for confidentiality is required. The successful candidate will facilitate support for students/parents/family members during both urgent and non-urgent situations, many of which involve mental and physical challenges. The Administrative Case Manager helps ensure appropriate care and follow-up for students in need of additional resources, helping to coordinate a comprehensive plan of care with appropriate colleagues across multiple units of the College.

In addition to primary shift duties, **this position participates in the campus administrator on-call rotation**, serving as a key escalation point for after-hours student health, safety, and psychological emergencies.

Additionally, this position is the primary campus liaison to Boston’s Accessibility Resources for Students, who determines reasonable academic, housing, and dietary accommodations. The position is responsible for connecting students to the Boston team and ensuring reasonable accommodations are implemented for students studying at Berklee Valencia.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Administrative Case Manager:

* Review and provide outreach to student concerns submitted as Health and Wellness Early Alerts and other incident reports; engage appropriate parties in the response where necessary.
* Apply standardized non-clinical behavioral threat assessment frameworks and related tools to provide and advise on appropriate interventions.
* Support the Director as the operational coordinator for the CARES Team, managing workflows in student database, liaising directly with the Valencia Director for Student Affairs
* Maintain accurate, timely documentation case management records and ensure compliance with both US higher education standards (FERPA/Title IX principles) and applicable local Spanish/EU data protection laws (GDPR).

* Coordinate safety plans, behavioral risk assessments, emergency communications, and multi-departmental support (e.g., accessibility services, residence hall staff, medical assistance team, and/or other community resources) across varying levels of student concern.
* Communicate with parents/family members, academic colleagues, and other necessary partners to assist with coordinated plans and management of student concerns.
* Coordinate emergency coordination with local healthcare providers, emergency services, and medical assistance vendors, facilitate re-entry plans upon a hospital discharge. Coordinate with the director on applying voluntary and mandatory leave policies.
* **On-Call Duty Rotation:** Serve in the administrative on-call rotation (nights, weekends, and holidays as scheduled) to coordinate response to urgent student crises, hospitalizations, or high-risk incidents outside regular working hours.
* Establish and maintain relationships with local English- and Spanish-speaking therapists, psychiatrists, hospitals, and social service agencies across the local health network.
* Oversee physical stocking and organisation of food pantry, collecting and analyzing data on its use.
* Serve as acting lead for student support matters when the Director of SADI is off-site.

Accessibility Liaison (Boston Office Partnership):

* Serve as the designated Valencia campus liaison to the Accessibility Resources for Students office in Boston, ensuring approved reasonable accommodations are implemented on the Valencia campus in alignment with institutional accommodation policies.
* Meet with students requesting academic, housing, or dietary accommodations; assist in gathering documentation; and facilitating the accommodation determination process by the Boston ARS Office
* Partner with local academic and operational leadership and faculty to; ensure approved reasonable accommodations are implemented, resolve academic, housing and dietary barriers, and advocate for universal design principles on campus.

Other duties as assigned.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Education:** Master’s degree in Social Work, Higher Education Administration, Student Affairs, Public Health, or a related field.
* **Professional Experience:** 5-7 years of progressive professional experience in higher education, student affairs, student risk management, or case management.
* Certified (or certified within a reasonable period of time upon hire) with National Association of Behavioral Intervention and Threat Assessment (NABITA) risk assessment tool. (Berklee would sponsor NABITA trainings if successful candidate is not certified prior to hire)
* **Language Proficiency:**
  + **English:** Native or full professional fluency (C1 level) — primary working language for student support, documentation and Boston coordination.
  + **Spanish:** Working professional/conversational proficiency (minimum B1/B2, preferred C1) to navigate local medical systems, emergency responders, and community providers during standard shifts or on-call incidents.
* **Schedule & On-Call Availability:** Ability to work standard shift hours of 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM CET, and willingness to carry an emergency on-call phone (including evenings, weekends and holidays). Must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of campus/local emergency facilities during on-call shifts.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

* Experience with coordinating response to complex student emergencies, ideally in an international setting.
* Excellent technology skills or proficiency in Maxient case management software or similar platforms.
* International / Cross-Cultural Background: Direct experience working within international higher education, study abroad programs, or multi-cultural student environments.
* Direct experience working as an Accessibility / Disability Services liaison or specialist in a US college or university setting.
* Familiarity with both US higher education legal/regulatory frameworks (FERPA, Title IX, ADA/Section 504 principles) and European contexts (GDPR, local Spanish healthcare navigation).
* Prior experience in a satellite campus or global education environment bridging communication across multiple time zones.

**KEY COMPETENCES:**

* **Crisis Management & Emotional Resilience:** Calm, authoritative presence under pressure with acute problem-solving capacity during complex emergency and on-call situations.
* **Exceptional Communication and Organizational Skills:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to communicate with colleagues and service providers in Spain and Boston. Ability to document work quickly and with precision.
* **Cross-Cultural Competency:** Nuanced understanding of the challenges faced by US and international students living abroad / attending a US-accredited institution in Europe.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:**

In consideration of expectations to serve in an on-call capacity during evenings, weekends and holidays, while not prohibited, applicants should carefully consider these expectations before accepting or maintaining other part-time employment, before accepting an offer of employment at Berklee. Part-time employment shall not be conducted during work hours for Berklee.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

Managers are responsible for maintaining an environment that is free from discrimination, intimidation, coercion or harassment, including sexual harassment. Work is performed indoors and primarily in an office setting. The noise level is usually low to moderate. While performing the duties of this position, the employee may be required to travel.

description:
**Introduction**

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Internal and external candidates will be considered for this vacancy.

For the purposes of this vacancy, internal candidates are defined as staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded or ungraded contract, including Junior Professional Officers (JPOs), UN Volunteers with at least twelve (12) months of continuous service in IOM, staff on Special Leave Without Pay (SLWOP), and staff members on secondment/loan released by the Organization, unless otherwise specified in their contract. Staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded contract will not retain their contract type if appointed to an ungraded position.

**Organizational Context and Scope**

The ICT Officer Identity and Access Management will lead own and evolve the identity and access management (IDAM) ecosystem. The role will be the gatekeeper for the digital identity landscape, ensuring the right people (and devices) get the right access, at the right time, for the right reasons.

The role will be responsible for the design, implementation, and support of the identity orchestration using One Identity - Identity Manager (IDM), integrated with Microsoft Active Directory, Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID), and HR-driven lifecycle events via the Oracle ERP (WAVE).

The ICT Officer (Identity and Access Management) must understand the art and science of automating access, enforcing least privilege, and reducing identity-related risks.
  
Under the leadership of the Director of Information and Communications Technology (ICT) / Chief Information Officer and reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, the ICT Officer Identity and Access Management (IDAM) is responsible for the identity and access management function within ICT.

  

Responsibilities: IDENTITY AND ACCESS MANAGEMENT  
  
Design, configure, and maintain One Identity - Identity Manager (IDM) for user lifecycle management, provisioning, and role-based access control.  
Integrate identity data from the WAVE ERP system to drive Joiner/Mover/Leaver (JML) processes.  
Manage synchronization and identity federation between Microsoft Active Directory and Azure Active Directory (Entra ID).  
Define and implement access governance, including role modelling, segregation of duties (SoD), and access review campaigns.  
Develop automated workflows for account provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement management across all ICT platforms.  
Collaborate with HR, Information Security, and Compliance teams to enforce identity related policies.  
Enforce Just-In-Time (JIT) access for sensitive operations.  
Monitor and respond to identity-related incidents and service requests.  
Create and maintain IAM documentation including architecture diagrams, SOPs, and audit records.  
Supervise the IAM team and conduct effective performance management and promote a cooperative work environment.  
  
MICROSOFT ACTIVE DIRECTORY AND ENTRA ID

Define entitlement management with access packages for joiners/movers/leavers.  
Enforce naming conventions and OU placement standards.  
Manage service accounts with lifecycle governance (preferably with expiration controls).  
Manage access using Azure AD roles, administrative units, and custom roles.  
Assign privileged roles via Privileged Identity Management (PIM) with time-bound or approval-based access.  
Define Conditional Access Policies based on risk, device, location, and user sensitivity.  
Enforce MFA using built-in Entra policies.  
Enable the publishing and management of SaaS apps using SAML, OAuth, or OIDC for Single Sign-On (SSO).  
Configure provisioning connectors to automate account creation in cloud apps.  
Build processes to enforce user consent restrictions to limit data exposure to risky apps.  
Create and maintain procedures for maintenance of security groups and distribution lists.  
Implement and enforce role-based access control (RBAC) through group nesting and inheritance.  
Periodically review and clean up stale groups and memberships and establish access review campaigns for groups, apps, and privileged roles across regional offices.  
  
ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES  
  
Provide input for the license entitlements and ensure correct integration with FinOps and licensing portals.  
* Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

  

Qualifications: Education  
  
Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or,  
University degree in the above fields with seven years of relevant professional experience.  
The following certifications are required.  
Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300).  
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).  
Must attain and maintain ITIL version 4 Foundation certification and CISSP.  
One Identity - Identity Manager Foundations (#IM-FND) certification is an advantage.
