Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database .  
  
Experience  
  
A minimum of 5 years of experience in Identity & Access Management, IT Security, or related infrastructure engineering roles.  
Hands-on experience with One Identity - Identity Manager (strongly preferred).  
Solid proficiency in Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy, and Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID).  
Experience in integrating IAM solutions with ERP systems for automated provisioning (e.g. SAP, Oracle).  
Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect).  
Experience implementing RBAC, ABAC, and SoD controls.  
Strong scripting ability (PowerShell, SQL, or similar) for automating IAM workflows.  
  
Skills

title: Head of Customer Service (all genders)
description:
Málaga, Spain

Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

**Your future team**

As Head of Customer Service, you'll lead Holidu's Customer Happiness front line from our Málaga office: 3 in-house Team Leads, almost 40 in-house advisors, and 150+ partner advisors. You may initially lead one market team directly while we complete the Team Lead bench.

You'll report to the Director of Customer Happiness and work alongside our enablement teams whose job is to equip the front line to succeed. We're at a turning point: we're moving to a new case management platform, rethinking how we measure performance, and redesigning how our teams work together. You'll be one of the people shaping it.

**What you will do**

**Own front-line performance**

* Own the results of our internal and external handling teams: resolution, customer satisfaction, response and resolution times, and productivity
* Set clear expectations, run a weekly performance rhythm with your Team Leads and partners, and act fast when results slip
* Make the tough calls when needed - on performance, staffing and priorities

**Lead the leaders**

* Manage, coach and develop our Team Leads in Málaga, building a leadership team that sets a high standard and holds each other accountable
* Potentially lead one market team directly at first, and stay close to the work by regularly handling cases yourself
* Build a culture of ownership, independent judgement, and pride in the work, with a clear development path for advisors from junior to senior

**Get the best out of our partners**

* Share accountability with our Workforce Management team for partner performance: help define performance targets, train and coach partner teams on their floors, and funnel partner feedback to our enablement teams so root causes get fixed
* Spend time on site with them, review quality together, and reduce escalations that bounce back to the in-house team
* Contribute to partner selection, onboarding and incentive design

**Fix how we work**

* Spot and remove friction on the front line: unnecessary escalations, duplicated work and outdated processes
* Be the operational voice in the rollout of our new case management platform, making sure workflows reflect how cases are really handled
* Bring coaching back to the floor - buddy systems and hands-on onboarding - so new advisors and partner staff get up to speed fast and continuously improve
* Lead the move to a model where complex cases are solved end to end by our in-house experts, with no escalation layers

**Build bridges**

* Work as one team with our enablement functions: be clear about what the front line needs, and hold them to it
* Represent the voice of our guests and hosts in cross-functional discussions with Product, Tech, Sales and Account Management

**What success looks like**

* 30 days: you know every Team Lead, have handled cases in each queue, and have spent time with our partners
* 90 days: shared targets are agreed with Team Leads and partners, a weekly performance rhythm is running, and first quick wins are delivered
* 6 months: measurable improvement in cost per resolved case, CSAT, escalation rates, a stronger Team Lead bench, and all advisors performing to a higher standard

**What you bring**

* 8+ years of experience in customer service or customer operations, of which 4+ managing managers or multiple teams
* Has led an operation of 100+ people across in-house and outsourced teams
* A proven track record of turning around team performance, with measurable gains in both productivity and quality
* Experience managing outsourced support partners (BPOs) on performance and quality
* A leader who sets a high bar and holds people to it, while genuinely caring about their growth - you help your teams meet expectations rather than shield them from them
* Hands-on: you're comfortable stepping onto the floor and handling cases yourself
* Strong with data - you use KPIs to find root causes and drive action, not just to report
* Experience leading teams through change - new tools, new structures - while keeping people engaged
* Experience with complex, emotional B2C cases (eg. travel, hospitality, tour operators), not only transactional ticket queues
* AI-literate: you use AI tools in your own work, and you have run a team alongside AI agents or automation. You know where AI resolves, where it fails, and how to measure it.
* Fluent English; another of our market languages (Spanish, German, Italian, French) is a plus

  

**What we offer**

* **Impact:** Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters—and you’ll see the impact.
* **Learning:** Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets—with a strong focus on AI.
* **Great People:** Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts—people we can all relate to—making work meaningful and energizing.
* **Technology:** Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.
* **Flexibility:** Work in a hybrid setup with 50%+ in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.
* **Perks on Top:** Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized—but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.

**Life at Holidu**

Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram@lifeatholidu

* Commercial and financial acumen.

This is far more than a traditional Rooms leadership role. You will join the Executive Team responsible for launching one of Ibiza's most exciting new luxury lifestyle resorts, helping shape its guest experience, operational excellence, reputation and commercial success from day one.

If you are looking for an opportunity to leave your mark on a landmark hospitality project and create a luxury guest experience that becomes synonymous with excellence in Ibiza, we would love to hear from you.

title: Biology Lab Research Support Technician
description:
ICFO – The Institute of Photonic Sciences is a world-leading research center devoted to advancing the science and technologies of light. Based in Castelldefels, Barcelona, ICFO combines frontier research, education, innovation and technology transfer to generate scientific and societal impact.

Over the past two decades, ICFO has established itself as an internationally recognized center of excellence and a global reference in photonics. Today, with a highly international community of around 500 employees representing more than 70 nationalities, ICFO continues its institutional development aimed at strengthening scientific excellence, organizational effectiveness and long-term impact.

As a public research institution, ICFO is governed by a Board of Trustees and led by an Executive Leadership comprising the Director and the Managing Director, who are responsible for the scientific, strategic and operational development of the Institute.

ICFO is seeking a **Biology Lab Research Support Technician** to join its Biology Lab.

**Position Overview**

The main responsibilities of the Biology Lab Technician will have two components:

* operation and organization of the Laboratories and common areas of the Unit, and
* provide support to the research activity of Lab users.

**Key Responsibilities**

The main responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to) the following:

1. Supporting tasks in the management of the Facility:

* Assist in the registration, control and maintenance of the inventory of biological samples (mammalian cells, microorganisms, worms, model organisms, antibodies, etc.) of the Unit.
* Assist in the purchasing process, registration, supervision and maintenance of the inventory of laboratory consumables, media, reagents and chemicals, safeguarding their correct handling and storage.
* Organization and service of laboratory equipment as well as the glassware and plastic items.
* Handling and management of the biological and chemical waste generated in the Unit.
* Assist with the permanent training activities to Biology Lab users regarding safety and biosafety regulations.
* Assist with the permanent training activities regarding the use of equipment, handling of biological samples and chemicals,
* Development, implementation and vigilance of routine protocols oriented to ensuring the correct handling and disposal of biological and chemical waste generated in the Lab.

  
2.- Research support responsibilities:
  

* Perform routine culture and maintenance of mammalian cell lines, microorganisms and other model organisms.
* Perform routine breeding tasks and basic research procedures involving living animals.
* Assist in tasks related to the preparation and sterilization of culture media, buffers, reagents and additives.
* Perform routine protocols of classic and last generation biochemistry and molecular biology techniques for cloning, extraction, purification and characterization of DNA and proteins.
* Preparation of samples for high-resolution microscopy and nanoscopy techniques.
* Perform routine tasks related to the culture, handling and storage of C. elegans and other model organisms.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Minimum bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences (Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or similar).
* Updated official credential to work with experimental living animals (Projects and Procedures Design Function. RD 53/2013).
* Minimum B2 English Level.
* Minimum 2+ year experience in a similar position, preferably in an international research and/or academic environment.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience in classical and last generation biochemistry and molecular biology techniques.
* Hands-on experience in microorganisms and mammalian cell culture techniques.
* Hands-on experience in model organisms (mainly C. elegans) culture and handling.
* Hands-on experience in preparation of biological samples for microscopy and nanoscopy techniques.
* Experience in breeding and handling living animals, as well as experience in performing basic procedures involving living animals (euthanasia, surgery, dissection, etc.)

**Personal Competencies**

The successful candidates will demonstrate:

* Service orientation, initiative, proactivity, attention to detail, organizational commitment, and teamwork mentality.
* Strong organizational, planning and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-evolving international research environment.
* Strong communication skills.

**What ICFO Offers**

At ICFO, we offer the opportunity to contribute to the scientific, strategic and organizational development of one of the world’s leading research institutions.

The position provides:

* a highly stimulating and international research environment;
* meaningful responsibility and autonomy;
* competitive conditions commensurate with experience and qualifications;
* a unique location in Barcelona, one of Europe’s leading scientific, cultural and innovation hubs.

**Equal Opportunity**

ICFO is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based solely on merit and potential, regardless of gender, nationality, or disability. ICFO fully endorses the European Charter for Researchers and Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers, ensuring a transparent and supportive recruitment process.

**Conditions**

The contract offered will be a permanent contract for scientific and technical activities (ACT).
  
This is a full-time position.
  
A probationary period of 6 months will apply, in accordance with ICFO’s internal labor regulations and the applicable public-sector labor framework.
  
A salary according to ICFO’s approved salary scales will be offered, commensurate with the level of the position and the candidate’s experience.

**Application Process**

To apply, please submit your:

* resume,
* a cover letter outlining your experience,
* contact information for 2 professional references.

Applications should be submitted via the ICFOjobs platform http://jobs.icfo.eu.

The selection process is conducted in accordance with ICFO’s Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment (OTM-R) Policy, ensuring equal opportunities, transparency, and fair treatment for all applicants. Candidates are assessed exclusively on the basis of their qualifications, experience, skills, achievements, and potential in relation to the requirements of the position. Further information on the recruitment principles and procedures, conflict of interest and the appeals mechanism available to candidates, can be found in the OTM-R Policy.

The selection process will consist of:

1. Eligibility check of applications
  
2. Assessment of merits (education, experience, and language)
  
3. Written test for pre-selected candidates to assess technical knowledge related to the job position
  
4. Interview with shortlisted candidates

The Evaluation Committee will include at least three members and ensure gender balance and impartiality.

Each phase will be documented, and candidates will be notified of the outcome within 15 days of the interview.

**Data Protection**

In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Organic Law 3/2018, ICFO informs applicants that their personal data will be processed exclusively for recruitment purposes.

* Solid understanding of optimization technologies and AI-driven processes, workflow automation, and performance outcomes.

description:
**Job**
-------

Producer

**Description**
---------------

**About the Company**

As the world’s leading multidisciplinary service provider, Deluxe underpins the media and entertainment industry, servicing content creators and distributors including Netflix, WarnerMedia, The Walt Disney Company, Amazon, Apple, Viacom, NBCU, Google, AT&T and many others, by providing Global Content Distribution, Localization, Accessibility and Mastering while leading end-to-end innovation with unparalleled scale and agility across the Streaming, Theatrical, Broadcast and Mobile landscapes. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices around the globe, the company employs over 3,500 of the most talented and experienced industry individuals worldwide. For more information, please visit www.bydeluxe.com

**Position**: Producer

**Full-Time, Permanent Position**

**Location:** On site - Madrid

**Hours/Shifts**: 40 hours– 3 pm – 11pm

**Position Overview**

Coordinate the day-to-day production of assigned graphics localization projects for audiovisual marketing content, including trailers, TV spots and other campaign assets. The Producer will work closely with graphics artists, account management and post-production teams to ensure that briefs are clear, work follows agreed production plans and deliverables meet the required quality standards and deadlines.

The Producer will manage assigned projects independently, working with the Senior Producer on complex requirements, competing priorities and escalations.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Manage assigned graphics localization projects from briefing through to delivery, following agreed production plans and workflows.
* Review incoming requests and ensure that source materials, instructions, specifications and deadlines are complete and clearly understood.
* Plan and monitor assigned projects within agreed priorities and resource allocations, flagging scheduling conflicts or capacity concerns early.
* Maintain clear and timely communication with internal teams and client contacts, providing updates and flagging risks or issues early.
* Track assets, versions, feedback and approvals to ensure that everyone works with the correct materials and latest instructions.
* Coordinate with subtitling, dubbing and post-production teams to ensure that localized graphics, subtitles and audio versions are aligned for final delivery.
* Coordinate reviews and quality checks, ensuring that feedback is accurately implemented and deliverables meet the agreed brief and technical requirements.
* Identify production challenges, resolve routine issues and escalate more complex problems with clear information and proposed next steps
* Keep project records and delivery trackers accurate and up to date.

**Requirements**

  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English, including the ability to communicate confidently in meetings, understand briefs and write clear project updates.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage personal workload, time and competing priorities independently.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative approach to working across teams.
* Ability to work under pressure, respond calmly to changing requirements and find efficient, practical solutions.
* Understanding of design and post-production workflows, including how graphics are created, adapted, reviewed and delivered.
* Familiarity with theatrical localization, post-production and delivery workflows, including subtitling and dubbing processes.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple assets, language versions and rounds of feedback.
* A proactive mindset, with the confidence to clarify requirements, follow up on outstanding actions and escalate issues when needed.
* Previous experience in production coordination, creative services or audiovisual post-production, with the ability to manage assigned projects independently.

**Diversity Statement**

Deluxe is committed to inclusivity, fostering an environment where every employee feels comfortable bringing their full selves to work. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against, based on race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

title: Audiovisual Producer, Commercial Video
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

Madrid, ES

En Condé Nast Commercial Creative CNCC buscamos un/a **Audiovisual Producer** con sólidos conocimientos técnicos, experiencia práctica en rodajes y una mentalidad ágil, resolutiva e innovadora.

El/La **Audiovisual Producer** supervisará la producción de contenidos audiovisuales comerciales para Vogue, GQ, Vanity Fair, AD y Condé Nast Traveler, colaborando con anunciantes de moda, lujo, belleza, viajes, cultura y estilo de vida. Buscamos un/a profesional versátil con sólidos conocimientos técnicos y experiencia práctica en rodajes para gestionar producciones de diversas escalas. El perfil ideal combinará la excelencia técnica con modelos de producción ágiles e innovadores para optimizar tiempos y presupuestos sin comprometer la calidad.

**Responsabilidades clave**

* **Producción integral:** Planificar, presupuestar y ejecutar proyectos de branded content, campañas comerciales y vídeo para redes sociales desde la preproducción hasta la entrega final.
* **Gestión de recursos y proveedores:** Definir las necesidades técnicas y humanas de cada proyecto, seleccionar proveedores y negociar con productoras y profesionales independientes (freelancers).
* **Supervisión técnica:** Controlar la ejecución en el set de rodaje, garantizando los estándares de calidad, el cumplimiento de los plazos y un estricto control presupuestario.
* **Innovación y nuevos formatos:** Explorar e integrar herramientas de inteligencia artificial, automatización y formatos social-first (vídeo vertical, podcasts, transmisiones en directo) en los flujos de trabajo.
* **Colaboración interdepartamental:** Trabajar junto a los equipos de Commercial Video, Diseño, Brand Marketing, Ventas y Delivery, aportando criterio técnico y estimaciones económicas en la fase de preventa.

**Requisitos y habilidades esenciales**

* Mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en producción audiovisual en productoras de vídeo, agencias creativas o entornos de branded content.
* Licenciatura, diplomatura en áreas relacionadas con las funciones del puesto.
* Experiencia práctica en la organización de rodajes, coordinación de equipos, gestión de presupuestos y resolución de incidencias bajo presión.
* Conocimientos técnicos sólidos en cámaras, ópticas, iluminación, sonido, flujos de trabajo de postproducción y dinámicas de grabación y realización de podcasts y videopodcasts.
* Dominio de herramientas de edición como Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects o similares.
* Comprensión profunda de los requisitos de contenido, formatos y tendencias de Instagram, TikTok y YouTube.
* Sensibilidad estética, atención al detalle, visión de negocio
* Nivel fluido de inglés para trabajar en una compañía global.

**Se valorará especialmente:**

* Trayectoria demostrable como auxiliar, coordinador/a o jefe/a de producción en proyectos digitales de pequeña, mediana y gran escala.
* Experiencia práctica en formatos de televisión digital, configuraciones multicámara, entretenimiento o retransmisiones en vivo.
* Red propia de colaboradores, profesionales y proveedores audiovisuales en España.
* La experiencia de trabajo en entornos internacionales.

**Buscamos a alguien que ame producir, que sepa resolver y que tenga ganas de encontrar nuevas y mejores formas de hacer las cosas.**

description:
Company Description

  

MET Retail is a new chapter for the group: bringing energy directly to households. We're building a technology-driven retail platform for power and gas, with a digital, customer-first model. One model, built to scale across Europe.

We're a small international team, and there's a lot to build. Join us on this exciting journey and you'll help shape how this company works, with real ownership from day one.

  

Job Description

  

He/She brings practical service knowledge into digital delivery: understanding customer, operational, commercial and regulatory needs, shaping how customers reach us and how we respond, and building a support function that is fast, compliant, measurable and AI-assisted by design rather than by retrofit.

The role covers the customer-facing layer of the end-to-end journey (from contracting to first bill, collection and service) across the contact channels, self-service area and support tooling. Spain at launch, followed by other markets such as France, Germany and Italy. The person in this role will own customer ticketing and service, customer engagement, the continuous optimisation of support including its tools, and claim management, end to end.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the business reference point for customer service, engagement and claims across the Spanish operation and, subsequently, the markets that follow
* Translate customer and regulatory objectives into clear service processes, procedures, service levels and quality standards
* Design the omnichannel service model across phone, email, chat, WhatsApp, app and self-service portal
* Build the ticketing operation: taxonomy, routing and prioritisation rules, SLA framework, escalation paths, and shift and capacity planning

title: Head of Pricing and Price-to-market
description:
Allianz Partners is seeking a globally-minded pricing leader to architect the future of RSA (Roadside Asisstance) pricing. This is a strategic, high-visibility role combining deep technical pricing expertise with innovation leadership to drive profitable growth across RSA Lines of Business worldwide.
  
Working hand-in-hand with a dedicated RSA Data team that owns reporting and harmonized portfolio monitoring, your mandate is squarely focused on pricing intelligence: building state-of-the-art rating engines, advancing modelling techniques, connecting external data ecosystems, and setting the technical direction for how Allianz Partners prices RSA risk globally.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
PRICING STRATEGY MARKET POSITIONING
  
  

* Define and own the global pricing strategy for all RSA products, translating portfolio intelligence and market dynamics into competitive, technically sound tariffs across all geographies.
* Conduct rigorous technical competitor analysis (benchmarking RSA rate levels, product structures, and pricing tools against market peers) to sharpen price-to-market positioning.
* Collaborate with Regional Underwriting Portfolio Management teams to ensure pricing strategy is aligned with underwriting appetite, profitability targets, and commercial objectives.
* Support the planning process and RSA Smart Circle Meetings: contribute the pricing perspective to 360-degree quarterly reviews for top B-Partners, translating technical outputs into forward-looking commercial narratives.
* Drive profitable growth by identifying under- and over-priced segments, recommending corrective pricing actions, and monitoring their impact on portfolio KPIs.

RATING ENGINE DEVELOPMENT ADVANCED MODELLING
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end design and evolution of RSA rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, and comparable actuarial platforms, ensuring models are robust, scalable, and regulator-ready.
* Apply advanced statistical and machine-learning techniques (GLMs, GBMs, Random Forests, neural networks, and clustering methods) to frequency/severity modelling, risk segmentation, and rate relativities.
* Implement profit testing frameworks to validate tariff adequacy across the full PL, including claims, expenses, reinsurance costs, and required margin.
* Ensure all rating models are version-controlled, documented, and peer-reviewed, maintaining a high standard of actuarial governance across global markets.

EXTERNAL DATA, CONNECTED PLATFORMS ECOSYSTEM INNOVATION
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, and integrate external data sources (telematics, geo-spatial and climate risk data, socio-demographic datasets, medical cost indices, and third-party claims benchmarks) to enrich RSA pricing models.
* Explore and assess AI-driven pricing ecosystems and next-generation actuarial platforms developing a prioritised technology roadmap for RSA pricing infrastructure.
* Collaborate with the RSA Data team to define data requirements and ensure pricing-relevant data pipelines are fit-for-purpose, timely, and of sufficient granularity for advanced modelling.
* Champion the use of open-source and cloud-native modelling tools (Python, R, cloud ML platforms) alongside vendor solutions, building a flexible and future-proof pricing tech stack.
* Evaluate connected insurance concepts (IoT, real-time risk scoring, and embedded pricing APIs) and assess their applicability within the RSA product and distribution landscape.

TARIFF IMPLEMENTATION PRICING GOVERNANCE
  
  

* Manage the full tariff lifecycle: data collection and harmonisation, actuarial modelling, final rate preparation, system testing, and sign-off, ensuring consistent implementation across all available pricing tools and markets.
* Define pricing governance standards, model validation protocols, and change management processes to ensure pricing decisions are transparent, reproducible, and commercially justified.
* Establish a global tariff review calendar aligned with portfolio performance cycles and market conditions, enabling proactive rather than reactive pricing management.
* Work with IT, Operations, and regional teams to ensure seamless deployment of updated rates into policy administration and quoting systems.

TEAM LEADERSHIP CAPABILITY BUILDING
  
  

* Lead, inspire, and grow a team of pricing professionals across global markets, setting clear objectives, providing structured feedback, and creating pathways for professional development.
* Build internal capability in advanced modelling techniques, external data utilisation, and pricing technology tools running knowledge-sharing sessions and supporting technical upskilling.
* Foster a high-performance pricing culture grounded in analytical rigour, intellectual curiosity, commercial awareness, and a drive for continuous innovation.
* Identify and develop talent within the team; support succession planning aligned with Allianz Partners' people strategy and the RSA pricing function's long-term growth.

What you will bring
  
  
EXPERIENCE BACKGROUND
  
  

* 10+ years in pricing, actuarial, or underwriting roles with deep expertise in PC or assistance/travel insurance pricing.
* Minimum 3 years leading a pricing function, with direct management of international teams of 5+ FTEs.
* Proven hands-on experience building and deploying rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, or comparable GLM/ML actuarial platforms.
* Demonstrated track record integrating external data sources and third-party platforms into pricing models in a production environment.
* Experience presenting pricing strategy and modelling outcomes to CRO, CFO, or Board-level stakeholders.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage given the global scope.

TECHNICAL MODELLING SKILLS
  
  

* Expert-level command of GLM-based rating engine development; proficiency in GBMs, Random Forests, and other ML techniques applied to insurance pricing.
* Hands-on with WTW Radar and/or Emblem for rate relativities, model fitting, and scenario testing.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or R for pricing analytics, model automation, and data manipulation.
* Familiarity with cloud-based ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google Vertex AI) and their application to insurance pricing pipelines.
* Experience with external data integration: geo-spatial data (e.g., Verisk, CoreLogic), medical cost databases, telematics feeds, open weather/climate APIs, and socio-demographic enrichment layers.
* Knowledge of pricing optimisation and elasticity modelling techniques, including demand modelling and customer lifetime value frameworks.
* Solid grounding in actuarial concepts: profit testing, reserving, reinsurance structures, and PL interpretation (GWP, NEP, loss ratio, CoR).

EDUCATION
  
  

* Degree in Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Actuarial qualification or progress toward one (FIA, FCAS, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.

title: Technical Writer
description:
TANlock, a dormakaba Group company, is a fast-growing technology business specializing in intelligent high-security access solutions for data centers and other critical infrastructure. Since joining the dormakaba Group in July 2025, TANlock has gained access to a global network, expanded international market reach, and exciting new growth opportunities. At the same time, we continue to operate with the agility, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit that define our company culture. Based in Georgensgmünd near Nuremberg, our dedicated team develops advanced electromechanical rack locking systems, versatile authentication modules and smart IP readers that help secure server and control cabinets around the world.

  

Position overview

This exciting expansion role requires an experienced technical pre-sales manager to lead our pre-sales engineering processes and team across the EMEA, USA, and Asia territories. Reporting directly to the Global Head of Sales, you will work closely with TANlock Regional Sales Managers and inside sales to provide deep technical and business support to new and existing key customers, distributors, resellers, and integrators.

You will serve as technical pre-sales leader and become the "voice of the customer," bridging the gap between our go-to-market teams, our TANlock Sentinel channel partners and our Germany HQ engineering, product, and operations teams.

Technical Strategy & Consultation

title: Managing Tech Lead - Europa Universalis V
description:
You will join the studio as the manager of our technical team working on a live grand strategy game, together with the designers, artists and QA who build and test it. We are looking for a Managing Tech Lead to lead the team and keep the existing codebase healthy: maintaining it, improving it and making sure it keeps supporting the game as it grows.

We care about how the team works: clear technical goals, honest conversations about priorities, and people who grow. If you enjoy helping engineers do their best work, and still want to stay close enough to the craft to make good calls, this is a good place for that.

Here the leads plan, decide and build. Judgment and hands-on work go together. Stay close to the code, develop your leadership skills and make great games.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Manage the programming team: one-to-ones, feedback, career development, performance, hiring and onboarding.
* Set clear technical objectives for the team that support the creative vision and the product roadmap, and contribute to technical direction alongside the other leads.
* Drive improvements to the game and the existing codebase, with a focus on performance, stability and maintainability.
* Work with the other managers to remove blockers, keep production moving and balance technical decisions against scope, schedule and budget.
* Keep the team's work aligned with the roadmap across concurrent update branches, so that we build and release with as few technical setbacks as possible.
* Stay connected to Paradox's wider technical organization, so that practices, tools and knowledge flow in both directions.
* Time permitting, contribute hands-on: implementing features and systems, reviewing code and solving gameplay problems with efficient technical solutions.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Solid C++ experience in a professional setting, ideally in games, including at least one shipped or live title.
* Experience leading a team of programmers, including the people side: setting expectations, giving feedback, and having the difficult conversations.
* Technical judgment: you prioritize under real constraints, make trade-offs and own the call.
* The ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and non-engineers alike.
* A history of improving how a team works. There is a practice, tool or workflow that exists, or was killed, because of you.
* Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken.

**Things to elevate your application**
--------------------------------------

* Paradox grand strategy experience, Europa Universalis especially. Genuine interest in the genre matters more than logged hours.
* Experience on a live title with a recurring update cadence.
* Experience working with a large, long-lived codebase.

**The Studio**
--------------

Paradox Tinto was founded in 2020 by a small and dedicated team of industry veterans led by Johan Andersson, and building on our experience from Paradox Interactive and Paradox Development Studio, we develop Europa Universalis V, the latest entry in the grand strategy franchise that started it all more than twenty-five years ago.

**The Team**
------------

At Paradox Tinto we work in a small, gameplay focused team, where everyone is part of crafting the player experience and has input on the design of the game. We believe game development should be fun, and we strive for a relaxed, stress-free atmosphere. Being a small studio built from the ground up, we expect everyone to contribute to the development of the studio and its culture. We are also proud of having accessible, experienced managers who lead you and care about you. Your contributions matter to us, to the whole studio, and to the games we make. You will be close to the final product, our community and our fans. We will encourage you to interact with our players directly through social media, our forum, and via streams. Work/life balance matters to us, so our development plans do not rely on crunch. This does not mean we never work overtime, but overtime is relatively uncommon and not encouraged.

**The Location**
----------------

Our office is 300m from one of the beaches of Sitges, a picturesque Mediterranean coastal city. It is well connected by public transport and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, pharmacies, supermarkets, shops and hotels. Sitges is barely 20 minutes by car or bus from El Prat, Barcelona's international airport. It offers 17 beaches along its own coastline, the Costa del Garraf, and an average of 300 days of sun a year, which is hard to argue with for outdoor sports and weekends. Mountain lovers still have the Pyrenees, only a two hour drive away. The town will also captivate you with its cultural events, Mediterranean food and, of course, excellent Spanish wine.

**Some of our benefits**
------------------------

* 25 working days of vacation per year (23 per the collective agreement, plus 2 extra)
* Private health insurance
* Wellhub subscription: gym access and digital wellbeing apps

description:

**Senior Product Manager (Anti Money Laundering/Transaction Monitoring)**

Product - FinCrime

**Ebury Valencia Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week**

As we expand our capabilities across new verticals (i.e. embedded payments), new products (i.e. cards) and new payment rails (i.e. stablecoins ), Anti Money Laundering controls are becoming a more critical part of our product strategy.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Financial Crime Intelligence Product domain, owning Transaction Monitoring across fiat, crypto, card and hybrid payment flows as a domain lead.

You will own the Transaction Monitoring product area, working at the intersection of First Line, Compliance, Engineering and Data.

Your focus will be on building scalable, regulator-ready controls while enabling growth across traditional and digital asset payment rails considering different product and business vertical compliance frameworks.

This role reports to the Head of Financial Crime Intelligence Product.

* Balance growth vs risk trade-offs.
* Use data and research to identify pain points, investigate anomalies, and deliver optimisations.
* Define the strategy for your area, ensuring alignment with overall Financial Crime Intelligence Product domain goals and company direction.
* Translate these into a clear, actionable roadmap across: fiat to fiat transactions, fiat to crypto transactions (mainly stablecoins), crypto to crypto transactions and card spends
* Define and evolve Transaction Monitoring rules, scenarios, risk typologies and predictive AI models aligned with different compliance frameworks, taking into account Crypto Travel Rule requirements.
* Drive improvements in False positive reduction, Alert quality, Operational scalability.

* (Nice to have) Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related technical field.
* (Nice to have) Experience building platforms that serve both B2B and B2B2C use cases.

**What success looks like:**

* Transaction Monitoring that scales across new products, verticals and rails.
* Measurable reduction in false positives without increased regulatory risk.
* Predictive models trusted by Compliance and regulators.

Technology is not treated as an add-on. It is integrated into the foundation of every development. The company connects homes, products, and building systems through its proprietary smart-living system. This intelligence learns from individual needs and evolves over time, creating environments that are more intuitive, responsive, and deeply human.
  
  

* Operating from Dubai, the company is building a multi-brand portfolio in which every development carries a distinct identity within one unifying vision
* Its developments are supported by sales galleries, show units, and a Consumer Experience Centre designed to bring the brand promise to life
* It works alongside hospitality brands, branded-residence partners, brokers, and channel partners to deliver launch-ready experiences

The Brand Marketing Manager is responsible for developing the brand and marketing strategies for the company, any new brands introduced as part of its wider offering, and each individual project launch. The role leads brands and projects from initial concept through to launch, translating the Chief Marketing Officer's overarching vision and business objectives into distinctive positioning, identities, go-to-market strategies, campaigns, content, events, sales collateral, and launch experiences.
  
  
The Brand Marketing Manager leads the full brand development journey. This includes market and audience insights, concept creation, naming, positioning, brand architecture, creative direction, visual identity, campaign strategy, project launches, PR and communications, and experiential marketing. The role ensures that every brand and development has a clear and differentiated identity while remaining aligned with the overarching company vision and portfolio strategy.
  
  
Following launch, the Brand Marketing Manager oversees the Marketing Executives responsible for ongoing campaigns, content, social media, and brand consistency. The role also works closely with the Digital Marketing Manager to ensure brand strategy, campaigns, digital activity, and customer touchpoints are fully aligned.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the marketing production calendar to ensure assets are approved and delivered on time

* Develop and deliver go-to-market plans for new project launches in partnership with the CMO, Sales, Design, Development, and relevant internal teams
* Define launch requirements, milestones, dependencies, and approval processes to ensure marketing readiness
* Oversee marketing requirements across the full launch journey, from teaser and pre-launch through to launch and post-launch activity
* Lead the development of sales galleries, show units, customer experience spaces, sales collateral, and broker enablement materials
* Coordinate co-branded activity with hospitality brands, branded-residence partners, brokers, and channel partners
* Events & Experiential Marketing
* Plan and deliver project launches, investor previews, sales galas, broker events, and other brand experiences
* Manage event concepts, guest experience, production, logistics, vendors, and on-the-day delivery
* Oversee the company's participation in relevant exhibitions and industry events
* Coordinate marketing input into the Consumer Experience Centre's content, activations, and event programming
* PR & Communications
* Work with the CMO and PR agency to develop communications plans for the company, its leadership team, and individual projects
* Oversee press releases, media materials, corporate announcements, thought leadership, executive profiling, and launch communications
* Support internal communications for key company milestones and business updates
* Maintain a central library of approved messaging, fact sheets, biographies, FAQs, and press materials
* Budget, Team & Cross-Functional Coordination
* Work with the CMO and Head of Marketing to identify budget requirements and deliver assigned activity within approved budgets
* Track expenditure and flag potential variances, risks, or additional requirements
* Guide Marketing Executives responsible for campaign implementation and ongoing project marketing
* Coordinate with the Digital Marketing Manager to align brand, campaign, social media, and digital activity
* Work closely with Sales, Design, Development, Technology, and other teams to align requirements and delivery timelines
* Provide regular updates to the CMO on progress, expenditure, outcomes, and risks

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field

* Proven experience developing brand strategies and building brands from concept through to launch
* Strong experience leading project launches, integrated campaigns, creative production, and sales marketing

* Experience working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams
* Familiarity with the Dubai real estate market and UAE advertising requirements is advantageous

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent creative judgment and attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple brands, launches, and workstreams simultaneously

* Effective collaboration across Sales, Digital Marketing, Design, Development, Technology, and PR
* Excellent written, verbal, briefing, and presentation skills

title: LED Service and Prep Technician (Video | Live Events | Middle East)
description:
Overview:

**About PRG**

Production Resource Group (PRG) unites exceptional people and deep production expertise to bring ambitious creative visions to life. As a global production partner across Music & Live TV, Corporate Events & Brand Experiences, TV & Film, Broadway and Sports, we deliver more than 5,000 events a year from 33 locations.

Our teams cover lighting, audio, video, LED, camera, rigging, scenic, automation, broadcast and crew, so wherever you start at PRG, you’ll work alongside specialists in every production discipline. Projects range from a single rental to fully integrated productions, and with a presence across five continents, there’s plenty of room to grow.

At PRG, our people make it possible. Whatever your role, your work shows up in what audiences experience on stage, on screen and beyond.  
  
**Main purpose of the job:** The primary role is to own the full service cycle of the company's LED screen inventory — receiving returned kit, inspecting and sorting it, diagnosing and repairing faults to component level where practical, and prepping and deploying serviceable LED product for upcoming events. The role ensures all LED equipment leaves the warehouse fully tested, correctly configured and within the scheduled time slots, and that the LED fleet is kept at maximum availability with minimal downtime.

  
Qualifications:

### **Experience and technical knowledge**

* Proven experience in LED screen service, repair or technical support, ideally within the live events, rental or staging industry.
* Sound working knowledge of LED video wall systems, including panels, modules, receiving cards, power supplies, data and power distribution, and mapping.
* Hands-on experience with LED processing and configuration software (e.g. Brompton Tessera, NovaStar NovaLCT, Colorlight or equivalent).
* Competent in fault-finding to component level using a multimeter and standard diagnostic tools.
* Good soldering skills, including SMD rework, with an understanding of ESD-safe working practices.
* Familiarity with LED calibration, colour matching and firmware management.
* Understanding of video signal flow and associated equipment (switchers, scalers, media servers, fibre and copper signal transport) is an advantage.
* Manufacturer certification on major LED product lines (e.g. ROE Visual, Absen, INFiLED or equivalent) is desirable.
* Previous experience within a warehouse and equipment rental environment.
* An understanding of stock control and equipment rental software, and good IT skills.
* A good understanding of:
  + Electrical safety at work
  + PAT testing
  + Safe working practices, including ESD control
  + Safe lifting and handling of heavy, fragile equipment

Responsibilities:

**Summary of principal duties and responsibilities**
----------------------------------------------------

### **Receiving and sorting returned kit**

* Receive LED equipment returning from site, checking all items in against the equipment rental software, including bar codes, and reporting any missing or damaged items to the Video Manager.
* Inspect, clean and sort returned LED panels, modules, processors, receiving cards, power supplies, cabling, frames and rigging hardware into serviceable, faulty and write-off categories.
* Quarantine and clearly label all faulty or damaged items so they are not re-issued before repair.
* Log damage reports and site fault notes from returning crews, following up with project teams where information is incomplete.

### **Diagnosis and repair**

* Own the LED repair function, diagnosing and repairing faults on LED panels and associated equipment in line with manufacturer guidance and the Company's standards and procedures.
* Carry out module, receiving card, hub board, power supply and data/power connector replacement, and component-level repair (including SMD/LED pixel replacement and soldering) where practical.
* Perform calibration, colour and brightness matching, and firmware updates on panels, modules and processors (e.g. Brompton, NovaStar, Colorlight or equivalent) so replacement parts blend seamlessly with existing stock.
* Burn-in test and quality check all repaired items before returning them to serviceable stock.
* Maintain accurate service history for every asset on the equipment rental software, recording faults found, parts used, repair time and outcome.
* Identify recurring faults or problem batches and report trends to the Video Manager, recommending corrective action or warranty claims.
* Liaise with manufacturers and suppliers on warranty returns, RMAs, technical support and the purchase of spare parts.
* Manage the LED spares inventory, monitoring stock levels of modules, cards, PSUs, cables and consumables and raising requirements in good time.

### **Prep and deployment**

* Prep LED equipment for forthcoming jobs in line with pick lists and project requirements, ensuring the correct product, quantities, processing, spares and accessories are allocated.
* Build and test LED screen configurations in the warehouse where required, confirming mapping, processor configuration and signal flow before dispatch.
* Ensure all equipment and flight case tour labels are marked up correctly for specific jobs.
* Ensure an appropriate on-site spares kit (modules, cards, PSUs, cables) is prepared and sent with each LED deployment.
* Inform the Video Manager of any shortages or issues with equipment or consumables for forthcoming orders.
* Provide technical briefings and handover notes to site crews where required, and offer remote troubleshooting support to crews on site.
* Where required, attend site to support LED installations, fault-finding or repairs.

### **General warehouse and compliance**

* Prepare and carry out portable appliance testing (PAT testing) where necessary, ensuring all information is logged.
* Assist in the asset entry and bar coding of all new LED equipment received on the equipment rental software system.
* Assist in the undertaking of stock cycle counts with operational departments when scheduled.
* Assist with the loading and unloading of vehicles in a safe manner as directed by the Operations Director.
* Ensure the LED service bench and warehouse areas are kept tidy, organised and ESD-safe at all times.
* Keep up to date with the latest LED products, processing and technology, undertaking manufacturer training when necessary to ensure the correct handling and repair of equipment.
* Report any health and safety issues to the Video Manager or Operations Director.
* Represent the company in a positive and professional manner at all times.
* Ensure the Company's quality standards, policies, rules, procedures and obligations are met and observed at all times.
* Undertake training as required to assist with personal development within the role.
* Fulfil any other reasonable task required by the company.

The above list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be exhaustive. Employees are expected to adopt additional tasks when required. These tasks will be in keeping with the general profile of the role.

title: Head of Product, UX & Design (Product Owners, Experience & Creative)
description:
**Company Description**
Our Client is a real estate developer creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, with an intelligent agent that learns its occupants and adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity. Their approach is built around the idea that a smart home should know you, care for you and make you healthier over time, not just act as a remote control on an app.
  
  
Our Client runs a lab and experience centre where products are tested with real residents and office users, and has a pipeline of thousands of units to deploy into. Our Client is a fast-moving, founder-led organisation, with a mandate to set a new design standard for the industry.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an exceptional Head of Product, UX & Design to own what our client builds and how it feels. The client is creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, spaces with an intelligent agent that learns their occupants and continuously adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief AI Officer (CAIO), you will lead all product owners, product managers, designers and creative talent. You will turn the CAIO's vision into clear product roadmaps and an unmistakably premium experience across every touchpoint: the super app, wall switches, smart mirrors, voice, a 3D AI agent, and the physical spaces themselves.
  
  
We are looking for a design superhero with product leadership depth: someone of the calibre found at Apple, Uber, Noon, Swiggy, Revolut or leading health-tech companies. You must hold a very high bar, and be confident enough to push back when something isn't good enough.
  
  
**Reporting & Team**
Reports to: Chief AI Officer (CAIO)
  
  
Key partners: Head of Technology (engineering delivery); Technical Program Manager; Marketing & Brand (including external brand agencies); Sales & Go-to-Market
  
  
Leads:
  
  

* Product owners: Agentic Intelligence, PWA / Super App, Hardware & IoT. Each owns their product end to end and partners day to day with the Head of Technology's engineering teams
* Product management: Product Managers and Product Associates reporting into each product owner
* UX Design: UX Design Manager, Product Designers, UX/UI Designers
* Creative & Graphics: Graphic Design Manager, Senior Graphic Designer, Motion Graphics Designer

**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Leadership & Roadmap
* Own the product strategy and roadmap across the client's three product lines: the agentic intelligence layer, the PWA / super app, and the hardware & IoT experience
* Lead and grow the product owners, giving each a clear mandate, outcomes and accountability for delivering a complete, working product with their engineering counterparts
* Turn the CAIO's vision into prioritised, sequenced roadmaps that balance residential first (the current priority), commercial workplaces, and later hospitality
* Define success metrics and run the product cadence (discovery, PRDs, sprint reviews, launch readiness) together with the Technical Program Manager
* The Super App & Customer Journey
* Own the end-to-end journey in the PWA, evolving it into the super app for agentic living:

+ Pre-sales: an AI-guided digital brochure, delivered through brokers, that helps buyers choose an apartment and its customisations
+ Onboarding: the resident "interviews" their home agent, building their profile, preferences and household setup (with privacy between family members)
+ Handover: construction updates, fit-out choices and move-in readiness
+ Living: daily control and wellness insights, plus communicating with the home from anywhere

* Design for multiple modalities (chat, voice, a 3D/avatar agent and touch) while keeping the experience simple for people who don't want to "talk to AI"
* UX, Interaction & Design Systems
* Build and own the design system across app, web, wall switches, smart mirrors, tablets and in-space displays
* Define the interaction language for ambient, mostly invisible automation: how the space shows what it is doing, what it detected, and how the occupant can override it
* Champion research and usability testing with real residents and office users in the lab and Experience Centre
* Set and protect a world-class quality bar for micro-interactions, motion and polish
* Creative Direction & Brand Expression
* Lead the creative and graphics team: visual design, motion graphics, product storyboards and sales/marketing assets
* Partner with Marketing and the brand agency so that the brand direction (bold and colourful, "Nike meets Apple", glassmorphism and neumorphism, biophilic cues) shows up consistently in the product
* Produce product vision videos and prototypes that make an invisible, passive experience visible and compelling to investors, buyers and partners
* Wellness, Data & Trust
* Translate biometric and wellness data (from wearables such as Whoop, Oura and Ultrahuman, and from in-space sensing) into insights and nudges people actually act on, without being creepy
* Make privacy and consent a first-class part of the experience, working with the Head of Technology on privacy-by-design

**Requirements**
**Requirements**
**Product & Design Leadership Requirements**

* Product Leadership: Product strategy, roadmapping, OKRs, managing product owners/managers, outcome-based prioritisation
* UX & Interaction: Multi-platform UX (mobile, web/PWA, embedded displays), conversational and voice UX, prototyping, user research
* Visual & Creative: Design systems, typography, motion design, brand-to-product translation; strong portfolio required
* AI Product Literacy: Understanding of LLMs and agents, and how to design trustworthy, explainable AI experiences
* Tooling: Figma (expert), prototyping tools (ProtoPie, Framer or similar), After Effects/motion tooling, analytics platforms
* Collaboration: Proven partnership with engineering leadership; experience working with external agencies
* Leadership: Built and led combined product + design teams of 10+; hiring and mentoring across seniority levels

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hardware-Adjacent Products: Experience designing products that extend beyond the screen into smart home, IoT, wearables, automotive or connected devices
* Health/Wellness Tech: Product or design leadership at a health-tech or wearables company (e.g. Whoop, Oura, Ultrahuman, Eight Sleep) is a strong plus
* Consumer Super Apps: Experience at companies known for design excellence and complex consumer journeys (e.g. Apple, Uber, Careem, Noon, Swiggy, Revolut)
* Zero-to-One Experience: You have built a product and a team from scratch, not just optimised an existing one
* Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: You will push back on a bad idea, including the CEO's, and change your mind when the evidence says so

**Why This Role?**
Most real-estate "smart homes" are a remote control on an app. Our client is building something different: homes and workplaces that know you, care for you and make you healthier over time. You will define the face, voice and feel of that intelligence, from the first time a buyer meets the client's agent on a broker's tablet to the moment a resident's bathroom mirror suggests a better night's sleep. You will have the mandate, the team and the executive support to set a new design standard for the industry.
  
  
**Additional Suggestions For The Candidate**

* Portfolio Is Everything: Please include case studies that show product thinking and craft, ideally including motion and multi-device work
* Think Beyond the Screen: Come ready to discuss how you would design an experience where the best interaction is often no interaction at all
* Bring a Point of View: Tell us one thing you would change about how today's smart home apps work, and how you would do it better

**Benefits**

* Offered Salary: Competitive, in line with market standards for the role and seniority, along with additional benefits as per the company's band structure

title: Director of Creative Performance
description:
**Department:** Marketing

**Reports To:** Head of Growth

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Location:** Remote

**Base Salary:** $170,000–$190,000 + bonus

**About Bask & Lather**

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Director of Creative Performance to lead our paid acquisition creative function. You will turn customer insights and performance data into compelling ads, build a disciplined testing and learning process, and develop a reliable pipeline of creative that can sustain profitable spend.

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will own creative strategy, briefs, production coordination, quality assurance, and creative performance analysis. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring analytical depth, creative judgment, and strong execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Creative strategy and testing:** Build a prioritized roadmap for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other active acquisition channels. Define customer audiences, objections, product benefits, hooks, formats, and hypotheses for each test.
* **Production and delivery:** Translate strategy into clear briefs, scripts, demonstrations, and channel-specific assets. Manage the production calendar, feedback, approvals, and delivery against agreed deadlines.
* **Creative learning and iteration:** Review results with Growth, identify why concepts perform, and turn findings into the next briefs. Expand winning concepts and diagnose weaker executions before deciding whether to revise or retire them.
* **Creators and partners:** Manage performance creative agencies, UGC partners, freelancers, and production vendors. Improve quality, turnaround time, and cost efficiency while building dependable production capacity.
* **Team and resources:** Lead assigned creative resources, establish clear ownership, and manage approved production budgets. Recommend staffing, partner, and capacity changes to the Head of Growth.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

You will own the paid acquisition creative roadmap and production priorities within approved resources. Growth owns media budgets, campaign execution, and spend allocation; you will jointly define testing conditions, evaluate results, and recommend which concepts merit additional investment.

Partner with Brand and Design to uphold brand standards, and with Product Development and the appropriate reviewers to ensure product education and claims are accurate. Coordinate with Integrated Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retention around launches, offers, customer insights, and reusable assets. Organic social, brand campaigns, and lifecycle creative are partner functions with separately agreed priorities.

**Creative Operations and Accountability**

* Maintain a searchable asset library with consistent naming, concept tagging, performance history, usage rights, and approval records.
* Plan production capacity against the testing roadmap and budget. Flag delivery risks early, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain backup partners for critical needs.
* Establish a consistent review process for product accuracy, demonstrations, brand alignment, platform specifications, and creator permissions before launch.
* Use AI and workflow automation where they improve research, ideation, briefing, reporting, or production efficiency, with human review for accuracy and quality.
* Run a weekly creative review covering results, lessons, fatigue, production status, budget, next tests, owners, and deadlines. Bring recommendations supported by evidence and clear hypotheses.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

During onboarding, you and the Head of Growth will establish baselines, consistent metric definitions, and numerical targets. The scorecard will track:

* **Creative effectiveness:** The share of original concepts that meet agreed acquisition or profitability targets at a defined spend threshold, the spend sustained by winners, and their useful lifespan.
* **Testing and learning:** Original concepts tested, meaningful hypotheses validated, and the speed at which learning becomes new creative. Track original concepts separately from asset variations.
* **Operating performance:** Brief-to-launch time, on-time delivery, cost per tested concept, budget adherence, and production capacity against the approved roadmap.
* **Diagnostic metrics:** Channel-appropriate hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion, CPA, ROAS, and fatigue indicators. Interpret these in the context of spend, audience, placement, attribution, and offer.

Acquisition and profitability outcomes are shared with Growth. Creative output volume alone will not define success.

**Required Experience and Capabilities**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in performance creative, creative strategy, or growth marketing, including leadership of creative teams or external production partners.
* A demonstrated record of developing ads that supported profitable acquisition for a consumer product brand. Beauty, personal care, or wellness experience is strongly preferred.
* Deep working knowledge of Meta and TikTok creative, with experience adapting concepts for YouTube and other acquisition channels.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to distinguish a creative insight from an attribution, media, audience, or offer issue.
* Hands-on skill in briefing, scripting, product demonstrations, UGC, editing feedback, and translating customer objections into effective creative.
* Experience managing production budgets, agencies, creators, timelines, and competing priorities. You set clear expectations, surface risks early, and follow through.

**Portfolio and Results Standard**

Be prepared to walk through examples showing the original hypothesis, your contribution, testing approach, spend supported, performance results, and subsequent iterations. We want to understand what you built, how you measured it, and what you learned. Share team and budget scope where possible, using anonymized information when needed.

**Compensation and Benefits**

Base salary of $170,000–$190,000, plus annual performance bonus tied to agreed role and organizational goals. Comprehensive benefits and paid time off.

title: Account Director, Brand
description:
**About the Role**

You’ll manage a book of Stacker brand clients, from growing startups to established mid-size companies, and own their experience from kickoff through renewal. You’ll report to the Head of Accounts and partner with an Account Coordinator, our Editorial team, and the Value Team.

Most of these clients come to us with a clear goal: more backlinks, more brand mentions, better visibility in search and AI answers. Your job is to get them up and running quickly, keep their content flowing, and show them what it’s producing. You’ll carry a quarterly renewal goal, and part of that is spotting when a client is ready for a bigger package.

**About Stacker**

Stacker helps brands and nonprofit newsrooms get their stories in front of more readers. Organizations submit content, our editorial team prepares it for syndication, and it’s distributed for free to a network of 3,000+ trusted news publishers. Clients get earned media placements, canonical links back to their site, and visibility in search and AI answers. We’re bootstrapped, remote-first, and growing, and we care about long-term results over short-term wins.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Run kickoffs:** Confirm goals and KPIs, walk clients through the portal and our editorial guidelines, and set expectations on submission timing and review.
* **Keep content moving:** Track pacing against each contract, follow up on submissions and approvals, and make sure clients use what they’ve paid for.
* **Help clients succeed with editorial:** Explain why a draft needs changes, suggest angles that tend to get picked up, and loop in Editorial or the Value Team when a client needs deeper strategy.
* **Report on results:** Share pickup, backlink, and search performance in a way that connects back to the goals from kickoff. Flag what’s working and what to try next.
* **Own renewals:** Start renewal conversations early, address concerns before they turn into churn, and recommend upgrades when the results support it.
* **Stay organized:** Keep notes, tasks, and account health current in the CRM so anyone on the team can pick up where you left off.
* **Make the team better:** Share what you learn from clients and help improve our templates and processes.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 3-5+ years in account management, client success, or a client-facing marketing role
* Experience owning renewals or a book of business
* Working knowledge of SEO, content marketing, or link building
* Comfort with analytics tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, Ahrefs, or SEMrush
* Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain a performance dip without getting defensive
* Good organization. You’ll manage many accounts at once, each with its own timeline
* Genuine interest in media, journalism, or how content gets discovered

*Nice-to-Haves*

* MarTech, agency, or digital PR experience
* Familiarity with GEO or AI search

**Location**

Remote (U.S.)

**Why Join Us?**

We’re a diverse team of storytellers committed to building a more exciting, innovative future for media and marketing. As a bootstrapped company, we’re resourceful, fast-moving, and focused on sustainable growth. Our virtual-first culture is rooted in trust, ownership, and collaboration, with a deep respect for each team member’s voice and value. You’ll be joining a company that’s serious about impact, and intentional about how we scale it.

**Perks & Benefits**

Equity Program  
Unlimited PTO  
100% Remote  
3 Months Paid Parental Leave  
401(k) Match  
Full Health & Dental Coverage  
Life Insurance & Short-Term Disability  
Awesome Team Culture, Events & Retreats

Stacker is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage women, people of color, veterans, people with disabilities, and gender-nonconforming candidates to apply. We don’t discriminate based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic.

Compensation Range: $110K - $150K

**About LocaliQ:**  
At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.
  
  
You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.
  
  
**About the Role:**  
This is an enterprise-level role focused on C-suite conversations rather than local business owners. PIQ is a performance-based marketing program that converts print advertising space into marketing opportunities on a revenue-share, cost-per-acquisition, or cost-per-lead model. The PIQ Account Executive tells an enterprise story about partnership relationships—not transactional relationships—leveraging USA TODAY’s entire asset base to partner with national and regional clients. The role aligns with national sales efforts and one-to-many programs, focusing on enterprise-level relationships that allow the company to leverage its full scale.
  
  
In your first 90 days, you’ll ramp into the PIQ enterprise story—gaining a deep understanding of our performance-based model, how we partner with C-suite leaders, and how our national scale creates value for enterprise clients. As you progress, you’ll begin building and advancing a strong enterprise pipeline while establishing core sales rhythms and collaborating closely with internal strategists. By the end of this period, you’ll be confidently owning enterprise opportunities and leading complex, high-impact deals with support from a seasoned cross-functional team.
  
  
**What You Will Do:**  

* Generate a sales pipeline through self-directed prospecting using ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, attendance at vertical-specific expos, referrals from existing clients, and AI tools for finding leads and building outreach strategies.
* Qualify and pursue enterprise level opportunities—focus on prospects capable of $150,000+ deals selling to C-suite and marketing directors at regional, state, and national level.
* Deliver the PIQ value proposition—one-to-one exclusive leads to subscriber-based audience, with high frequency exposure through trusted USA TODAY content, and scale across 860 markets/publications.
* Collaborate with strategists on proposals for deals exceeding $150,000; quarterback internal resources to design, build, and deliver campaigns.
* Manage and grow existing accounts; maintain weekly client touchpoints to drive retention and expansion.
* Lead cross-functional delivery—delegate effectively, maintain quality control, run pod cadences, and own outcomes while leveraging specialist expertise
* Track performance data—monitor campaign metrics, set clear expectations, review performance regularly, address issues early, and resolve problems through appropriate specialists.
* Maintain client data in Salesforce—log activities, track pipeline, and forecast accurately.

**Qualifications:**  

* 5+ years’ proven track record of success in B2B sales, with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles, selling to the C-suite or marketing director level on deals that exceed $150K+
* Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.
* Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.
* Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity.
* Digital acumen—understanding of digital marketing landscape and performance-based marketing models.
* Data-minded, able to understand tracking, performance metrics for client campaigns and developing strategies from that data.
* Experience working with agencies and understanding agency operations and relationships.
* Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders.
* Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

**Who Thrives Here:**  
You’ll thrive here as a self motivated, competitive, and consultative seller who owns a book of business, creates opportunities, and confidently leads complex deals. Top performers are data driven, resilient, and results focused—energized by real time performance metrics and rankings, motivated by commission upside, and accountable for outcomes. They consistently outperform peers, earn expanded roles or territories, and effectively quarterback internal teams to deliver measurable client impact.
  
  
**Benefits:**  
We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.
  
  

* Competitive base salary + uncapped commission opportunity
* 401(k) with company match
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more
* Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays
* Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast
* Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders
* Flexibility and Autonomy: remote work environment
* Access to industry-leading tools, resources and marketing expertise
* Career development opportunities
* High-performance culture with recognition, incentives, and contests

#LOCALiQ
  
  
If you’re energized by enterprise level selling, motivated by performance and ownership, and ready to build something meaningful at scale, this role was designed for you. Apply now to bring your expertise, ambition, and curiosity to PIQ—and be part of a high impact team shaping the future of performance marketing.
