**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
============================================

At Amgen, our shared mission to serve patients drives everything we do. As we build our presence in obesity and related conditions, we have an opportunity to create connected, patient-centered experiences and meaningful engagement at scale.

  
  

**What you will do**
====================

  
  

The Director, Brand Media & Activation serves as the brand’s lead media integrator, translating brand and audience strategy into an integrated media and activation approach for the U.S. obesity and related conditions portfolio. The Director brings Consumer and Healthcare Professional (HCP) teams together around a coordinated brand plan and sets direction for the integrated brief, media planning, and activation strategy. The role maintains regular alignment with Global Customer Capabilities and Insights (GCCI) team, Medical, and Corporate Affairs so customers are engaged through a coordinated approach across functions.

  
  

**What sets this role apart**
=============================

* Serve as the brand’s lead media integrator, bringing Consumer and HCP together around a coordinated customer plan.

* Maintain regular coordination with GCCI and cross functional teams to align customer engagement across functions.

* Connect integrated media planning with high-impact activations and the broader customer experience.

  
  

**Key responsibilities**
========================

  
  

**Integrated Strategy and Brief Leadership**
--------------------------------------------

* Lead development of the integrated media and activation brief, grounding the assignment in brand objectives, audience insight, and the role of each channel.

* Set the strategic direction for channel planning and activation so the plan works as a coherent system across paid, owned, earned, and experiential touchpoints.

* Translate business priorities into clear media and activation objectives, audience priorities, strategic choices, and measures of success.

**Media Planning and Activation Strategy**
------------------------------------------

* Lead the media planning process with the Associate Director and GCCI/agency partners, including channel roles, planning principles, and investment recommendations.

* Set direction for activation planning, identifying opportunities that are relevant to priority audiences and connected to brand strategy.

* Ensure plans balance reach, attention, engagement, and action while making deliberate choices about investment and timing.

* Guide integration of campaign creative, media content, and activation experiences so each is fit for its channel and audience.

**Cross-Functional Integration**
--------------------------------

* Lead integrated media planning with Consumer and HCP partners, bringing both teams into brief development, channel planning, customer journey design, and key decisions.

* Coordinate regularly with GCCI, Medical, and Corporate Affairs to align customer engagement priorities, channel plans, content, and timing across functions.

* Connect media and activation plans with Corporate Affairs, Patient Advocacy, Patient Experience, Direct-to-Patient, and other partners, clarifying roles and handoffs across customer touchpoints.

* Represent the media and activation function in brand planning, launch readiness, and senior leadership discussions.

**Team, Agency, and Performance Leadership**
--------------------------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop the Media & Activation team, including the Associate Director and Senior Manager and the team’s activation execution capability.

* Set expectations for GCCI/agency partners and hold them accountable for strategic quality, execution, and delivery against scope.

* Oversee media investment recommendations and disciplined stewardship of the media budget in partnership with GCCI, Finance and brand leadership.

* Review performance with the Associate Director, using measurement and learning to refine channel and activation plans.

  
  

**What we expect of you**
=========================

  
  

**Basic qualifications**
========================

* Doctorate degree and 2 years of Marketing/Sales experience OR
* Master’s degree and 4 years of Marketing/Sales experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of Marketing/Sales experience OR
* Associate’s degree and 10 years of Marketing/Sales experience OR
* High school diploma/GED and 12 years of Marketing/Sales experience.
  

  

**Preferred qualifications**

* Demonstrated success leading integrated media and activation strategy for a complex brand or launch.
* Experience with consumer marketing, media planning, channel investment, experiential marketing, or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of HCP and consumer engagement and the ability to align plans across audiences.
* Experience leading agency partners, budgets, and cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.
* Ability to use measurement, audience insight, and marketplace learning to make clear investment choices.
* Pharmaceutical, healthcare, consumer health, or other regulated-industry experience preferred.
  

  

**What you can expect from us**
-------------------------------

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

title: Assistant Director of Contract Optimization - Remote
description:
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

Supporting four of Hilton's largest and most complex properties — **Hilton Riverside, Hilton Chicago, Palmer House, and Hilton Midtown** — this role will partner closely with hotel sales leadership, Hilton Worldwide Sales (HWS), internal stakeholders, and customers to analyze, negotiate, and optimize contracts.

This is not simply a contract-review role. We are looking for an industry leader and senior seller who knows how to lead a negotiation, navigate a complex organization, influence stakeholders, and coach sales teams through challenging contracting situations.

  

**Strategic Contract Optimization**

* Serve as a strategic resource and second set of eyes for complex, high-value, and high-profile group contracts.
* Analyze contracts holistically, identifying potential risks, opportunities, and areas requiring strategic negotiation.
* Evaluate unique or non-standard clauses and develop solutions that support both the customer relationship and Hilton's commercial objectives.
* Partner with sellers to move complex contracts forward and help get business across the goal line.
* Identify trends and recurring contracting challenges and develop strategies to address them proactively.
* Balance customer expectations, hotel objectives, Hilton standards, and commercial priorities throughout the negotiation process.

  

**What We're Looking For**

We are seeking a **senior commercial leader with hotel sales and contracting experience** who understands that successful negotiations require both business acumen and relationship management.

The ideal candidate is:

* A **Senior Seller and industry leader** with significant experience negotiating complex hotel group contracts.
* An analytical thinker who can quickly understand the business implications of contractual terms.
* A skilled negotiator who is comfortable leading conversations with sophisticated customers and senior internal stakeholders.
* An influential communicator who can navigate Hilton's matrix and bring the right people together to reach a solution.
* A strategic problem solver who looks beyond individual clauses to understand the overall business opportunity.
* A coach who can elevate the contracting and negotiation capabilities of sales teams.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure around a brand-new function.
* Able to balance customer advocacy with Hilton's commercial interests.
Confident making recommendations and leading conversations rather than simply identifying problems.  

**What it Takes to Make the Stay**

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

#LI-TA1

  

**How We'll Help You Thrive**

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:

* **Incredible travel perks** – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
* **Own a piece of Hilton** – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
* **Paid parental leave** – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
* **Personalized caregiving support** – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
* **Crisis concierge** – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care

title: Principal Creative, Growth Production
description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Overview**
------------

Local Produce is Instacart's in-house creative agency. We build brand storytelling that is strategic, fun, and fresh, and we make grocery shopping feel effortless across film, photo, social, product surfaces, and experiential moments.

We are hiring a Principal Creative, Growth Production to own the production engine behind our growth and direct response (DR) work. You will produce high-volume video and performance creative, run the operations that keep it moving, and build the systems that let the team scale without losing quality. You do the work and you oversee it. One week you are on set or in the edit review, the next you are rebuilding an intake process or negotiating a vendor rate card.

You will join a tight-knit core senior production team of 4 within a 10-person production org and a 40-person agency. You will work directly with senior stakeholders in Growth and Marketing, make judgment calls on creative, operational, and business affairs questions in real time, and set the bar for how we produce.

**About the Job**
-----------------

* Own end-to-end production for growth and DR creative across video, photo, social, design, and AI-scalable formats, from brief through final delivery and platform-ready versioning.
* Run video production hands-on and at scale: testimonial, UGC, talent-led, short-form, and vertical content for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and paid media placements.
* Plan and produce for performance. Build modular shoots and asset systems that yield many cutdowns, hooks, and variants per production day, and work with Growth and Marketing partners to turn test results into the next round of creative.
* Translate briefs into production strategies, scopes, budgets, and timelines. Manage AICP-style bidding, cost tracking, and reconciliations to deliver on time and within budget.
* Build and maintain the creative operational systems for the growth team: intake and briefing, production calendars, asset naming and versioning, review and approval flows, delivery specs, and reporting. Document everything so the team can run it without you.
* Drive AI production workflows alongside traditional production. Know where AI tools speed up or replace conventional methods for iteration, versioning, and scale, and where they do not.
* Own Business Affairs responsibilities, including usage rights, licensing, talent and music clearances, and audit-ready deliverables, in partnership with Legal, Policy, and IP.
* Handle localization end to end: produce content in multiple languages (English and Spanish preferred) and manage the workflows that keep multilingual assets consistent and on time.
* Source, negotiate, and manage a diverse roster of production partners, including directors, DPs, editors, color, sound, finishing, music, and freelance creators, matched to the needs of each project and its budget.
* Lead pre-production and on-set operations: casting, locations, permits, insurance, releases, safety, and union and non-union compliance.
* Establish repeatable workflows, templates, and documentation in Airtable, Asana, and Frame.io. Mentor teammates and push continuous improvement across the production function.
* Flex into high-profile commercial and cultural projects as business needs shift.

**About You**
-------------

You are a producer who can do the work and run the operation around it. You are comfortable on set, in a bid, in a contract review, and in a spreadsheet that tracks 40 deliverables. You do not wait for a manager to make the call.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* 13+ years of end-to-end creative production experience delivering multi-channel campaigns (video, photo, social, digital) at an agency or in-house, with range across formats beyond traditional linear production.
* Direct experience producing growth, performance, or DR creative at volume, including short-form and vertical video, UGC, and iterative creative testing.
* Proven track record producing testimonial and brand content across multi-market shoots, with hands-on on-set leadership from pre-production through post.
* Demonstrated experience building creative operations: intake, workflow, templates, asset management, and reporting that a team adopted and kept using.
* Ownership of campaign budgets of $250K+ and experience managing 10+ external partners per project.
* Fluency in Business Affairs: usage rights, licensing, talent and music clearances, legal, policy, and IP approvals, and audit-readiness.
* Deep knowledge of production operations: schedules and call sheets, permits and insurance, talent and location releases, and SAG-AFTRA, union, and non-union workflows.
* Familiarity with AI production tools and workflows, and a point of view on how they are changing the craft.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, Airtable or Asana, Frame.io, and basic Adobe Creative Cloud for review and markup. Ability to travel up to 25% for shoots.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in an in-house creative agency, partnering with Marketing, Growth, Product, Legal, Policy, and IP teams.
* Background in high-growth tech, marketplace, retail, or grocery, with fluency in both brand and performance objectives.
* Experience producing celebrity and talent-led work, UGC, and social-first formats for YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.
* Familiarity with AICP bid forms, cost reporting, tax incentives, and multi-state production compliance. PMP or a recognized production certification is a plus.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish, with hands-on experience producing content in both languages.
* Comfort working at a senior scope, across domains, without close oversight, and with credibility at the senior stakeholder level.

title: Community Manager
description:
Kickstarter is the leading crowdfunding platform for creative projects across film, games, music, art, design, and technology. Since our founding in 2009, our mission to help bring creative projects to life has been powered by the people behind the work.

Together, we’ve helped creators around the world launch creative projects that have generated billions of dollars in pledges. That same commitment extends inward. Rooted in shared values, Kickstarter invests in the growth and success of our team, treating employees as whole people and empowering them with the autonomy and space to participate in decisions that shape their work and our company.

Kickstarter is seeking an experienced Community Manager to join our Marketing team. This role sits at the heart of how Kickstarter shows up and is perceived across the places our community talks: social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the corners of the internet where creators and backers compare notes. Reporting to the Director, Brand and Communications, the Community Manager will listen, respond, and engage, and will work closely with cross-functional teams to route what they hear to the people who can act on it.

As the owner of Kickstarter’s community presence and reputation, they serve as our early-warning system when sentiment shifts or a problem starts to spread. This is not a “schedule posts and check metrics” role. The ideal candidate is already deep in these communities, knows the norms of each one, and gets a little twitchy when a thread starts to turn.

The salary for this role in the United States is $115,905.50.

#### **In This Role, You Will:**

*Reputation Management and Monitoring*

* Monitor brand mentions, sentiment, and emerging narratives across social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the broader web, in real time.
* Spot early signals of reputational risk (a viral complaint, a controversial project, a misunderstanding of our policies), assess severity, and lead the response, partnering with Communications, Trust & Safety, Legal, and leadership on sensitive or high-stakes moments.
* Design and own the escalation framework with Communications, Trust & Safety, Support, Product, Legal, and leadership, including severity tiers, owners, and response timelines.
* Build, own, and continuously refine response playbooks for common scenarios (project controversies, creator disputes, outages, policy changes, and press-driven moments), and run post-incident reviews to improve them.
* Define how we measure community sentiment and reputation, and deliver regular reporting to senior stakeholders that connects trends to business and mission impact, with clear recommendations.

*Community Engagement*

* Show up as Kickstarter in public conversations, in a voice that is human, direct, and well-informed.
* Participate credibly in Reddit and Discord communities, following each community’s rules and culture rather than treating them as broadcast channels.
* Correct misinformation helpfully, de-escalate heated threads, and know when not to respond.
* Support creators and backers by pointing them to the right resources, and handing off to Support when an issue needs a ticket.
* Celebrate creator milestones and engage with backers and make Kickstarter feel present and human beyond our owned social channels.
* Set voice, tone, and engagement guidelines for Kickstarter’s presence in community spaces, and coach teammates who engage on the company’s behalf.

*Feedback Loop*

* Own a community feedback program that turns unstructured community input into prioritized, evidence-backed insights for Product, Design, Policy, Support, and Creator Success, and track what gets acted on.
* Maintain a living picture of the top recurring pain points, feature requests, and trust issues, with examples.
* Close the loop publicly when we ship something the community asked for.
* Build and run a creator and backer advocacy program, identifying enthusiastic community members for testimonials, campaigns, and storytelling.

*Programs and Operations*

* Own the strategy and operation of Kickstarter-owned community spaces (e.g., Discord, creator forums), including moderation guidelines, tooling, and volunteer or mod programs.
* Align Social, Comms, and our creator-facing teams on campaigns, launches, and announcements so community context is built in from the start.
* Select, manage, and optimize our social listening and community tooling, including vendor evaluation and measurement.
* Track emerging creator communities, cultural trends, competitor conversations, new platforms and community behaviors.
* Translate community insights into recommendations that inform marketing, acquisition, and product priorities.

#### **About You**

* You have 4+ years in community management, social media, reputation management, or a related role, ideally at a platform, marketplace, or consumer tech company.
* You have deep, demonstrable fluency in Reddit and Discord, as a longtime participant and not just a brand account. You know what a good community looks like and what gets a brand banned or mocked.
* You have hands-on experience across the major social platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads), including how norms and audiences differ on each.
* You have experience monitoring and managing sentiment on review and feedback sites (e.g., Trustpilot, App Store and Google Play reviews, Hacker News, and niche forums).
* You have strong judgment under pressure and ambiguity: you can tell a vocal minority from a real problem and a mistake from a crisis, and you make clear recommendations or calls without waiting to be told what to do.
* You are an excellent writer. You can be warm, plain-spoken, and precise, and you can adapt tone to the platform and the moment.
* You have experience with social listening and community tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Meltwater, Mention, or similar).
* You have experience building processes and aligning cross-functional partners, and you communicate clearly and credibly with executives, Legal, and Trust & Safety when stakes are high.
* You have a track record of owning a community, reputation, or voice-of-customer program end to end, with measurable results.
* You are familiar with crowdfunding, creator economy, or maker communities (games, comics, film, music, design, publishing, tech).
* You are familiar with platform-specific communities like BoardGameGeek, Product Hunt, Indie Hackers, or creator-focused Discords.
* You have experience handling public-facing communications during controversies or policy changes.
* You have data skills: you are comfortable building dashboards or pulling insights from large volumes of unstructured text.

**Our Fully Virtual Team**

We’re currently able to support employees based in the following US locations: CA, CO, CT, GA, IL, MA, MD, NC, NJ, NY, OR, SC, VA, VT, and WA. We're also able to support employees in the United Kingdom. If you live in—or are willing to move to—any of these locations, we look forward to your application! If there is a required or preferred location for an open role, it will be listed in the job description.

Kickstarter is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to fight for equality, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

Please reach out to Kickstarter’s Help Center to report potentially fraudulent contact here: https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

description:
Brilliant is seeking a full-time **Associate Director, Client Management** for our Influencer & Celebrity team. This role will own the day-to-day client relationship and keep every influencer program on time, on budget, and flawlessly executed.

**The Role**
------------

This is a client-facing, project-management-first role. All day, every day, you are the voice of Brilliant to our clients: you run the calls, write the recap, chase the approvals, and make sure nothing slips. Our strategy and talent leads build the programs; you make sure they get delivered.

You are hyper-organized. You know where every creator, contract, deliverable, and invoice stands at any moment. You understand influencer budgets inside and out, and you have done this in high-volume agency settings where dozens of creators and multiple brands are live at once.

**Who We Are**
--------------

We’re a fully remote performance team built on a simple promise: *Work Hard. Play Hard. Laugh Hard.*

We aren't for the faint of heart. We move fast, hold a ridiculously high bar for excellence, and thrive on driving real ROI for our clients. But we also believe that intense drive should come with great culture, which is why we offer unlimited PTO, Fabulous Fridays (doors close at 3pm), virtual happy hours, a monthly book club, and endless reasons to win together.

And the industry notices: we were recently named an **Inc. Best Workplace 2026** and landed on the **Inc. 5000 List of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies for 2026.**

**What We Do**
--------------

Since 2008, Brilliant has been where bold ideas meet relentless execution. We're a performance marketing agency with deep expertise in family-focused brands, bringing together PR, Influencer, Social, Paid Media, Affiliate, Retail Support, Experiential, and AI Intelligence to create integrated, full-funnel campaigns that shatter targets and cut through the noise.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Own the client relationship**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for multiple influencer and celebrity accounts across Zoom, email, and Slack.
* Lead weekly status calls and client meetings, and send same-day recaps with clear next steps, owners, and deadlines.
* Know your clients’ brands, products, retail calendars, and stakeholders cold, and build relationships they trust.
* Manage expectations proactively: flag risks early, present solutions, and keep clients informed before they have to ask.
* Pull together campaign data, content, and results for client reviews, QBRs, and milestone presentations.
* Listen critically in every meeting to spot incremental opportunities within existing accounts, and bring them to leadership.

### **Run the project, end to end**

* Own campaign timelines from kickoff through final reporting, so every program is delivered on time and aligned with client objectives.
* Build and maintain project management tools and trackers (AirTable, Asana, or similar) that give the team and clients a single source of truth.
* Track every moving piece: creator outreach, contracts, product shipments, content drafts, client approvals, go-live dates, and usage windows.
* Coordinate across Brilliant’s strategy, talent, paid media, PR, social, and analytics teams to keep integrated campaigns in sync.
* Ensure every program meets FTC disclosure guidelines and brand safety standards.
* Keep creator issues to a minimum, and handle the ones that arise calmly and quickly.

### **Manage the money**

* Own influencer budgets on assigned accounts: track talent spend, gifting, product costs, fees, and paid amplification against approved budgets.
* Build and maintain budget trackers and flag overages or underspend before they become problems.
* Lead monthly billing reconciliation with finance, making sure creator payments, invoices, and client billing match.
* Provide inputs on account profitability and scope, and raise when work is drifting out of scope.

### **Lead and develop the team**

* Oversee specialists and coordinators on campaign execution, and set the standard for client correspondence, follow-through, and attention to detail.
* Mentor junior team members: what training do they need, and how can we encourage their growth?
* Help build and improve the client management processes, templates, and playbooks that let the team scale without sacrificing quality.

### **Stay sharp**

* Keep a pulse on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, and emerging platforms, and share trends with clients and the team.
* Bring energy to brainstorms and push the team to think bigger.

**Our Dream Team Member**
-------------------------

* 5–7 years of client service or account management experience, with at least 3 years in influencer marketing.
* Experience in a high-volume influencer agency setting, managing many creators and multiple brands at once. Large-agency experience strongly preferred.
* A deep understanding of influencer budgets: talent rates, fees, gifting, usage rights, whitelisting costs, and how they roll up to a client budget.
* Experience leading monthly billing reconciliation and tracking account profitability.
* Hyper-organized. You build the tracker, you live in the tracker, and you never miss a deadline.
* Fluency in project management tools such as AirTable or Asana, plus familiarity with CreatorIQ, HypeAuditor, Shopify Collabs, or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of paid, gifted, affiliate, and ambassador programs, plus whitelisting, Spark Ads, and Partnership Ads.
* Experience overseeing or mentoring junior team members.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with composure and confidence on camera in client meetings.
* Can manage up, manage down, and keep a million moving pieces running smoothly.
* Resourceful, committed, deliberate, and genuinely enjoys crossing things off the list.

### **Bonus Points**

* Experience with parenting, baby, kids, toy, or family lifestyle brands.
* Experience with celebrity talent partnerships and working with agents, managers, and publicists.
* Experience on integrated campaigns that combine influencer with PR, experiential, or retail activations.
* A slight obsession with Amazon, online shopping, and discovering new products.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO
* Paid time off between Christmas and New Year's
* Fabulous Fridays: the work day ends at 3pm all year
* 401K with a 3% company match (immediately vested) after the initial 3 months
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Medical and Dependent Care FSA
* Company-paid Life Insurance
* Company-paid Long-Term Disability

**Salary Range:** 85K–95K

title: Head of Apparel Design & Product Development
description:
**Company:** Controlled Insanity  
**Position:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Product Development & Design

Controlled Insanity is a premium bodybuilding and streetwear brand focused on creating innovative, heavyweight apparel that challenges traditional gymwear. We pride ourselves on unique garment construction, distinctive silhouettes, premium materials, and designs that stand apart from the standard fitness apparel market.

We are looking for someone who shares this vision and can help push the boundaries of what our clothing can become.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative, experienced, and innovation-driven **Head of Apparel Design & Product Development** to lead the development of new clothing concepts, garment bases, silhouettes, and product innovations for Controlled Insanity.

This person will be responsible for continuously researching, conceptualizing, designing, and developing new apparel from the initial idea all the way through finalized, manufacturer-ready tech packs and production.

We are not simply looking for someone who can take an existing garment and make minor adjustments. We want someone who can independently come up with original garment concepts, identify opportunities in the market, experiment with new construction techniques, and develop completely new product bases that give Controlled Insanity a competitive advantage.

You will play a major role in shaping the future of our product catalog and establishing a recognizable design identity for the brand.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Apparel Design & Innovation**

* Continuously develop new and innovative clothing concepts and garment bases.
* Create original silhouettes, fits, cuts, paneling, seam placements, and construction techniques.
* Develop unique variations of existing product categories while introducing entirely new categories.
* Experiment with unconventional garment details, functional features, and design elements.
* Push beyond standard gymwear designs to create distinctive, recognizable products.

**2. Technical Design & Tech Packs**

* Create detailed, manufacturer-ready tech packs for every approved product.
* Produce technical flats, garment measurements, construction details, stitching specifications, and material requirements.
* Specify fabric compositions, GSM, trims, washes, hardware, and finishing details.
* Develop measurement charts, grading specifications, and sizing standards.
* Ensure all technical documentation is accurate and production-ready.

**3. Fabric & Material Research**

* Research and source innovative fabrics, textiles, and materials.
* Experiment with different fabric weights, textures, compositions, and treatments.
* Identify opportunities for unique washes, dyeing techniques, distressing, embroidery, printing, and garment finishing.
* Continuously research new manufacturing techniques and apparel innovations.

**4. Market Research & Competitive Analysis**

* Regularly analyze leading bodybuilding, streetwear, and athletic apparel brands.
* Identify emerging trends, product opportunities, and gaps in the market.
* Research successful garment constructions and identify ways to create original alternatives.
* Stay ahead of industry developments and continuously bring new ideas to the team.

**5. Product Development & Sampling**

* Communicate directly with manufacturers and suppliers regarding product development.
* Oversee sample creation and evaluate fit, construction, materials, and overall quality.
* Provide detailed revisions and corrections to manufacturers.
* Manage products through multiple sampling stages until final approval.
* Ensure the finished garment matches the original creative and technical vision.

**6. Catalog Expansion & Creative Direction**

* Continuously expand Controlled Insanity's apparel catalog with new garment bases and product categories.
* Build a library of original, reusable garment silhouettes and construction concepts.
* Work alongside the creative and marketing teams to ensure products align with upcoming collections and brand direction.
* Help establish consistent design standards across all product categories.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* Has professional experience in apparel design, technical design, or product development.
* Has extensive knowledge of garment construction, pattern development, and apparel manufacturing.
* Is highly proficient in creating professional tech packs.
* Has experience working with overseas and domestic manufacturers.
* Understands fabric compositions, GSM, garment washes, stitching, and construction techniques.
* Has a strong understanding of bodybuilding apparel, streetwear, and contemporary fashion.
* Is extremely creative and constantly generating new product ideas.
* Can work independently, identify opportunities, and take concepts from initial sketches to finished products.
* Has a strong portfolio demonstrating original garment development, technical drawings, and completed products.

Performance Expectations

* Consistently present new garment concepts and product innovations.
* Maintain a pipeline of new products and garment bases under development.
* Deliver accurate, detailed tech packs for approved designs.
* Maintain communication with manufacturers and monitor sampling progress.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve existing products and expand the catalog.
* Bring proactive ideas and creative solutions to the brand on an ongoing basis.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote
